TitleText: Who has done this to Village!?

Huh, what's this!!! How could everything have changed while I was just on a business trip to Snowstorm Village.....
What? It didn't just happen? So this started a long time ago, huh?
Who cares, though? Who was it? Who has done this to the village!!!
Is it you!?
It's not you? Then MetalEtemon is the only culprit!!
You guys go teach MetalEtemon a lesson!! If you don't do that, I'll report you!!

Ah, the penguin you just saw is our leader...
He seems a little unfocused, but in the Digital World, that doesn't matter. On top of that, the fact that we're even talking shows how incredible the world is.
Complete: I'm sorry our leader surprised you.

So... What's the leader doing over there? Why is he over there... Isn't it hot?.
If he just flaps his wings, he can get out from there...
Maybe he's embarrassed...

I do have water, but if I just give it to you... Just giving it to you would be an insane way to run a business... I can't help that I'm a salesperson, first and foremost
If you don't need it, I won't care if you just go.

But if you really want it, you can go collect Dark Tower remnants from the MetalEtemon as payment. I don't know who made them, but they seem to have been made with rare minerals.
If you are a merchant, you want to have anything valuable..
Process: I thought you needed this water! Why are you so late?
Complete: Oh, good work. So you've finally obtained the remnants of the Dark Tower
Expert: Hurray! Dark Tower remnants!

Well, a promise is a promise, so here's the water. But what are you going to use all this water for?

Well, I'm not particularly interested in your reasons. Just take the water and be off!
If you feel like it, buy something... Hahaha!!

There is force shield surrounding the DigiEgg... Someone must have deployed it on purpose... I am not so sure.... Since we couldn't pass through the shield, let's test it with the data collector.

This is embarrassing, but Digimon have stolen jump boosters,  so the way back to the Real World is not clear...
I'd like to tell Homer Yushima...
MetalGarurumon have attacked and stolen from us for no reason...Please find our jump boosters.
Process:
I'm so worried that we won't be able to go back.
Shh! This is Homer Yushima's secret...

Oh, thank you. Now, a weight has been lifted off my mind as I travel through the Digital World.
What? No, I didn't say that I'm immediately returning to the Digital World...
But please take these remaining jump boosters as a token of my appreciation.

They must originally be basic Etemon, but they put on those strange metal exteriors... I want to know how that single thing gives them such strength!!
Bring back the metal exteriors from the MetalEtemon. We need them for our experiments. Something is telling me we can't overlook this.
Process: They're far too strong to be steel.
Complete: Good work... I have to investigate this now, so go somewhere and take a break.

Body:
Due to their tenacity, Vikemon were leaders who led all the Digimon in the Glacier region. However, because of the Strange Activities these days in the Digital World, they have turned very violent.
As a result, the penguin leader has given an order to take weapons from the Vikemon.
Even inside the volcano, he's still giving orders left and right..
Because the Vikemon are too strong for us to collect the weapons from them ourselves...we want you, the tamers, to handle this.
Process: Please collect the weapons as fast as you can.
Complete: You've worked very hard. Our awful leader has put you through the ringer.

?

As you know, unlike in other places, there is a Digimon who controls all of the Glacier Area.
This Digimon is called a Mercurimon, which is in its Mega stage.
Since the Mercurimon manages and controls this zone, it finds solutions promptly for the strange activities that arise.
I want you to find him and go to the Infinite Ice Wall.

Mercurimon told me to use this when threatened by Digimon...but I don't think that will happen since I'm with you, so I'm going to give it to you...

because I have to get into touch with him myself.

Process: Go back quickly
Complete: I've received a message from Commander Richard Sampson. Speaking with Gallantmon is your top priority.
Expert: Oh, you're back...

Body: First off, go to Gallantmon and have a short conversation with him. Gallantmon also seems to believe that the Dats Center is not involved in this situation. Go see Gallantmon first, and you'll be able to speak to him if you give this to him.
Process: Go now to speak to him.
Complete: So you are humans from the Real World. And what business do you have with me?
Expert: What is it?

Body:
This is Kudamon's necklace? Where did you get this, my human friend??

(Gallantmon listens to you say that you got it from Richard Sampson)

Hm... I see... so Kudamon accompanied Richard Sampson around... For some reason I never saw him.
Then you guys have nothing to do with what's happening in here. Okay, I will trust you for now, because we need to deal with strange incident first.

I came here charged with the task of dealing with the Digimon who have been behaving strangely.

Now I want you to take charge of this task, so I can test your abilities.
Process: Hmm...maybe your skills aren't up to snuff.
Complete: Hm...you're back, finally...Well, maybe your skills are good enough.
Expert: Aren't you a little late?

Body:
Doctor Akihiro Kurata and the Digimon Kaiser are the source of all this. I can't forgive them.... However, I'm so exhausted I can't take revenge against them...

SaberLeomon has also changed a great deal... He's Mercurimon's friend, Although he was a violent Digimon, he was greatly valued by the Digital World...

(Keenan Krier has a resolute look on his face.)

This is our only option to resolve this situation. First we have to get past this hurdle, to prevent all Digimon from suffering. They don't really die, because they are reborn later, so this will help them out.
Process: Even if this pains me, I have no other choice.
Complete: Thank you. You'll pay for this, Akihiro Kurata and Digimon Kaiser!
Expert: You're here.

Body:
First, recover the Symbol of Domination from the SaberLeomon, who are dominating the Glacier Area.
Although they were entrusted to be leaders, I want to deprive them permanently of their qualifications, as long as the strange activities continue.
Process: Perform your duties faithfully.
Complete: Good work. Although I am trusting Kudamon and accepting your help, I don't want to hear you talking nonsense.
Expert: You're finally here.

Body:
You have unexpected abilities...now I know why Kudamon trusts you .
But that doesn't mean you can relax now.
You have to move immediately to the next task. We still have a long ways to go.
The culprit at the source of all the Strange Activities invaded here, followed by his partner, SkullGreymon.
I want you to go defeat them.
Process: I told you to stop goofing around.
Complete: We haven't earned the right to relax yet.
Expert: You're finally here.

We're in dire need of Mercurimon's assistance in this situation.
But now all his duties have been neglected and he has disappeared.
Go to the castle and try to find Mercurimon
Let me know immediately if something happens.

Body:
So..Mercurimon isn't here...
Well, that's that. Take this, so you can use it later in the Infinite Ice Cave.
These are pyrotechnics built for signaling to one another during crises,and it's perfect for situations like this...
Go on your way.
Process: We can't let anything go wrong.
Complete:
The pyrotechnics didn't work!? I can't take anymore bad news!This situation we're in is getting worse and worse...Ok.
Now don't do anything unnecessary from now on.
Expert: How did this happen...

Body:
Hm...we're certainly swamped in work...
You've probably heard a good deal about the Eveling.
However, since we have not analyzed it to understand what it is, I want you to recover the Eveling and bring it back to me.
Process: Hmm... Eveling...
Complete:
I never thought a human would be capable of making such a thing.
That's extraordinary.
We made a huge mistake!
Expert: You're finally here.

Body:
What strange... looking Digimon over there... It looks like a machine...

(Gallantmon, upon hearing the background story on Gizumon)

Oh, I see... So that's an artificially-made Digimon...
How terrible that someone's out there playing God! !!!
Destroy all those machine-like creatures, now!!
Process: It is the ringleader.
Complete: That's a very dangerous Digimon. Where on Earth has Mercurimon gone?

TitleText: I have no need for weaklings!
Body:
Hmm? A human? It's been a while since I've seen one here.
Humans are pathetic and need to take ages to defeat even the smallest Digimon. At this rate, we'll never get out of here.
Focus more on your work.
Simple: I have no need for weaklings!
Complete:
Oh, I forgot to introduce myself. I'm Banchoreomon.
I am taking care of bad Digimon in Digital World.
And it looks like you're doing similar work, although I don't see how that is possible, if that's all your skills amount to.
Expert: I, Banchoreomon, am a Digimon that travels around and have given up all creature comforts.

Body:
You, again! Stop bothering me, you humans!

(with a face of resignation)
Alright, alright, it looks like we're all in the same boat. Well, I can't give you my total trust right off the bat.
To earn it, I'm going to put you to a test of skills...Your first task is to fight off Digimon in this area. 
Hurry back! I'll be here enjoying the scenery.
Process: So, how are your skills...terrible..??
Complete: Well, maybe you can be useful for a few tasks, but you still have a lot to prove.
Expert: Oh! I forgot you were here.

Body:
Well, you seem to be rising to the challenge... I'll give you my trust

What? You want to know what Bancho means?? What are they teaching you in the Digital World!!

If you want to know, ask someone with a good deal of knowledge about this place...
Richard Sampson will know...
Go ask him. I'm busy now.
Process: So you haven't left.
Complete: So...finally you've learned what Bancho means.
Expert:
What does Bancho mean? So, I guess you've met Banchoreomon...
Bancho is a designation given to Digimon that have just barely defeated fierce opponents in fights...
Banchoreon...this is...a surprise.

Body:
So... You found out what Bancho meant!
And here's something else to do with this... I'm going to let you in on a little secret.
You are not yet using 100% of your partner's true capabilities.
If you only realize these abilities, you'll be a match for anybody.
Complete: You think I just gave you that information for free? If I gave you access to skills before you could handle them, you'd only become more dangerous.
Expert: You still have a long way to go.

Body:
I'm not in a position to just hand you information about Mega power. Ah! Minnie has a suggestion. There are very dangerous Digimon all over the Digital World. I'll give you the information you need to achieve Mega strength, if you capture them.
Hmm, where should I send you first...
Ok...start with the Dark Tower Wasteland...
Among the SkullMeramon is an evil one who plays the role of leader. Go capture that Digimon first.. .It will be a tough opponent for you.

SkullMeramon (Ruler of the Flame) is the Boss Digimon that appears when you capture a fixed number of SkullMeramon. Keep that in mind.
Process: You've still got a long way to go.
Complete: Well, I will give you credit for your skill...You've done well.
Expert: Finally, you're back.

Body:
Strangely, the Glacier Region has become a very dangerous place.... I never expected Skull Greymon would be here...
Looks like someone did this.
(Going his own way.)
First, fight off the SkullGreymon... If you accomplish that, you'll have proven yourself to me...
Process: No, you're still not there yet.
Complete: Well, you're capable of this much...Well, congratulations, you've gained some of my respect..
Expert: Isn't this scenery beautiful??

Body:
Hm, in in any case, there some Digimon here with unknown identities...although it's not your fault...
Go chase them off. They are doing harm to Digimon living in the Glacier Region.
That way you'll prove your skills to me.
Process: What...you're tired now?
Complete: Hmm...you seem to be equal to the challenge.
Expert: So, finally, you're done?

Body:
Now, this is just the beginning. Don't let your guard down.
Now, capture Okuwamon  which has appeared at Frozen Ground...
That Digimon is known as a tyrant and is so violent that even I avoid facing him.
You're not tired yet, are you?
Don't you have to do this much, if you want to obtain Mega power?

Okuwamon (Tyrant of Darkness) is the Boss Digimon that appears when you capture a fixed number of Digimon. Keep that in mind.

Gizumon AT (Digimon Destroyer) is the Boss Digimon that appears when you capture a fixed number of Gizumon AT. Keep that in mind.
Process: I have a favor to ask of you.
Complete: As a Digimon, I don't think I can take Gizumon's attack.....
Expert: Whew...incredible...

Body:
No... This is the last one!
I've found out that there is a Gizumon that is stronger than normal Gizumon... And this will be a huge challenge.
If you take care of this, I'll give you Mega strength.
Although you seem to have grown to some extent...
I charge you with completing this final task.

Gizumon XT (Digimon Destroyer) is the boss Digimon that appears when you capture a certain number of Gizumon AT (Digimon Destroyer). Keep that in mind.
Simple: Final Challenge to Reach Mega Mode!
Process: Mega Power...
Complete:
Congratulations on completing this long training.
I hope you receive even more training and protect the Digital World.
Expert: You are incredible...

So let me make one proposal to you.
As you guys know, this place is in chaos because Mercurymon is not here. Some group of Digimon Leaders often invades this area.
If you defeat them, I will let you have Mega strength. How about that?
I think this is a good deal for both of us...

Body:
This is Richard Sampson from Dats Center.
Do you copy?
We require your assistance.
Double-time to Dats Center.
We will talk more in detail when you arrive.
Simple: Find Richard Sampson at Dats Center.
Helper: Find Richard Sampson at Dats Center.
Process: You should hurry.
Complete: Finally, you are back.  Well done.

Body:
The current situation looks grim with Dr. Akihiro Kurata and Digimon Kaiser alone.  In the midst of all this, we have also received intel that a place has been discovered in the Western Area which seems to have been intentionally distorted by human hands.
It will be a very dangerous mission.
We don't know what kind of intention lies behind this, and this may be Digimon Kaiser's trap.
A trustworthy partner in the Western Area of the Digital World
has requested elite reinforcement.  The partner will be waiting to the north of Dark Tower Wasteland.  Go and assess the situation.
Simple: Speak to Starmon in Dark Tower Wasteland.
Helper: Speak to Starmon in Dark Tower Wasteland.
Process: Hmm...  This is not looking good.  You are the only agent who can take on this dangerous task.
Complete:
So, you are the agent Dats Center dispatched?
Hmm...  I asked for someone reliable...

Body:
I'm familiar with your service records.
I'm sure you will be of great assistance to me.
Commander Sampson has briefed you on our situation, I assume?
We can't have humans frequently causing 
such incidents in the Digital World.
As it is, anti-human sentiment is spreading
because of Digimon Kaiser and Akihiro Kurata.
More and more digimons are rallying behind the ruler of the Western Area whose only mode of resolving conflicts is by force.
If this incident involves humans,
we will have to stop them first before the ruler interferes.

I will be there ahead of you.  See you there soon.
Simple: Find Starmon at the Digimon Maze Entrance.
Helper: Find Starmon at the Digimon Maze Entrance.
Process: You have to hurry!
Complete: You're back.  Too slow, don't you think?

Body:
This place is hot.  Phew...
We have built a temporary base here for now.
We have requested support from the Western Village,
but no digimons are willing because of safety issues.

Unless this place is secured and safe first,
no digimon will come to our aid.

Besides, if we are to receive reinforcement from Dats Center,
this place will need to be safe.

Rockmons near the entrance pose a significant threat.  Remove them first.
Process: Hmm...  About 15 of them should do, don't you think?
Complete: Not too shabby when it comes to taking care of digimons, huh?

Body:
Rockmons look threatening because of their sheer size.
Just because we have eliminated them doesn't mean this area is safe,
but, at least, we have removed visible threat.
This should help convince the digimons that this area is safe.
I will give you an official document requesting reinforcements from Western Village.
Take it to Chuchidarumons in Western Village.

Give me a minute.
Process: Those cowards...  Chuchidarumons have no guts.
Complete: Take the reinforcement request and the Jump Booster.
Expert: I'm writing up the official document.  Hang in there for a minute.

Body:
This is the official document requesting support.
With this, Chuchidarumons from Western Village will have no choice but to help.
I'll give you a Jump Booster to go with it, so hurry on.
Simple: Speak with merchant Chuchidarumon in Western Village.
Helper: Speak with merchant Chuchidarumon in Western Village.
Process: (Starmon keeps on grumbling out of some discontentment.)
Complete:
Hmm...  This is irritating.
We have no obligation to help you...
But this is an official document from Starmon.  We can't exactly turn it down, either...
I'm sorry, but this alone is not enough.

Body:
Oh, yeah.  I forgot about that...
Even if we have eliminated Rockmons, those coward Chuchidarumons
won't move without the evidence.
We need evidence
that we have eliminated the threat in this area.

Hmm...  We need something solid...
Oh, I know!  The leaders of Rockmons are superior to the regular Rockmons
in size and in strength.

Destroy them and bring me
5 Stone Fragments as evidence.
Process:
Those Chuchidarumons are a bunch of chickens...
They don't seem to realize how they are keeping safe
at Western Village.
Complete:
Ahem...
I see why Dats Center places so much trust in you.

Body:
Chuchidarumons are big cowards.
Even with the official document along with the evidence of safety,
they can choose not to help.
They forget that they owe their safety in Western Village to us.

(He grumbles for a while...)

Among the Chuchidarumons in Western Village, there is a certain young one.
He is very bold and curious.
If you take the Rockmon Stone Fragments to him,
he will be very curious where you got it from.
If that kid insists on coming here,
merchant Chuchidarumons will have no choice but to come as well.
Take this Stone Fragment to the young Chuchidarumon.
Simple: Speak with Young Chuchidarumon in Western Village.
Helper: Speak with Young Chuchidarumon in Western Village.
Process: (He is grumbling in some unknown tongue.)
Complete:
Hmm?  What is this?
I've never seen such a thing before.  Oh, my...
There are things I don't know about in this world?
What?  You found this in the Digimon Maze?
Hmm...

Body:
I would like to go and see the Digimon Maze myself...
Hmm?  merchant Chuchidarumons refuse to go there, you say?
Tell them I said
that no matter how dangerous that place may be,
I will go there to satisfy my curiosity.
Process:
Look at these Stone Fragments...!!
Amazing.  Simply amazing!  They have the same formation as the crystal anomaly of Martensite as a type of external anomaly in its metallic state...
Complete:
See?  What did I tell ya?
When I say I will go, others are bound to follow.
Expert:
What?  The Young Chuchidarumon wants to go where?
That place is incredibly dangerous!
*sigh* I suppose we will just have to accompany him...

Body:
Now that we have secured reinforcements from Western Village,
we need to investigate this place now.
While you've been at Western Village, I've been looking around a bit,
and I've discovered a few suspicious locations.

I would like you to go and look into these places more closely.
As you patrol the area, watch out for the digimons in the area.

They won't be all that friendly towards you.
Look out for Boltmons, especially.
Simple: Patrol around the Digimon Maze Entrance.
Helper:
%qs1Explore the Strange Altar%qe %cc1:%mc1
%qs2Explore the Destroyed Holy Site%qe %cc2:%mc2
%qs3Explore the Digimon Maze Entrance%qe %cc3:%mc3
%qs4Explore the Ruins%qe %cc4:%mc4
%qs5Explore the Ruined Castle Walls%qe %cc5:%mc5
Process: I would like you to investigate the Strange Altar, Destroyed Holy Site, Digimon Maze, Ruins, and the Ruined Castle Walls.
Complete: Ruler SaberLeomon from the Western Area is here.  Things are getting complicated.  We need to find a way to enter the Maze before they do...

Body: We will organize the supplies here first.  You go on ahead of us and let Starmon of Passion know.
Simple: Speak with Starmon of Passion at the Digimon Maze Entrance.
Helper: Speak with Starmon of Passion at the Digimon Maze Entrance.
Process: If I can just unlock the secret of these Stone Fragments...
Complete:
I was right.
The Young Chuchidarumon is fearless, unlike the rest of the group.

Body:
The Stone Fragments you brought to Western Village were fascinating.
I would like you to bring me more of those.
Where in Digital World did you get such oddities?
Bring me 10 more of those, would you?
Simple: Collect 10 Stone Fragments from Rockmon leaders.
Process: Look at these Stone Fragments.  It's as though they are alive!
Complete: Oh...  There are so many of them...

Body:
What is this place?
This is not at all what the official document said.
Unless you do something about Cerberumons,
we won't stay here another minute.

They are very aggressive, and we don't know when they will lay ambush on the base.  It's not because I am a coward...

It's all for safety...
Process: I'm just a weak Chuchidarumon who doesn't know how to fight...
Complete: We still can't let our guard down...

Body:
The research can't continue if I'm just taking little bits and pieces of material from you.  I will have to do something about this.
Of course, I won't ask you to be my guide.

I will give you something I invented.
Take it and use it where you found the Stone Fragments.

This invention is my work of art.
Don't be too amazed.

All it does is record images on the photo-sensitive plate.
Simple: Use Chuchidarumon's invention on Rockmon leaders.
Process: Did you take the image?
Complete:
What is this?  Rockmons?!
You got these Stone Fragments from Rockmons?

Body:
The young Chuchidarumon seems to be taking interest in Rockmons...
Rockmons are highly dangerous digimons.
If we are not careful, we may get into trouble.
You are an expert in that area.
I would like you to destroy Rockmon leaders
so they are not seen by the young Chuchidarumon.
Process: I think defeating about 10 Rockmon leaders would do.
Complete: You have the responsibility for our safety.

Body:
I'm sure you've been working hard at it, but the number of Cerberumons is not diminishing.
If you don't continue to keep this area safe, I'm going to leave this place.
Process: If we slay their leaders, the followers will naturally go away.  Slay 5 of them for me.
Complete: Sometimes, it looks as though you enjoy slaying digimons.

Body:
Yikes!
That's the self-styled ruler of the Western Area, the Ruler SaberLeomon.
Why is he here?

This is not good.
If he is out and about, that means he realized something is up...  He is not too fond towards you all since his failed invasion attempt into the Real World.
It's probably for the best not to get involved with him.

Hurry back to the camp and we'll talk about this.
Simple: Return to Starmon of Passion at Camp.
Helper: Speak with Starmon of Passion at Camp.
Process: It's best not to confront them head-on...
Complete:
This has gotten complicated...  They must be sending out scouts throughout the area to learn something.
It would be good to find some clues from them,
but, naturally, they won't tell us their findings that easily...  What do we do...?

Body:
I suppose there's not much we can do...
Ruler SaberLeomon may not be able to understand us,
but Patrol Leomon probably know our intention well.  The patrol must be wandering about in this area.  Find them, and tell them what they are investigating.
Helper:
%qs1Speak with Scout A%qe %cc1:%mc1
%qs2Speak with Scout B%qe %cc2:%mc2
%qs3Speak with Scout C%qe %cc3:%mc3
Process: Don't use force...  We just might end up losing potential allies.
Complete:
Hmm...  It's difficult to persuade them with words, as expected.
There has to be some other way...
Expert:
Our intel says that humans are involved in this incident.  You, too, are humans!
We cannot give you any information.

Body:
This space has been distorted by humans...
It looks a lot like the pyramids humans constructed ages ago.
There must have been an error during data configuration, though, the structures are upside down.
You should be able to see the entrance from there...  See if you can open it.
Complete:
I knew it wouldn't be easy, but...  Hmm...
Now, what do we do?
Expert:
(Force won't do anything here.)

.........

Body:
Before coming here, I had asked the Fourth Dimension SuperStarmon to scout out the area first.  He must be around here somewhere.
He may be a little rough around the edges, but he's harmless.  He'll be of great help to you as you explore the Digimon Maze.
I'll give you a flare.  Use it in a conspicuous area.
Fourth Dimension SuperStarmon will show up soon enough.
Simple: Use the flare at the Strange Altar.
Helper: %qs1Use the flare at the Strange Altar%qe %cc1:%mc1
Process: Use the flare at the Strange Altar.  It's a pretty conspicuous place.
Complete:
Hey, long time no see, suspect.
You need my help again?

Body:
As expected, there are plenty of digimons to watch out for in the area...
If we don't secure camp safety,
we may lose the hard-earned support from Western Village.
Before those cowardly Chuchidarumons pick up and leave,
let's take the initiative and destroy the raging digimons in the area.

Why don't we take care of Volcamons first?
Defeat 15 Volcamons and take 5 helmets from the leaders.
Simple: Defeat 15 Volcamons and collect 5 Volcamon Helmets.
Process: Volcamons, not Boltmon.  Don't confuse the two...
Complete: Well done.  Now that we have seized their leaders' helmets, they will feel the threat.

Body:
CannonBeemons are awful creatures...
They move about in groups wreaking havoc in the Western Area.  No matter how many of them you defeat, they just keep coming.
Defeat 20 of them for me, would you?
Not only do they look intimidating, they are also powerful.
You will have to use caution.
Especially watch out for their poison needles.
Process: Be careful.  Their attacks are immensely powerful.  If you take them too lightly, you may end up on a stretcher.
Complete: Good work.  This will make Chuchidarumons happy.

Body:
In order for us to maintain the safety of our camp,
we must defeat them continually.
Bring us 10 helmets from their leaders.
Process: Volcamons, not Boltmon.  Don't confuse the two…
Complete: Well done.  Now that we have seized their leaders' helmets, they will feel the threat.

Body:
As you defeat CannonBeemons and their leaders,
you should be able to acquire their poison needles.
Collect 8 of them and bring them to Chuchidarumons.
If we show them that we are mindful of the camp's safety,
they will have peace of mind, too.
Process: Be careful.  Their attacks are immensely powerful.  If you take them too lightly, you may end up on a stretcher.
Complete:
These are poison needle fragments from CannonBeemons?
Astonishing.  You are capable of slaying such monstrous creatures.

Body:
Since we defeated the Volcamons,
multiple PileVolcamons have appeared at the Digimon Maze Entrance.  If we don't take care of them,
our investigation on the Maze Entrance will be stalled.
Process: Defeat 10 PileVolcamons and 5 of their leaders.
Complete: Hmm...  You took these things from them, did you?

Body:
Oh, dear!
The Young Chuchidarumon has gone out of the camp...
This region is filled with fearful digimons...
How could he do such a thing?
Please hurry and find the Young Chuchidarumon.
Process: I hope he's safe...
Complete:
What?  He is gravely wounded and has lost consciousness?!
This is terrible!
Expert:
.............
(He has lost consciousness.  Judging by the wounds, he probably had a run-in with Rockmons.)

Body:
I knew this would happen!
This is why we didn't want to come here in the first place!
I will give you first aid supplies.  Go, heal him and bring him back.
This is all your fault.  You lured the Young Chuchidarumon into coming here, so you'll have to take the responsibility on this matter.
Process: Hurry!  Time is of the essence!  Use the medicine on the young Chuchidarumon...
Complete: He has survived, at least.  That's good...
Expert: Uuuhhhnnn...  Wh... where am I?

Body:
Fire...  The Stone Fragments you brought me, they are no... ordinary stones.  They can look like crystal anomaly of Martensite like a type of external anomaly in its metallic state, but...
It's nothing like that at all...
If we have powerful flame energy...
we can... we can create life.
Create life with my... hands...
PileVolcamons carry immense flame energy hidden in their back.  Bring me... 10 of those.
Process: Hur...ry...  We don't have much time...
Complete: Thank you.  This... will... do.

Body:
I feel sorry for Starmon of Passion, but... what with the accident that happened to the Young Chuchidarumon and all..., we can no longer lend our support to this area.
This place isn't safe for us.
Simple: Speak with Starmon of Passion at Camp.
Helper: Speak with Starmon of Passion at Camp.
Process: It's no use trying to change our mind.  We're sorry...
Complete:
Bah!  I knew this was going to happen!
Those cowards!!

Body:
Those cowardly Chuchidarumons have all returned to Western Village after all.
Bah!  This makes things complicated.
Now, the only other option we have is to ask Dats Center for reinforcement...
Simple: Speak with Starmon of Passion at Camp.
Helper: Speak with Starmon of Passion at Camp.
Process: Go ahead...
Complete: I have written down our situation in detail.  Take this with you.
Expert: I'm sure Dats Center won't send us any cowards...

Body:
I've made a Reinforcement Request form for Dats Center.  I need you to take it to Dats Center.
Take the Jump Booster with you and hurry back.
Simple: Speak with Richard Sampson at Dats Center.
Process: Hmm...  Raging digimons are a headache, but working with those cowardly Chuchidarumons is just as bad...
Complete:
Mmm...  I see what's going on over there.
Well done.
From now on, Dats Center will send out its reinforcements directly.

Body:
So, the chaos in this region is because of Digimon Kaisers, huh...
Hmm...
Take the Evil Ring to Chief Leomons.  If we explain to them that we have a common enemy, they will realize that they have no reason to fight against us.
We may not be able to communicate with Ruler SaberLeomons,
but Leomons will listen to us.
Process: Chief Leomon is not all that fond of you all, so you'd best be careful.
Complete:
You seem familiar...
We are allies?  How am I to trust your word?

(I show the Chief Leomon the Evil Ring.  He seems conflicted.)

I see...
You, too, are in pursuit of those causing the chaos in this area.  I understand.  We will cooperate.

Body:
We are paying attention to the strange devices installed here and there.
These devices seem to be some kind of a power suppressor.
We've sent out scouts to find out how to activate them.
You should speak with the Elite Scout Leader.  He and his scout unit are moving along the path in the middle of this region.
Give him your full cooperation.
Complete:
I heard from the chief.  Cooperating with humans, huh...
We have sent out scouts to gather intel from this area,
but the presence of raging digimons is making it difficult.  If you help them, we will give this partnership a chance.

Body:
Oh, dear...
I need to activate that strange device,
but these raging digimons are getting in the way.
I think I will investigate the device while you suppress the digimons.
Think you could lend us a hand?
It's simple.  Defeat Cerberumons and Rockmons, 10 each, so that they can't approach me while I carry out the investigation.
Process: Their willpower is weak to begin with...  Easy targets for manipulation.
Complete: Excellent work.  Now, we'll be able to investigate the device thoroughly.

Body:
One of our comrades has been attacked to CannonBeemons...
Such awful poison.
If we can't neutralize the poison, he is sure to die...
In order to create an antidote, we need their poison.
I need you to bring me 5 units of Venom from their leaders.
Process: If you are not careful, you will fall for it, too.
Complete: Thank you.  This should be more than enough for the research to create an antidote.

Body:
PileVolcamons in this area carry very strong armor.
If we render their armor useless, they are not that tough to deal with...  I will give you 5 Bombs.  Use them on PileVolcamon leaders.  Once the armor is destroyed by the bomb, it won't be that big of a threat for us.  That'll give us some edge.
Simple: Use the Bomb on PileVolcamon leaders.
Process: Regular PileVolcamons won't do.  Make sure you use them on their leaders.
Complete: Ha!  PileVolcamons won't be bothering us anymore, I see.
Expert: (There is a large explosion, but it doesn't seem to have any effect.)

Body:
Hehe...
Looks familiar, doesn't it?

(SuperStarmon shows me an Evil Ring.)

In the course of my investigation, I found out that raging digimons in the region are being controlled by this thing...
That means the one responsible for the chaos in this area, and the one responsible for the rampage of digimons in the Western Area are one and the same.

You should be able to get this as you defeat digimons in this area.  Bring 8 of them to Starmon of Passion.
That should tell him what's going on here.
Process:
You don't have to be so amazed...
This is quite normal for a genius like me.
Complete:
This is an Evil Ring!
So, you were instructed to deliver this to Fourth Dimension SuperStarmon, huh?

Body:
Hmm...
My investigation reveals that these digimons carry something strange other than the Evil Ring.
It looks somewhat like the communicator commonly used by humans.
Now, digimons wouldn't communicate with each other like that...
This thing is rather suspicious.

You can find it on digimons in the area.  I would like you to bring me 10 of them.
Process:
Don't complain or anything...
We helped you, so you should return the favor, don't you think?
Complete:
Ah!  Having collected these things stokes my curiosity even more.

(SuperStarmon starts touching this and that.  Shortly, the device breaks down...)

What is this?  It doesn't work?

Body: (This is important information written before his death.  I should take it to Leomon.)
Simple: Deliver the memo to Elite Scout Leomon.
Complete:
The Leomon has fallen, has he?  Hmm...
He has left a very critical piece of information for us.
It says here that we need to activate the mysterious devices in this area in order to open up the Digimon Maze.
It looks like we need a special device if we

Body:
What strange devices...
They look like the communicator you humans use...
It seems that someone attached these on the digimons for information.
The culprit behind all the troubles here is no doubt
gathering information about this area with these.
We should destroy them as soon as we see them.

When you see one, bring it to me and I will destroy it.
Process:
Bring 8 of each.
No matter how many more you bring, the Deconstructor can only handle a limited number at a time.
Complete: Even when I break something, I do it like a genius.  Hehehe.

Body:
We have received the report that Evil Rings have been discovered in the area.
Evil Rings are dangerous artifact that must be eliminated from the Digital World.  If you acquire Evil Rings, please, bring them to me.
Process: If something like this exists in the Digital World, the anti-human sentiment will grow.
Complete:
Good work.
I look forward to our continued partnership.

Body:
This area is a space created with the data gleaned from an ancient structure in the Real World.
Perhaps because of that, precious research data is scattered here and there in the Real World, too.
Digimons don't know how valuable these are.
Dats Center has ordered the retrieval of those precious research data.  As you take down digimons, you should be able to acquire Precious Research Data.
Bring me 5 of them.
Process: Collecting such data is certainly within the scope of what Dats Center does.
Complete: Thank you.  These will be transported to Dats Center safely.

Body:
This is amazing...
Not only have we avenged Leomons, we have also activated all the mysterious devices.
Process: We need to let Chief Leomon know...
Complete:
We have received reports of an unknown digimon at the Strange Altar.  He appeared when the mysterious device was activated.
I would like you to go and ask how to open the Digimon Maze Entrance…

<Target CannonBeemon leaders.  When the Overseer appears, seize the Power Core from him.>

Body:
This is Starmon of Passion!
The item that you gave to Fourth Dimension SuperStarmon...!
It's probably a signal emitter of some sort.
Get one of those from SuperStarmon and bring it to me.  I will find out how to use it.
Process: Get one from SuperStarmon and bring it to me.  I will figure out how to use it.
Complete:
What?  You want one of these?

(SuperStarmon grumbles.)

Body:
This is Starmon!

I want you to bring that item to me.  There may be some sort of a clue in there.
Complete:
Great work...
I will examine this thing very carefully.

Body:
Scouts are supposed to report in even if nothing has happened...
But, at some point, I stopped hearing from Leomon A scout...  Find him and see what's happening.
Process: I hope nothing terrible happened...
Complete: (There is a memo next to the Leomon.  It looks like he wrote something on it for his friend moments before he died.)
Expert: (This Leomon has sustained a grave wound.  It is already too late...)

Body:
Are you the ones who have awakened me?
I am Anubimon, a long-time guardian of this place...
My title was revoked by humans,
and I have been asleep since.
Process: What do you want from me?
Complete:
Activating all the devices alone doesn't solve all our problems in this place.  There is an underlying evil in this place.  If we don't take care of it, the Digimon Maze Entrance won't open.  Lure out the source of evil and destroy it.
You may have seen

Body:
Yipes!!
Have you seen them?  Have you?  Those are Boltmons!!
They have no emotions whatsoever.  They only blindly obey their creator...
They are cruel and fearsome creatures!!!
Leomon was defeated by them a little while ago, too...
So long as they are wandering about, this place is not safe!!!
I beg of you.  Please, destroy them!!
Helper:
%qs1Defeat Boltmon of Rock%qe %cc1:%mc1
%qs2Defeat Boltmon of Darkness%qe %cc2:%mc2
%qs3Defeat Boltmon of Flame%qe %cc3:%mc3
%qs4Defeat Boltmon of Poison%qe %cc4:%mc4
%qs5Defeat Boltmon of Strength%qe %cc5:%mc5
Process:
(He seems frightened somehow.)

Don't do anything rash like taking him on by yourself!
Complete: Th... thank you...  But this is still not very assuring for us...

Body:
Gather 10 devices and bring them to me.
If you do so, I will create a device for you that will attract the source of evil in this place.

He has the key to the Digimon Maze Entrance.
Process: You can find Danger Sensors on raging digimons in this place.
Complete: With this, we should be able to lure him out...  Be careful.  You just can't defeat him on your own.

TitleText: Root Out the Source of Evil [Party]
Body:
Take the Summoning Stone to the <Destroyed Holy Site>.  That will cause the source of evil that has tainted this region show himself.  Defeat him.
That will open the way to the Digimon Maze.
Process: You can't do it on your own...  Find some friends.
Complete:
This takes care of the source of evil.
I will give you the key to the Digimon Maze.  May eternal safety and peace be upon you...

Body:
This is Starmon of Passion!  Do you copy?
That device is the one that Fourth Dimension SuperStarmon thought suspicious before!
So, my hunch was right, after all...
Come and see me for a while, would you?
Process: Come back to Camp!
Complete: What incredible intuition.  Nothing less than Fourth Dimension SuperStarmon.  This device is highly dangerous!

Body:
I learned from Anubimon how to use this thing.  From now on, this dangerous device must be managed by Dats Center.  If you find more of these in the future, bring them to me immediately.
I will make <Summoning Stones> with them for you.
Process: Hmm...  It turns out, this is a very dangerous thing.
Complete:
Good work.
Let me give you a Summoning Stone.
You know where to use it, right?

TitleText: Root Out the Source of Evil [D]
Body:
The source of evil is so deep-rooted that... it doesn't vanish easily...
It's like poisonous mushrooms.
Eliminate the hell hunters, Cerberumons, and I will give you the key to the Digimon Maze.
Process: Destroy the source of evil and restore peace in this place...
Complete: I will give you the key to the Digimon Maze.  May eternal safety and peace be upon you...

Body:
This is Starmon of Passion!
You are amazing.  You have finally opened the way to the Digimon Maze.
Come back to camp.  Let's discuss what we'll do from here on.
Simple: Speak with Starmon at Camp Kidosin.
Helper: Speak with Starmon at Camp Kidosin.
Process: Hurry back to Camp, would you?
Complete:
Now, all we have to do is to enter the Digimon Maze.
It's probably a good idea to stock up at Camp before we enter the Maze.
Unlike here, you can't receive any supplies while you are in the Maze.  Remember that.
Oh, and we should let Leomons know, too,

Body:
I would like you to take this news to Leomons...
They are our partners, after all.
If we maintain our partnership in the Maze, they are as good as military allies.

They make powerful allies, unlike those cowardly Chuchidarumons.
Process: Take the news to Elite Scout Leomon.
Complete:
I see...
The way to the Digimon Maze is open!

Body:
Take the news to the Chief Leomons.
Now, all we have left to do is to get into the Digimon Maze.  Once we are inside, and if we can manage it, we should continue our partnership.
Process: If at all possible, we should work with each other inside as well.
Complete:
Fool!
Humankind is our common enemy...
Be gone!  If we meet each other again, I will show no mercy even for you!  Be prepared to die next time!
Expert:
I see...  I understand what is happening now.
Now, we can trust you somewhat.

Body:
Dear, me...
It looks like we fell into a trap right from the start.
This is probably an underground level of the Digimon Maze.  We have no idea what manner of traps Digimon Kaisers may have installed, so we will have to tread carefully.

I also see dangerous, raging digimons here and there.
Hmm...  Anyway, we will have to take care of those raging digimons first
if we are to leave this place soon.
Process: This place is terrifying...  Working alone is a foolish idea.
Complete: Well done...  Now, shall we move forward?

Body:
I saw Giromons up head...
They are highly dangerous creatures.  They are vaccine digimons whose original duties were to protect specific areas.
I can't believe even they are infected and being used...
It looks like whoever created the Digimon Maze is a tough one to deal with.

I have an Evil Ring Deconstructor, so we can use that.  If that doesn't work, well... I suppose we will just have to blast through this place...

Use the Evil Ring Deconstructor on Giromons.  If we can restore them, we will have a great advantage.
Simple: Use Evil Ring Deconstructor on Giromons.
Process: I hope it works...
Complete: Oh, no...  This doesn't work at all!!

Body:
Roachmons are simply disgusting...  They don't seem to realize that about themselves, though...
We will have to teach them just how disgusting they are.
They carry strange pouches that smell absolutely foul.  Seize them from them, and throw them at their leaders.  If they smell it,
they will realize just how foul of a thing they have been carrying all along...
Simple: Seize Foul Pouches from Roachmons and throw them at their leaders.
Process: Take the foul-smelling pouches from Roachmons and throw them on their leaders!
Complete: Ugh...  What a stench!  This is incredibly foul...

Body:
Ugh...  Boltmons have pursued us here...
This is not looking good...
We are sandwiched between raging digimons up ahead and Boltmons behind us.
Now, this is what I call a dilemma.
We can't afford confronting them, so the only way is forward.
I want you to defeat the Meramons that are blocking our way.  Things are very hot around them, so be careful.
Simple: Defeat 10 Meramons and 8 of their leaders.
Process: Defeat 10 Meramons and 8 of their leaders for us, would you?
Complete:
Phew...  That gives us some room to breathe for now...
When you see Boltmons, the best thing to do is flee.

Body:
This leave us with no choice...  We break through!
Defeat 5 of them!
Complete:
How sad...
Their willpower is manipulated in such terrible ways...

Body:
I have sent out scouts throughout this area...
I have to deliver orders, but I have no good way of reaching them right now.  I want you to find them, deliver the orders, and see if they are experiencing any trouble carrying out their assignments...
Simple: Deliver the Orders to the scouts.
Helper:
%qs1Deliver the Order to Scout A%qe %cc1:%mc1
%qs2Deliver the Order to Scout B%qe %cc2:%mc2
%qs3Deliver the Order to Scout C%qe %cc3:%mc3
Process: Are you not done yet?  This is taking longer than I thought.
Complete: Good work.
Expert: Hmm...  Alright.  I have received the message.

Body:
This is too embarrassing...
We've had the order document sent by Elite ScoutLeomon seized by Gladimons.

I would like you to recover that order for me...
I can't move right now, you see.

You should be able to recover the order from Gladimons.
Process: Would you mind collecting 5 Order Fragments?
Complete: Many thanks...  How unusual that I should receive help from a human.  This place is more dangerous than what one would expect.

Body:
Hmm...  I see.
The order document is torn to pieces, but, at least, we can decipher what it's meant to say.
According to Elite ScoutLeomon's orders, we are to make it a priority to eliminate Gladimons.  They are getting in the way of our dominating this place.

Still...
The situation isn't looking good.  We have already lost contact with other Leomons that have entered the Digimon Maze with me.

This place is more dangerous than we had expected.
I need you to defeat Gladimons on my behalf.
Process: The raging digimons here are more powerful than us.  How absurd!
Complete:
Thank you...
But this is not the only order...

Body:
This is Starmon of Passion!

I see that those ScoutLeomon are wasting their time and energy.  We are having trouble making progress as it is!
The best way to take them down is to eliminate their leaders.

If we don't take care of their leaders, they simply won't give up!!!
I want you to defeat Gladimon leaders.
Process: If we just rely on them, nothing is going to get done.
Complete: Thank you.  Gladimons should remain quiet for a while.

Body:
Many Leomons other than myself have entered this place.  I have lost contact with them.
Contacting Elite Scout Leomon is not easy right now, either.
It would be most appreciated if you could find other Leomons, recover their orders and assist them.
Process: Things are getting quite difficult...
Complete: .......... (He has sustained a great burn.  It's already too late...)

Body: (Judging from the wounds, this must be Meramons' doing.  I will have to recover the order document from Meramons.)
Process: (I need to collect the order documents from Meramons.)
Complete: (There is something written on the recovered order.)

Body: (The contents of recovered orders are written in digimon script and cannot be verified.  I will have to take this to Starmon of Passion.)
Simple: Take the Order documents to Starmon of Passion.
Helper: Take the Order documents to Starmon of Passion.
Process: (The contents of recovered orders are written in digimon script and cannot be verified.  I will have to take this to Starmon of Passion.)
Complete: An order left behind by Leomons?  Hmm...  I see.

Body:
Tsk, tsk...
It looks like he tried to use Aqua Crystal against Meramons to defeat them.  He was probably defeated before he could even get to using it.
Not to mention having the <Aqua Crystal> seized.  It's really too bad, but his death was in vain.  Tsk, tsk...

Recover the <Aqua Crystal> from the Meramons and use it on their leaders.
Teach them a harsh lesson, would you?
Simple: Use the Aqua Crystal on Meramon leaders.
Process: It's too bad, but his death has been in vain...
Complete:
Great!!!  Hmph!
Now, they will have learned that harsh lesson.

Body:
This is Starmon of Passion!!
Thanks to your work, we made some progress from the Digimon Maze Entrance!  Move on a little more from where Meramons are, and you'll see us.  Come this way!

We have plenty of things for you to do here, too...
Process: We have plenty of things for you to do around here...
Complete: You are here...  This place seems a little safer, but we still can't let our guard down.

Body:
This is not good...
It looks like Boltmons have tracked us down here.
If we don't take care of them,
our six will be left wide open.  Not to mention more ScoutLeomon casualty.
I'd rather not confront them unless we absolutely have to, but...
I guess extraordinary circumstances call for extraordinary measures.
I need you to eliminate <Blood Boltmons> and <Fanatic Boltmons>.
They should show themselves as you defeat <Giromons>...
Process: They will show themselves as you slay <Giromons>...
Complete: We will have to move before they start pursuing us...

Body:
You seem to be in one piece.
Since we have entered this place, the only folks who have remained safe are you and Starmon of Passion.
This is terrible...

I have lost contact with others that have come in here together, and I am isolated here, too.
Right now, I can't even verify whether they are dead or alive.

I would like you to move on forward and see if they are alive.  If they have sustained grave wounds, please treat them with the <Healing Medicine>.

I know this is a difficult task, but you are the only one I can rely on.
Simple: Find Leomon survivors and treat them.
Process: I know it's a difficult ask, but you are the only one capable of doing this.
Complete: Right...  There is a survivor...
Expert: Thank you.  You saved me.

Body:
It would be good if the scouts are still alive, but... we should also be prepared for the worst case scenario.
If they have been injured or even died, I would like you to recover the orders from them and bring them to me.
If they fall into the hands of the enemy, this could turn really ugly.
As soon as you find them, burn them.
Simple: Recover Order documents from deceased scouts.
Helper:
%qs1Recover Order document%qe %cc1:%mc1
%qs2Recover Order document%qe %cc2:%mc2
%qs3Recover Order document%qe %cc3:%mc3
Process: Retrieve the orders from the scouts.
Complete: (I have incinerated all the recovered order documents.)
Expert: ............ (It's already too late.  I will just have to recover the order.)

Body:
It's really too bad, but most Leomons here seem to have been slain...
Tsk, tsk...  What a shame.  As a digimon myself, this is a real tragedy.
It would be abominable to abandon their bodies here.
I will give you a Data Loader...
I would like you to take care of their bodies.
Simple: Load the DATA of Deceased Leomons.
Helper:
%qs1Load Fallen Leomon DATA%qe %cc1:%mc1
%qs2Load Fallen Leomon DATA%qe %cc2:%mc2
%qs3Load Fallen Leomon DATA%qe %cc3:%mc3
%qs4Load Fallen Leomon DATA%qe %cc4:%mc4
Process:
It may have been a short while, but they were our allies.
It is not right for us to simply abandon their bodies here.
Complete: The DATA you have collected from them will be recreated in DigiEggs.  Well done.
Expert: (The DATA is loaded from the Leomon.)

Body:
Those Boltmons will never give up their pursuit.  Not before we stop the one controlling them, anyway...
We need to continually slay them.
Process: Slay Blood Boltmons and Fanatic Boltmons.
Complete: Excellent work.  We should be able to relax for now.

Body:
A little farther on from here are WaruMonzaemons.  I sustained a grave wound from them.
My partner didn't even make it when they attacked...  I will probably spend the rest of my life in this sense of guilt.
The guilt of failing to protect my partner...

I may be weak and incompetent, but you are different...
You have power.  The power to save a partner in the middle of a dangerous situation.

Please, I beg of you.
I want him avenged...  And I want you to ease this sense of guilt...

Slay WaruMonzaemons and bring me 5 capes from their leaders.
Process: I need you to defeat WaruMonzaemons...
Complete:
Thank you.
This should put the souls of our fallen comrades at rest.
I will present these capes as an offering.

Body:
The information they tried to protect to their death has been lost.  It's probably the doing of the raging digimons in the area.
Recovering what they tried to protect with their life
would be the last thing I could do for them.

I want you to retrieve the information they left behind from Giromons and WaruMonzaemons.
Simple: Recover Order Fragments from Giromons and WaruMonzaemons.
Process: Giromons and WaruMonzaemons are probably behind this...
Complete: Great work.  The final message they left behind...  I will protect it with my life.

Body: (This looks like a device that activates the Digimon Maze power source.  I will have to find the power source and activate the device.)
Process: (There must be a digimon who is carrying the power source in the Maze.)
Complete: (The device starts with a great roar.)
Expert: (The device starts with a great roar.)

Body: (This looks like a device that activates the Digimon Maze power source.  I will have to find the power source and activate the device.)
Process: (There must be a digimon who is carrying the power source in the Maze.)
Complete: (The device starts with a great roar.)
Expert: (The device starts with a great roar.)

TitleText: Power Source for Device of Blood
Body: (This device seems old and unstable.  I should continue to secure power sources.)
Process: (I need to seize the power source from Blood Boltmons.)
Complete: (The device starts with a great roar.)
Expert: (The device starts with a great roar.)

Body: (This device seems old and unstable.  I should continue to secure power sources.)
Process: (I need to seize the power source from Fanatic Boltmons.)
Complete: (The device starts with a great roar.)
Expert: (The device starts with a great roar.)

Body:
We meet again, human...
Thanks to your effort in securing the power source of the Maze, entry into the Maze is now possible.
Complete:
I will send you to B1.
Once you activate the power sources throughout the Maze and restore the Maze to its original condition, we should be able to find my body as well.
Please remember this - the only way to stop him is to recover my body.
Expert:
Originally, I took care of the Maze.  My responsibility was to protect the ancient artifacts and treasures in this place.

But, since Digimon Kaiser robbed this place and sealed my body, the security of this place has been compromised.

Body:
Did... did you feel that!?
What?  Was it just me?  Since I came in here, I feel some strange... resonance...
Complete:
We need to find a way to go up, quick.
I will look for a way to go up there.
Why don't you do the same?
Expert:
It is as though the entire Maze is moving.
I have a bad feeling about this...

Body:
Oh, no!!
A battle has broken out at the dead-end path up ahead between Leomons and the pursuing Boltmons.
Things are not looking good.  I broke away from it to get help, but... with this wound, I won't be able to last too much longer, either...  Ugh...

(Leomon spits out blood.)

You are our last hope.  Hurry...  Go and help the Leomons, or we will be annihilated.
Process: At this rate, we will all be annihilated!!!
Complete: Hehehe...  We have some powerful reinforcements now.

Body:
Now...  Haha...  All we have to do now is to use the power source to activate that device...
*cough* But, be careful...  He is not alone in this...
Simple: Defeat Boltmons and activate the device.
Process: When they show themselves, slay every last of them...  They must be eliminated before we can start the device.
Complete: Great work.  You have strength unlike anything I have seen.  Thank you...  Take this news to... *cough*
Expert: (The device starts with a great roar.)

Body:
Argh...  I got it pretty good...
I will have to rest here for a while.
Leomons that have entered the Digimon Maze are now all dead.
Please take this news to Chief Leomon at the Digimon Maze Entrance...
Process: Uhn...  The chief is probably at the Digimon Maze Entrance.
Complete: Annihilated?!  I have lost my digimons again...

Body:
*sigh*
So, Leomons who entered this place have been annihilated.
That's what happens when you are all passion and no caution.
I will give you this Data Loader.  Please, gather their bodies.
Helper:
%qs1Load Leomon DATA%qe %cc1:%mc1
%qs2Load Leomon DATA%qe %cc2:%mc2
%qs3Load Leomon DATA%qe %cc3:%mc3
%qs4Load Leomon DATA%qe %cc4:%mc4
%qs5Load Leomon DATA%qe %cc5:%mc5
%qs6Load Leomon DATA%qe %cc6:%mc6
%qs7Load Leomon DATA%qe %cc7:%mc7
Complete:
Well done.
The loaded DATA will be recreated in DigiEggs.
Expert: (The Leomon's DATA is loaded with a bright light.)

Body:
I can feel their grief and bitterness...
As their chief, I can't move on to something else unless I relieve them of their grief.
Will you help?
Process: Help me avenge their deaths, will you?  Destroy Berserker of Destruction.  He will show as you destroy <Boltmons>.
Complete: Pray for their souls to rest in peace.

Body:
Boltmons have stolen the <Power Source> we need to activate the device.  It must be very important to the Digimon Maze.
Recover the seized <Power Source>...
That is our priority.
Simple: Secure the power source to activate the device.
Process: Take the <Power Source> from Boltmons.  They seem to be trying to protect that device.
Complete: Yes.  This is it.  If we just use this <Power Source>...

TitleText: Report the result to Akihiro Kurata
Body:
I have read Akihiro Kurata's report and proposal. 
But why do we have to spend
such an enormous amount of money
to proceed with the project...
Tell him that we need firm evidence
to proceed.
Simple: Go back to Akihiro Kurata in Yokohama
Process:
We need a firm evidence...
Akihiro Kurata's proposal is good, but we need firm evidence to persuade opposing party...
Complete:
Huh...!!
Do we need more evidence!?
Shoot... What a coward.
Do you think I would give up just because
some of them are against my brilliant project?

Body:
We need more data in order to
execute my project!
I need your help.
I heard many Digimon have appeared at the Small Forest Trail.  I should go there and investigate
those Digimon immediately.
Meet me there when you are ready!
We should hurry. The number of Digimon
coming to Real World
is increasing...!

Don't tell me that you don't know where Small Forest Trail is. It is at the end of Small Forest Park. Now follow me!!
Simple: Find Akihiro Kurata at Small Forest Trail
Process: I will follow you as soon as I am ready...
Complete:
Look all those Digimon!
Aren't they awful?
Now. Let's begin if you are ready.

Body:
Kekekeke...
Now... Send this report to Director Hashima
at the Dats Center.
This is an indisputably perfect report
I can just see their reaction
now.
Simple: Return to Director Hashima in Dats Center
Process:
Hurry up. Move. Move!
If you are expecting some kind of reward
forget about it.
Beside, you didn't do anything.
Complete:
Report from Akihiro Kurata?
Hmm... Let's take a look?

Body:
Why do I have to return to the
Digital World full of those awful Digimon?
Well, it's just matter of time.
You can't enter Digital World because you are not an official agent...
Why don't you ask Richard Sampson
to promote you to official agent?
Not a bad idea, don't you think? Kekekeke
Come and see me once you are in Digital World
At least I know you are good at
fighting with Digimon.
If you could be of help in my research
you should consider it an honor... Hahaha...
Simple: Find Akihiro Kurata in Digital World
Helper: Conversation with Akihiro Kurata at Digital World Western Village
Process: So you work for Richard Sampson... Huh? What a pity.
Complete:
Are you an @<tc:800>official agent@</tc> now? Kekeke...
That will certainly speed up my research.
Shall we proceed as soon as you are ready?

Body:
Hmm...
Akihiro Kurata's report was very interesting.
But I feel that it is insufficient to research only the Digimon that have appeared in the Real world.
There must be all kinds of Digimon in Digital World.
If you could include them in your project, you will be able to come up with a better report...
Tell Akihiro Kurata that's what I think.
Simple: Report to Akihiro Kurata in Yokohama
Process:
That's a better idea than Richard Sampson's idea of doing nothing...
Dr. Akihiro Kurata
Complete:
What!?
That sly bastard...
Does he still think my report is
insufficient?

Body:
Thank you for everything~
You are young. And you are doing your job well.  You taught me a good lesson.
?
So you need a letter of recommendation to become an official agent?
I will write one for you.
Take it to Richard Sampson at the Dats Center.
Process:
Now, off you go.
I am sure you will be a good @<tc:800>official agent@</tc>.
Complete:
From the nurse?
Hmm... I see.
Since you have accomplished another task, I will give you @<tc:800>Dats Emblem@</tc>.

Body:
Thank you. Thank you for rescuing me from Digimon.
I won't do such a foolish thing again.
I will write a letter of recommendation to Richard Sampon at the Dats Center...
?
Simple: Report to Richard Sampson at the Dats Center
Process: I hope you can become an @<tc:800>Official Agent of the Dats Center@</tc>.
Complete:
Hmm... I see.
Now that you have solved all the problems, I will give you a @<tc:800>Dats Emblem@</tc> that proves that you are an official agent of Dats Center
Keep your spirits up.
And don't give up no matter how hard it gets.
?

Body:
You get a Cracked DigiEgg by defeating normal Digimon, as a type of trophy.  All you have to do is send it back to Digital World safely.

Go straight south, and you will find Woodmon. Take some bark from him. What?! That isn't cruel. They are not living beings...

Body:
You've come through D-Terminal, haven't you?  You've come a long way.

The File Island is made up of [Silver Lake], the [Silent Forest], the [Forgotten Ruins], [File Shores], the [Infinity Mountain and dungeons].

Aren't you getting excited just to think about all the adventures ahead of you?

Your adventure will begin at Silver Lake! Go east from here and you will find the path that leads to the Lake.

The File Island is filled with exciting adventures, but there are many problems, too. It would be very nice of you to take care of them, Tamer.

I hope you make lots of friends with the Digimons here. Enjoy the incredible adventures here on the File Island!

Process: Have you spoken with Agumon at Silver Lake yet?

TitleText: Reason why Palmon has became violent
Body:
I heard that the Black Cogwheels makes Digimons violent from other explorers. 

Palmon has become vicious recently, do you think it is related?  
Defeat Palmons and check whether Black Cogwheels are  there.
Simple: Collect 5 fragments of Black Cogwheels after eliminating Palmon
Process: I think the Black Cogwheels is related to the reason why Palmon became violent.
Complete:
Is this the Black Cogwheels…? 
It has crack on?!

Body:
This small fragment can make Digimons violent? 

Hmm… I think I cannot investigate more about this. 
Earlier explorers might have more information about this. 

Take this fragment to Terriermon. 
I will contact him in advance
Simple: Give Black Cogwheels of Palmon to Terriermon
Helper: Give Black Cogwheels of Palmon to Terriermon
Process: Terriermon must know more about this.
Complete:
I got call from Hawkmon in advance. 
You brought a fragment of Black Cogwheels?

Body:
Hmm… It seems like an investigation kit is necessary, but I have none. 

Explorer Lopmon across the continent has Ruins Composition  Analysis Kit. 
You may investigate with that. 

Go find Lopmon first.
Simple: Speak with Lopmon the explorer across the bridge
Process:
Palmon is near the cliff. Palmon will send you to across continent.  
Ruins Composition Analysis Kit will find out the component of that piece.
Complete: You need Ruins Composition Analysis Kit?

Body:
Oh… my god….. 
Gotsumons have stolen Ruins Composition  Analysis Kit while I was away. 
They won't know how to use it! 
Please bring me Ruins Composition  Analysis kit Gotsumons stole back to me.
Process: Gotsumons took the Ruins Composition Analysis Kit.
Complete:
Thanks! 
I will check whether Gotsumons touched it or not.

Body:
Fortunately, it looks fine. 
Here it is. 
Take it to Terreiermon.
Simple: Give Ruins Composition Analysis Kit to Terriermon
Helper: Give Ruins Composition Analysis Kit to Terriermon
Process:
Give this to Terriermon.
Terriermon will be waiting for you.
Complete: You came! I was worrying since you took so long.

Body:
All right, then let’s exert analyst's instinct of explorer~
Wait a minute!
Process: Concentrate! Concentrate!
Complete:
I think this is not made naturally from File Island. 
This fragment is too small to analyze in detail, but certain Digimon's energy is in here.

Body:
I heard from Lopmon that Gotsumons have stoles Ruins Composition  Analysis kit. 
I knew they are prank but nowadays it became more serious. 

Maybe Gotsumons too? 
Investigate Gotsumon and Gotsumon Leaders!
Process:
Prank boys! 
There should not be such a thing!
Complete:
Nothing happened? 
Phew~ It's not affecting all Digimons yet. 
But we have another problem!

Body:
While you were gone to investigate, another explorer Starmon has contacted me. 
Digimons have also became violent in his area. 
I made a report with information you gave, take this to Starmon!
Process:
What are you doing? 
Hurry up to speak with Starmon!
Complete:
Did Terriermon send you here? 
Our situation is bad here, too.

Body:
This is RedVegiemon's Village. 
I knew that they smell bad, but they did not attack first. 
One day, they became violent and spread disgusting smell all around! 
Stop RedVegiemon's violent behavior first!
Process: My head aches so badly because of RedVegiemon's smell…
Complete:
Phew… It seems a little better now. 
Wait a minute please. I will read the report.

Body:
Let's start serious conversation now. 
So the reason why Digimons became violent is the Black Cogwheels? 
And some Digimon created this Black Cogwheels?? 

Hmm…. Right! I think I saw RedVegiemon with black energy! 
It must have the Black Cogwheels! 
Go and get me one.
Simple: Collect 1  Black Cogwheels fragment of RedVegiemon
Process: Maybe this Digimon is affected by the Black Cogwheels.
Complete:
Did you get it? 
What? This is also a fragment of Black Cogwheels? 
Then there's nothing different from report….

Body:
Yes! SuperStarmon is near the river below. 
He is in corner but very bright about information. 
Get more fragments of Black Cogwheels and speak with SuperStarmon. 
He might know something.
Simple: Collect 5 Black Cogwheels fragments and give to SuperStarmon
Process:
SuperStarmon has good hearing. 
Go find him.
Complete: Why did you come to see me?

TitleText: Master Investigator? Reclusive Digimon bright for Rumors?
Body:
Have I heard about Digimons became violent? 
Yes, I already knew that. 
Why I did not tell anyone? 
Why should I? This area around me is so peaceful. 

So, you came to see me for information? With nothing? 

Huh, you are not aware of Give & Take. 
Recently Blossomons are increased and became loud. Go defeat some of them . 

What are you doing? Hurry up!
Process:
You don’t want information? 
Then just go.
Complete:
Thank you. 
It's quiet now. 

Then let's start to talk.

Body:
Did you see while you are coming up to here? 
Digimons in File Island became violent. 
The phenomenon started not long ago. 
I believe that this started to happen after you humans came to File Island. I just assume like that… 

Ah.. I don't blame or hate you humans, so no worries. 
I think your potential ability threatens the Digimon which created that Black Cogwheels. 

There is a Ruins across the river. 
You can find out about ancient legend if you go there. 
It might tell about your potential ability in detail. 

That's all I know. 
Return to Starmon and tell what I told you. 

Right, Leomon just walked by. Leomon is a nice Digimon. If you have more questions, go ask Leomon.
Process: Return to SuperStarmon and tell this.
Complete:
Really?! 
Your appearance and Bad Digimons' behaviors…. 
I am sure that Bad Digimons are afraid of you!!

Body:
Emergency Contact! 
Yukidarumon is in danger! 
Yukidarumon is a Digimon collecting trees around here. 
I did not hear details yet. 
Go talk to Yukidarumon now!
Process: What are you doing? Hurry up!
Complete:
Sob… 
Leomon…Leomon is….

Body:
I'm sorry… I can't talk right now because my heart is pita patting…. 
I think it will calm down if I listen to Gewappamon's song and smell Blossomon's flower. 
Will you get those for me…?
Simple: 1 Headset of Gawappamon and 5 Flowers of Blossomon
Process: Sob… I'm scared….
Complete: Thank you. Can you talk to me again after I calm down?

Body:
Um… Now I feel calmed down… 
Have you seen Leomon while  you walk here? 
Ah.. You didn't… 

You already know that Leomons are nice Digimons, right? 
But the ones I saw a moment ago were different… 
They were running with mad eyes and mumbling something… 
Defeat children interfering our purpose....' 

Something must happened to Leomon. 
I don't know the detail. 
Cherrymon might have seen Leomons too. 

Go talk to Cherrymon. It will tell you about Leomon and more details.
Process: Go to Cherrymon. I need to calm down.
Complete:
Yes. I also saw Leomon. 
It has black energy around. 
Can you tell me what had happened on the way here?

Body:
Cherrymons also became violent here. 
Black Cogwheels are the cause of their viciousness… 

Remove Black Cogwheels from them and get 5 fragments for me.
Simple: Collect 5 Black Cogwheels fragment of Cherrymon
Process: Bring me the Black Cogwheels embedded in Cherrymon.
Complete:
Thank you. 
This won't solve the problem, but it will get better.

Body:
A legend tells that there is an ancient document containing ancient digimon's prophecy. 
We call is the  Ancient Document  of Legend, but never seen it before. 
According to the legend, Mammothmon, the digimon who was with the birth of Digital World, has the document. 

Could you get the Ancient Document of Legend from Mammothmon Captain?
Process:
The biggest Mammothmon lived for the longest time. 
That Digimon seems to have the most possibility…
Complete:
Oh, this is it. 
I have never seen it before… 

Wait a minute here. I will read it once….

Body:
Damn…. The book is sealed itself. 
We can get the ancient document by ourselves, but not able to open…. 

I think it is out of my capability. 
Jijimon is over there. Go talk to him.
Simple: Give sealed Ancient Documents of Legend  to Jijimon
Helper: Give sealed ancient documents of Legend to Jijimon
Process: Jijimon knows a lot of things. He must know how to open the ancient document.
Complete:
Ancient Documents? 
I see the ancient document I only heard about for the first time. 
But we can't see it because it is sealed?

Body:
I am not sure if it can unseal the Ancient document, but I have a method. 

I need some materials from Digimons… 
Firstly, get Crystal of Wisdom from Mammothmon and Magic Wand of Wizardmon.
Simple: Collect 5 Crystal of Wisdom and 5 Magic Wand of Wizardmon
Process: I will prepare while you are gone to get materials.
Complete:
Nice work. 
Step aside, I need to use my spell.

Body:
Done! The book is opened! 
Let's read for a while… 

Oh….right… Hmm…..

I will summarize it for you, wait a second.
Process:
I am organizing in my head. 
Wait a minute.
Complete:
The Ruins contains the secret to make you, Chosen Children, more powerful. 
The reason why the Ruins was separated into two continents is to prevent Bad Digimons from blocking your power. 
But then I think Bad Digimons are now trying to jump ahead of us.

Body:
Tell this to Babamon. 
Also tell her what had happened until now. 
File Island is facing a huge crisis!
Process: Go see Babamon now.
Complete:
That's what happened… 
Now what happened here seems to fit each other…

Body:
I kind of guessed that. 
Waspmons and Dokugumons in this area became vicious, too. 

I have an ability to feel Digimon's energy. 

Bring me Black Cogwheel fragments of Waspmon and Dokugumon. 
I believe that I am more accurate than explorer's Ruins Composition  Analysis kit, I can figure out who's behind this.
Simple: Collect 5 Black Cogwheel fragments of Arachnemon, 5 Black Cogwheel fragments of Waspmon
Helper:
%qs1Arachnemon's Black Cogwheels Fragment%qe  %cc1/%mc1
%qs2Waspmon's Black Cogwheels Fragment%qe  %cc2/%mc2
Process: Digimons are more violent closer to the Ruins.
Complete:
Thank you. I feel bad mind raises just by holding the fragment of Black Cogwheels… 

Could you give me a little time? I need to concentrate…

Body:
Devimon? This is Devimon's energy! 
I can't be sure but I felt Devimon's energy. 
A champion Digimon could show this much power…. 

We need to stop this right now!! 
Let remaining explorer around the Ruins about this! 
They are in danger!
Process:
We have no time to spare! 
Go on!
Complete: What? Is that true? I saw Leomons moving towards the Ruins… But they were controlled by Devimon's power…

Body:
Tentomon is out to Entrance of Ruins for investigation! 
But I can approach because Digmons are raving around… 

It will be quite if we can defeat Digmons. 
Please defeat Digmons and tell Tentomon to evacuate!
Process: The situation is serious!
Complete:
Evacuate to a safe place? 
Digmon s are behind and Leomons are in front. I can't move at all~

Body:
Leomon is wandering around the Entrance of Ruins. 
I can't see well here, so  I am not sure what they are doing. 

Do you see a huge tree over there? 
Can you check Leomon's movement on the tree with telescope?
Simple: Use telescope where Leomon can be seen
Process: That huge~ tree in front.
Complete:
They are not able to enter the Ruins? 
That might be the reason why they are waiting for you so desperately.

Body:
There must be a reason why Leomon cannot enter the Ruins. 
Babamon might know about it. 
Speak with Babamon!
Process: Babamon knows a lot of things~
Complete: Leomon cannot go into the entrance of Ruins? Some power must block them….

Body:
Now is the chance! 
Leomons are wandering around, show your power! 
Once Leomon recovers its spirit back, Leomon will be your great supporter. 

Did you knot that Leomon is Fire Attribute? 
If you attack Leomon with Water Attribute Digimon, it will be much easier to win. 

It might be hard if you go alone, take other Chosen Children with you!
Process: Remember. Fire Attribute Leomon is weak at Water Attribute Digimons.
Complete:
Leomon ran away? 
Anyways, good job.

Body:
Have you been to shore? 
Not the shore in Real World. 
Shore of File Island is very famous for resting place. 

However, Black Cogwheels energy is affecting Digimons of the shore. 
Speak with Gawappamon at the shore to solve problems they have.
Process: Black Cogwheels are affecting all over the File Island…
Complete:
Welcome. 
You are new to the shore, right?

Body:
Well… Could you do me a favor? 

I love….no..like my  senior explorer Lopmon. 
Collect flowers on Palmon's head and give to Lopmon!
Process: Whoops ashamed  >ㅅ<
Complete:
What is this? 
Terriermon sent it?

Body:
I understand Terriermon's mind. 
But we are just good friends. 

Unless Terriermon become more mature explorer. 

For that reason, I will give some work. 
Gotsumon's rock skin is deeply related to stonecomposition from the Ruins. 
Collect 5 rock pieces of Gotsumon and give to Terriermon.
Process: Just a good junior colleague yet.
Complete:
Is this the answer of Lopmon?

Hmm, I think it's more serious than I thought.
M..Millenniummon… might appear in Infinite Mountain...

I… I will stop helping you from here.
You can do what the heck ever you want now!
