Complete:
Oh, my! It really happaned, Culu!
Wait, what? You… already defeated… Millenniummon?

Body:
Well, it seems like it's out of hands now.
As you would know as well, there will be a massive chaos - literally, a MASSIVE chaos if Millenniummon appeared in the Digital World.

But, now that you have defeated Millenniummon, you are now officially qualified to gain my trust, Culu!
Process: Millenniummon is a very dangerous being! Make sure to handle it with care!
Complete: I'm not sure if this is a good thing that I'm doing…

Body:
What the heck is that weird-looking Digimon?
I've never seen one like this.
Seems like it can evolve, too, just like many other Digimons.

What? I can't tell you how to evolve this Digimon, Culu!
It's certain nothing 'good' will come out as the result even if it evolves.
Simple: Talk to Digimon Kaiser in Dark Tower Wasteland
Process: Don't you dare think I will let you know how, Culu.
Complete:
Heh… You're a lucky useless being to have that Digimon that I made.
How are they? Are you feeling the powers yet?

Body:
What? Chimeramon can evolve in a different way?
Well, that bugs my curiosity.
I will do some researches on Chimeramon's Digivolutions.

However, the only thing is that Chimeramon possesses relatively low power despite all its merged data.
That being said, I am in need of some 'information' just for this Chimeramon. Go defeat Megadramons in Ruined Historic, do some research on their abilities, then report them back to me.
Process:
What in the world do you think you're doing here, you useless being?
Move your darn feet to Ruined Historc! … Now!
Complete:
Great, great…
Seems like increasing Chimeramon's power abilities just as much as Megadramon's value will get the evolution going.
Nice work, but you're still useless.

Body:
Yikes! How could this even happen…?
Oh, wait. You're still here - good, good. Let me tell you what happened.
I injected Mugendramon's power data into your Chimeramon because Megadramon's data weren't enough.

The result? Well… It successfully evolved, but that pathetic creature just ran off without even noticing me, the mighty Digimon Kaiser.
It seemed like it ran off into Infinite Mountain areas... but that's none of my business now!
Process:
A Digimon that doesn't listen…
It sickens me just by thinking of it.
What it does is none of my interest, anyways.
Complete: I sensed great evilness in Infinite Mountain. Was that you who defeated it, Culu??

Please open the jar instead of me with the lever Dracomon has. I will share the rewards exactly at odds of 7 to 3. Of course, I will take 7.

Do you want to do it or not? Decide it!

Kahaha! There must be huge treasures

Hey!

You won't know what kind of Digimon will appear; do not surprise and collect the piece.

You can't use Jump Booster in File Island!
Be careful, Calu!
Simple: Remove Dark Tower C and collect Dark Tower C's broken piece
Helper:
%qs1Remove Dark Tower C%qe  %cc1/%mc1
%qs2collect Dark Tower C's broken pieceC%qe  %cc2/%mc2
Process: Don't forget to collect the pieces, Calu!
Complete:
A Digimon appears whenever you destroy a Dark Tower?
Wait a moment, Calu.

Body:
It must be Arachnemon, Calu!

This is the Dark Tower mutant summon card made of the broken piece. 
Defeat the Digimon appearing at the tower and get Arachnemon's hair to have more detailed information, Calu.
Process: I heard the information that a Dark Tower becomes a Digimon by using Arachnemon's Hair, Calu.
Complete: I have found another Arachnemon's weak point again, Calu!

Body:
The information I heard is not wrong, Calu!
 
It seems that Arachnemon is using its hair to transform Black Towers into bad Digimons, Calu.
Complete:
We've got all the data, Calu.
Now, let's go to stop Arachnemon, Calu!

Body: We have Arachnemon's hair and gloves. Now defeat it, Calu!
Complete:
It's terrible, Calu!
Arachnemon did something big, Calu!

Body:
Arachnemon is now transforming 100 Dark Towers at once to summon BlackWarGreymon, Calu!

BlackWarGreymon is not under Arachnemon's control and trying to destroy the Digital World.
Complete:
I have to find a method, Calu!
While I think about how to take care of it, please prepare for battle, Calu!

Body:
Armadimon!
I want you to go to Digimon kaiser and ask him for help.
As he is the one who installed the Black Tower, he must know a weak point.
Find Digimon kaiser, Calu!
You can meet him at Infinite Ice Wall in Glacial Area.
Complete: Please jogress with Patamon and defeat BlackWarGreymon again.

Body:
Patamon!
While Armadimon is gone to ask for help, stop BlackWarGreymon, Calu!

 
BlackWarGreymon is making troubles at the center of Dark Tower Wasteland.
Process: Now go to Dark Tower Wasteland, Calu!
Complete:
Please jogress with Armadimon and defeat BlackWarGreymon again, Calu.

Use this card at Dark Tower Wasteland to make it!

Body: When you have a new Jogress form, try to challenge BlackWarGreymon using <BlackWarGreymon summon card>, Calu!
Process: Do your best, Calu!
Complete:
Though you didn't win, it's great you found a new jogress form, Calu!
Keep it up, Calu Calu.

Body:
So, you are the General with a Xros loader?

Now Shoutmon and the Digimons are waiting in the GreenZone.

I think they need your help.

Talk to me again when you're ready.
Process: Are you ready to go?
Complete: Did Jijimon allowed you to come all the way here?

Body:
I have a favor to ask of you, General...
If you go to the GreenZone,

Would you send my regards to my friend there, Jijimon?
Process:
Do me a favor!

My friend looks just like me!
Complete:
Is he alive?
This is a small gift of gratitude for delivering the letter.

Body:
Um, General!
I've heard that there's a guy in the Green Zone called Madleomon(Illusion Digimon). I'd like you to defeat him and bring me some saw blades.
Process:
I think it's going to be good research...

I have a lot of questions about Crossche Digimon!
Complete: Thank you. If there is anything, can I ask you a favor again?

Body:
Get up! Get up!

Thank you for putting my melody into the Xros loader!


This is the Green Zone where we live in the Digital World.

 Madleomon, one of the Bagramon's Minion, is controlling this zone.

I almost died, but you saved my life!

Oh, Who am I?
Simple: Welcome~ first time of GreenZone, right?
Process: Do you really want to know?
Complete: Well than, here's the answer.

TitleText: Who will become a King of Digimon
Body:
Do you want to hear it?

You want to hear the name of this body!

My name is Shoutmon! One day I will be the King of Digimon!



I don't think it's time to have a casual conversation.

He brought his men down this cliff.

If we don't stop them now, our town will be attacked!


First, Defeat four Mammothmon at the below the cliff.

After that, check out the Xros loader!
Simple: Will become a King of Digimon
Process:
Mammothmon is Madleomon's minions.

I can't get enough of them!
Complete:
All right! That's enough to move forward.

There's a Madleomon on the right side of the low hill. Be careful!

Body:
Our brothers are always shining! Thank God you came back alive!

I heard you're going to help us defeat the Bagramon's Army for a while!

Shoutmon says he's okay, but he is not fully recovered yet, i guess.

Inside the Green Zone, there's a Food called Diginoir Don! Collect 10 of Diginoir by defeating Digimons in GreenZone.
Process: Diginoir Don is a low drop probability for Digimon in the Green Zone, so you won't be able to collect all of it all at once.
Complete: Thank you! I'll take care of Brother's health!

Body:
I have to go to the Starmons Brother!

I'm lost here!

There are too many CommanDramon's in front of me to move forward.

So I want General to help me!

Can you open the way for me?!
Process: What are you doing? I have to go to Brother!
Complete:
I thought a Pickmon wasn't enough, so it was.

I'm sorry, brother!

Body:
I heard there's a hidden area in this Green Zone.

Through a thick patch of bushes,

They're selling items that could weaken the 매드Leomon...


First of all, Please defeat the chaotic SunFlowmon.
They're not always bad guys!
Process: SunFlowmon is originally a resident of our village.
Complete:
Thank you!

To continue with the story…
I heard that you should go through a wooded area.

Body:
Madleomon absorbed his men and split the ground!

We need the Pickmon to move on.

I feel like They are playing in the front yard because I'm out of military discipline!

Can you scold them and bring them to me?

I'll keep you in line so I can get through this road!
Process: What a lacked in the discipline.
Complete:
Pickmon will make you a string.
You can ride them over! Take care!

Body:
I think if you turn right at the crossroad, you might able to do the trial-match with Madleomon.

I heard that from Jijimon, so it should be right!
Why don't you try the challenge?
Complete:
Don't let down your guard! It's only a Illusion!
Even though, you did a great job!

Body:
The Mammothmons are big.

I can't just pass by because they blocking the way!

All the Bagramon's Army should be punished!

So General.

Please help me...yes?

Let's defeat Mammothmon and move on!
Complete: Now! The road is open, so charge!

Body:
General! If you go down this cliff, there will be a Mikemon not far away.

They're waiting for help.

Let's help on the way!


First find me a Mikemon.

They will be in a little higher where the terrain that went down.
Process: Are you still out there? Are you scared, General?
Complete:
Shoutmon worried about me?

Well, you came just in time!

Body:
Please here me first!

There's a Tricky Digimon called Phantomon in front of us.
I came out with my friends, "Gatomon" and "Black Gatomon."
He took my friends somewhere else!


Can you defeat them and find my friends?

I'm begging you.

I want to go there myself, but actually I don't like the type that looks like a ghost...
Process: Wouldn't have gone that far!

Body:
My friends were dragged by the Phantomon!

I need your help, General.
Process: Move! Before it's too late!
Complete: Thank you.

Body:
Thank you, General!
I think Mammothmon and Mikemon have been settled.
But it seems like some of Pickmon has left the Starmons line at the left side of the pass the hill of trials
I really hope that if you can help on the way?!

In front of this is a very powerful Madleomon : Armed mode.

He's the current ruler of the Green Zone.

He's one of the member of the Bagramon's Army, but he's at the bottom position.

But be careful! He's very powerful.

If he cut the ground with his saw, there will be critical damage you'll wear it.

I've heard that if we defeat the summoner he summons,

They are going to drop an item that you can directly damage him.

Keep that in mind!
Process:
I can't go in anymore!

I'm scared!

Please defeat them and bring peace in this Green Zone!
Complete:
Good work, General!

Even though I ran away, you defeat the Madleomon.
I can't let my guard down until he comes back!

Body:
How did you find this place?

I'm a friend of Ballistamon, Shoutmon.

And I don't like Fighting.

I want to get out of here, but I'm worried about that "MechaNorimon" in front of me. I don't want to fight first.

I'm sorry, but can you help me?
Process: If you defeat him, I will give you an important information about Madleomon and items.
Complete:
If you're on your way to fight the Madleomon,

Take this item!

This will be works to a summoner.

Body:
Who are you? I am Dats member Yoshino Fujieda.

Next to me is my partner digimon Lalamon.

First, I will tell you simple instructions and the information you need.
Process:
You can do basic moves by clicking the mouse.

Right click the mouse to move vision,

and use the mouse wheel to control the camera zoom.
Complete:
Welcome.
But I don't recognize you. Are you rookie?

Body:
You know the simple instructions now, right?
What? Wait.. Wait.. I have a call from the Dats Center.

Yes! Yes… Okay!

Umm… It's last minute, but I have a favor.

Rapter-1 is running away from the lab and causing damage.

If you go down the stairs behind me you will see the sky park.
They say he is there, so find the monster and keep him down.
Process:
Have you found Rapter-1?
Rapter-1 is in the sky park down the stairs behind me… It is the worst situation right now, so hurry!
Complete:
You took care of Rapter-1. You must be pretty good?

I will tell you one instructions I didn't tell you earlier..

You can register skills in the shortcut slots and use them.
F1-F2 are basically registered so try them!

Body:
Hi~ As I introduced before, I'm Dats member @<tc:171>Yoshino Fujieda@</tc>.
The Digimon next to me is @<tc:171>Lalamon@</tc> of my partner.

Ah! Richard Sampson said me, bring you to Dats Center. 

At first, visit Mrs. @<tc:171>Sara Damon@</tc> befor you go to there.

You can meet her if follow the road!
Process:
I thought there were stairs down to the park…
Have you still not found Marcus Damon's house?
Complete: Hi? It's really good weather~^^
Expert: I'm just cooking for a breakfast, could you eat Rolled Omelet together?

Body:
Oh, are you the one who's trying to become the rookie of Dats?

I'm glad you came..

Doctor Homer Yushima over there asked me to show him anyone who looked like a Dats member..

Go and meet Doctor Homer Yushima.
Process: Go to Doctor Yoo Homer Yushima in front of you.
Complete: Oh, you must be the Rookie of Dats!

Body:
There are 3 types of DigiEggs. 

@<tc:800>Retrieval DigiEggs which can only be retrieved@</tc>, 
@<tc:800>DATA Scan DigiEggs@</tc> which contain DATA that can be scanned,
@<tc:800>Mercenary DigiEggs@</tc> from which you can gain mercenary digimons.

DigiEggs with DATA can be scanned for items.

 But you need to pay for the scanning, so keep that in mind.

 Shall we bring the DATA Scan DigiEggs? Sarah Damon from Yokohama Village found  DATA Scan DigiEggs by chance.

Go and retrieve the DATA Scan DigiEggs from Sarah Damon.
Helper: Speak with Miki Kurosaki in Yokohama Village
Process: @<tc:800>DATA Scan DigiEgg@</tc>still has data left so you can get various items…
Complete:
Oh… good job. Are you the new Dats member?
I found this egg in the house as I was cleaning.

Body:
DATA Scan DigiEggs are divided into digimon types such as dragon type, beast type, insect type, ore type, plant type, bird type, devil type, etc.

Will you get this back to Miki Kurosaki?

You will find Miki Kurosaki by going down this steep road, at the parking lot on your left.

There are vicious Drimogemon on the way, so be careful..
Helper: %qs1Relay Dragon Mercenary DigiEgg to Miki Kurosaki%qe %cc1/%mc1
Process:
You must handle with care because it still has data in it.
Don't be too rough!
Complete:
Wow… Well done.
This is the @<tc:800>DATA Scan@</tc>DigiEggs. You can normally get it from the @<tc:800>Field Digimon@</tc>. The @<tc:800>DATA Scan DigiEggs@</tc>you can get according to field digimon are different so study them when you can.

Body:
All right!  Let's scan this DigiEgg. 
I'll give you a practice DigiEgg.  Try scanning it yourself.
To scan DigiEggs,                                                                                                                                                              come and speak with me first.  Then, select  Scan DigiEgg.
You can click "Auto-Assign" or drag the DigiEgg in the inventory that needs scanning.
Once you scan the DigiEgg, bring me whatever item you gain from it....
Curious what you will find?                                                                                                                                             Well, scan it and find out.  Heh.
Process: What is in it?? Aren't you curious?
Complete:
Ha, ha, ha… This DigiEgg was for practice so the item I entered came out…
but if you scan a general DATA Scan DigiEgg, you may not acquire diverse items.
Now you understand @<tc:800>Scanning DigiEgg@</tc>to a certain extent, right?

Body:
Huh? What?
You are going to meet Richard Sampson to become a Dats member?
There is a problem with how Richard Sampson handles digimon matters.

He's far too soft. We can't handle the growth of digimons.  We need to take drastic measures and preemptively eliminate potential problems... On this point, Director Hashima, the one in charge of Dats, agrees.

If you are a Dats member, it will be in your own best interest to assist me. *snickers*.  Get out there and bring me Dragon Digimon Research Data from Koromon.
Process:
Get the Koromon and collect
dragon type data…!!
Complete:
Ah… okay, okay…
That is great data.

Body:
There is a set chance of acquiring the data you just scanned when scanning DigiEggs.

If you happen to obtain a mercenary DigiEgg, you can hatch it for a mercenary digimon.

To hatch mercenary DigiEgg, you have to take it to the mercenary hatcher NPC and register it. You will also need the correct ingredient DATA.
                                                                                                                                                                                             You can get ingredient DATA items from scanning DigiEggs. Don't you forget...
Process:
If the@<tc:800>Mercenary DigiEgg@</tc>is hatched you can raise not just the @<tc:800>Partner Digimon@</tc>but also other digimons.
Isn't that great?
Complete: But it's too early to become an @<tc:800>Official Dats Agent@</tc>. How about starting with helping those who are in trouble because of the recent appearance of digimons?

Body:
We sincerely apologize for causing inconvenience for game users
with this quest since the last maintenance on October 10.
Complete:
This is a small reward I give with a sorry heart.

Thank you.

Body:
This is Richard Sampson. Can you hear me?
Now, you are the member of Dats Center. However, only the partner digimon can't make you great Tamer. You have to hatch mercenary digimon and nurture it as a strong digimon. It is also the condition for great Tamer. I will let you know the method to hatch mercenary digimon. Acquire 1 mercenary DigiEgg from Kunemon in front of you...                                                                                                                                               Size and shape of mercenary DigiEgg are different from those of other DigiEgg so you will identify it easily.
Process: You need other Mercenary DigiEggs and data to hatch mercenary digimons.
Complete:
This is great…
What you just acquired is a Kunemon Mercenary DigiEgg.

Body:
I have received information that a pair of bank robbers

have used a Drimogemon to steal a safe and ATM machine.

You are the closest, so take care of it.
Complete:
When you fight digimons don't forget to use the surrounding topography well.

I will give you a Dats Badge as a reward.

Body:
Can you hear me? This is Richard Sampson.

You will see a school ahead.

If you see a digimon reaction at the school,
it means there is someone in need. Please check it out.
Complete: If understood, hurry and go!

Body:
I am responsible for retrieving and scanning DigiEggs. 
You will see PawnChessmon more than me most times.

Retrieving DigiEggs is a basic task that a Dats member must carry out often.

While we are at it, let's scan Retrieval DigiEggs.
Process: What are you doing? Scan the DigiEgg I gave you, quickly.
Complete:
Wow… Well done.
Does this complete your first mission as a @<tc:800>Dats Agent@</tc>!?

I will give you a @<tc:800>Retrieval DigiEggs@</tc>. Try @<tc:800>Retrieve@</tc>it yourself. To retrieve, talk to me and select @<tc:800>Retrieve DigiEgg@</tc>.

Body:
The rabbits I take care of died during the night.
I… took care of them well… but…

Please find out who killed my rabbits!

My friend Kristy Damon says she saw someone who looks like a caterpillar do it!

Please get him!
(Is the culprit Kunemon? You need to investigate the small forest park.)
Process:
It was a digimon that looks like a caterpillar.
I think it was a Kunemon.
Complete:
Whew- Thank you..
The bad digimons need to be taught a lesson!
Hee hee…

I will give you a Dats Badge as a gift.

Body:
This is Richard Sampson.
A digimon has come to the Real World and is causing traffic signal problems. It has been confirmed as an Elecmon so find it and take care of it immediately!
Complete:
It seems like you are getting used to your work.
Here is a Dats Badge for you.

Body:
Hmm… Oh no…
That small spark-like thing is strutting around the streets and lighting fires. We cannot do anything about it. Can you help us?

Fires are hard to put out even with wind once they start to grow big.
Process:
Fire is interesting.
Don't forget that.

Fires are hard to put out even with wind once they start to grow big.
Complete:
Thank you.
Take the Dats Badge you need.

Body:
Ah, do you recognize me, too?
I am the young star of this age, G. Neon.
What is the secret of my popularity?
I… Only I must know it!!
Process: I am going to work on it alone in my room.
Complete: Are you still hanging out over there?

Body:
I have information that there are signs of a digimon near G. Neon.

It seems like Keramon is helping G. Neon.

He uses an information network, but he is stronger than he looks so be careful.
Process: Don't interrupt me!!!
Complete:
Sorry. I will try to make it to the top on my own from now on.

This is the Dats Badge you are looking for.

Body:
We have sufficient material on the dragon type now…

Now we need research data on the animal type digimon.

Seeing you collect data,
it seems as if you are qualified to be my subordinate..

Catch the Upamon and Tsunomon to get
research data on the animal type digimon...

This should not be difficult for you, with your skills?
Isn't that right?
Process:
Get the Kormon and collect
dragon type data…!!
Complete:
Ah… okay, okay…
That is great data.

Body:
Ha, ha, ha, ha…
Now… Get this report to Director Hashima
at the Dats Center.

Umm… It is a perfect report
without any room for objections,                                                                                                                                    so I can tell
what the reaction will be like.
Process:
Move quickly.

If you think that something is going to fall,
it's best that you don't hope for it.
You have done nothing, after all.
Complete:
The report by Doctor Akihiro Kurata?
Hmm… Shall I have a look?

Body: If you solve the case of the Yokohama village people who are experiencing troubles with digimons, I will give you a Dats Badge. Collect 5 of these…
Process: Have you collected all the Dats Badges?
Complete:
Hmm…
This is definitely a @<tc:800>Dats Badge@</tc>. Well done.

Body:
You have collected 5 Dats Badges. I now have to acknowledge you as an Official Dats Agent.
Come to the Dats Center to see me…

You can come quickly if you use the @<tc:800>Spatial Temporal Bomb-Dats Center@</tc> I gave you earlier.
Complete: You took care of it so quickly…

Body:
This is Richard Sampson of the Dats Center.
I heard you were helping Doctor Akihiro Kurata's work.

Doctor Akihiro Kurata is working for the Real World, but his methods only worsen emotions in the Real World and Digital World.
Process: He works for Real World, too, but his methods are wrong.
Complete:
I will recognize you as an Official Dats Agent if you bring 5@<tc:800>Dats Badges@</tc>to me.

I hope you will find a way to effectively solve the problems between the Real World and Digital World on your own when you become an official agent.

@<tc:800>D

가을을 맞이하여 14일간 사용할 수 있는 코스튬을 준비했다.
남자는 타오르는 주먹이지 !
여자라면 미안하군.
Process: 개인적으로 장갑이 마음에 드는데 말이지...

추가경험치 40%
공격력 40
친화력 40

Body:
나의 이름은 현무몬.
북쪽을 수호하는 디지몬이다.
데 리퍼들이 최근 보이는 것 같아.
이 녀석들은 디지몬이 아닌 '삭제'프로그램으로 일종의
백업 프로그램이지.
Process:
자네가 선택받은 테이머라면 그것을 증명할 수 있는 
"무언가"를 보여주길 바라네
Complete:
'디-아크' 군.
좋다. 이야기를 시작하지.

Body:
사성수 중 서쪽을 지키는 백호몬의 안부가 궁금하네-
데 리퍼 녀석들과 엮인 것이 아닌가 걱정도 되고.
백호몬의 종인 신드라몬을 찾아가보는게 좋을거야.
Process:
아직 안갔나 ?
신드라몬 녀석은 서부마을 어딘가에 있을거라 생각되는데 말이지...
Complete: 뭐라고 하던가 ?

Body:
역시나 백호몬은 데 리퍼녀석들과 싸우고 있단 말이군.
내가 바로 서쪽으로 가야겠네.
부탁하나를 하지.
이 북쪽의 안전을 보장해주면 마음편히 갈 수 있을 것 같은데...
눈보라마을에서 보이고 있는 메가드라몬을 처리해줬으면 좋겠어.
Process:
디지털월드에서 현재 상대 디지몬을 처치하고 로드할 경우
리얼월드로 갈 수 있는 힘을 얻을 수 있다는 소문이 돌고 있다더군.
Complete:
고맙네 작은 선물로 나의 디지코어의 일부를 주겠네.

I think we have to find another way out of the canyon here.

Body:
Welcome, the Digidestined.
I will train you here so you can fight Etemon!

First, fight with Roachmon in the west region so I can see your skills. Beep!
Process:
Fighting Etemon is not easy.
That is why you have to train. Beep!
Complete:
Good job. Beep!
I think that is enough.

Now, only Tai will receive special training with me. Beep!

Body:
Piximon instructed me to go on a special training.
I don't know why he is making only me do it but I must do what he told me to do.

The special training is fighting and defeating Strikedramon.

I think Strikedramon is in the southwest direction.
Process: To be honest, I am not confident. Do you think we will be OK? Agumon?
Complete:
Tai is becoming confident again. Beep!
The purpose of this special training was to help Tai be confident again. Beep!

Body:
It is weird… My necklace started glowing.
Does it mean my Emblem is around here somewhere?

It looks like the light becomes brighter when I go towards the south where Strikedramon live.
Process: Let's go to find the Emblem of Friendship.
Complete: Great, it is my Emblem of Friendship!

Body:
There is no need to stay here anymore because Tai is confident again and we found the Emblem. Beep!

Move to the 'Beginning of the Canyon,' the first place of the desert canyon. Beep!

Move to the east and you will easily find the place. Beep!

Helper: %qs1talking with Izzy at the 'Beginning of the Canyon' of the desert canyon%qe  %cc1/%mc1

Complete: Ah, this place is… I see.

TitleText: A question about the Digital World
Body:
Go down the road and you can get out of the desert canyon.
We can now get out of this complicated place.

But there are still unsolved puzzles.
It is a good idea to move to the south and fight Gazimon.

I will wait for you on the road towards the pyramid.
Process: We have to catch Gazimon to collect information.
Complete: The sentence information they had is similar to the information in the ruins.

Body:
You can operate the program just by using sentences and can make the Digital World using electricity.

Now, we understand the surrounding region. We only need to collect information for the whole map now.
We have to obtain the pieces of the Digital World Map from Gazimon.

Helper: %qs1collecting the pieces of the Digital World map%qe  %cc1/%mc1

Body:
The Digital World map is very similar to the world we live in.
That means this place is a world that looks similar to the model of the world made of data.

It is like we are in this world as data.
Process: Let's try to figure out the place from where Datamon sent the mail.
Complete: What? That means we are not real but our existence is digital!

Body:
That means our real selves are someplace else and we are here digitally.
That means we cannot die even under any danger.

Excellent! Let's fight Etemon and save Datamon!
Let's defeat Cherrymon, who is blocking our way, and go forward!
Process: Children! Let's go!

Excellent. Just wait Etemon!
I will show you the results of the training!

It seems like the children are placed in so much danger while finding my Emblem.
I am so sorry…But I am very thankful that all of you do not show it.

I want to do something helpful for the children. What do you think of finding kindling for Cherrymon at the bottom?
I want them to have fire so they will be warm tonight.
Process: Please. Find kindling.
Complete: Thank you. I will never forget your help.

Body:
To destroy the mobility of Etemon, we have to stop Monochromon, who pulls the train, at least a little bit.

That is why I want you to defeat Monochromon in the southeast so Etemon cannot use the train.
Can you help us a little?

I will be at the place of hope. Tell me when it is completed.
Process: I am nervous because I think Etemon might follow us all the way here.
Complete:
Thank you!
Do you think we can relax a little?

Body:
It looks like that evil Digimon is trying to break T.K. and I apart.
What is it trying to do, luring T.K.?

Let's show PicoDevimon a piece of our minds.
Process: T.K. must not fall for PicoDevimon's trap!
Complete: Thank you. Because of you, T.K. and I are not drifting apart.

I like Izzy. He is always searching for knowledge.
However, his necklace is glowing faintly but he is not thinking of finding the Emblem at all.

He is completely focused in researching the Digital World.
So, what do you think about searching Roachmon in the west for Izzy's Emblem?

There really is the Emblem of Knowledge.
With this, I have the ability to evolve into an Ultimate!

I really want photosynthesis.

Can we chase them away? If we defeat the Leader, I think we can somewhat take the place.

Complete: With this, I can receive some sunlight!

There is a hidden place in the canyon. Beep.

The reason I am here is to observe them. Beep.
If they come out, the Digital World will surely fall into chaos. Beep.

Can you fight them?

OK. If you are that sure, I will tell you how to fight them. Beep.

I have a basic idea of the route but it is better to be sure, right?

Now, let's go and face Datamon!

Body:
The one you saw just now is called Devimon.  I'd been looking for him all along.
Too bad I lost him again.
(They look similar, but he's a different digimon from Leomon as I know him.)

Devimon, how dare you do such a thing to me...?!  I will show no mercy!
(I did hear that Leomon (Devimon's Nemesis) was once brainwashed by Devimon.)

The evil must be purged!
I will find him and destroy him!

Stay alive, tamer, at all cost!
Before you go on any further,
you should explore the surrounding area.

Well done.  I suppose this concludes the exploration of the surrounding areas.

While you were out and about,
I found a device in this area used by humans .

I would like you to take this to its owner.
(I took Miki Kurosaki's Communicator from Leomon.)

Go on, tamer!

%qs1Speak with Miki Kurosaki <D-Terminal-Dungeon-2F>%qe  %cc1 /%mc1
%qs2Deliver Miki Kurosaki's Communicator%qe  %cc2 /%mc2
Process:
Hmm?  You are not sure where to find Miki Kurosaki?
I heard that she is somewhere in B2.

Keep moving on, and you should be able to
find the one you seek.
Complete: Oh, this is the Communicator that I lost a long time ago.  Thank you for finding it.

Body:
Thank you for finding this Communicator.
With this Communicator, I will be able to communicate with Dats Center without a glitch.

As a Dats agent, I've been examining the digimons in this area.
They are showing unusual behavior.

They have all become very ferocious and aggressive.
Sure, there are digimons that were aggressive in the first place,
but the digimons that used to be docile have now turned aggressive.

A Devimon appeared here and there, and I can only speculate that this is his doing.

Anyway, we will have to begin by investigating Monodramons in the area first.
Process:
You are not sure where to find Monodramons?
As you come to B2, you will see many pathways.

Enter these pathways and you will see small rooms.
You will find Monodramons there.
Complete: Thank you.  This is a Black Cogwheel, as I had suspected...

Body:
Thank you for bringing me the Black Cogwheel before.
It really helped with the investigation.

Now that we have found the cogwheel,
it is almost certain the Devimon's doing, the one that has been showing up around here.

Still, this is not 100% conclusive.
Can I ask you to investigate a little more for me
Thank you so much.

If you keep going ahead here,
you will come to a large open space.


There, you will see digimons called Keramons.


Keramons are rather mischievous,
but I don't think they realize that their mischief is putting the Digital World in danger.

Investigate them for me, would you?
Go on, then.
Process:
You will find Keramons if you go straight
from the pathways.

They are purple.
If you see mischievous faces,

you have found them.
Complete: Thank you.  Your help is making our investigation much smoother.

Body:
Thank you so much.
With your help, the investigation has become so much easier.

But I can't keep asking you to do things for me,
so I'll ask one final thing of you.

Have you heard of the Great Twelve?

Of these twelve, there is one called Sinduramon.
It's in the shape of a bird.

I would like you to investigate the Sinduramon.
It flies around like a bird.

You should be able to recognize it right away when it shows.
Now, move along and investigate Sinduramon for me, will you?

When you are done, go and speak with Leomon (Devimon's Nemesis).
Process:
Sinduramon, one of the Great Twelve,
is a bird-like digimon.

It flies in the sky, so you should have
no trouble spotting it.

Please, hurry with the investigation with Sinduramon.
When you are finished, go and speak with Leomon (Devimon's Nemesis)
Complete: This concludes the preliminary investigation in B2.

Body:
I see.  So you have finished the investigation of this area, then?
You are not sure where this Black Cogwheel comes from?

It is the doing of none other than Devimon himself.

Long ago, I met Devimon on the <File Island>.

He once used the <Black Cogwheel>
and controlled my body.

I have never forgotten that piece of my past.
Now we know that it is Devimon's doing...

We must secure a wider perimeter, and then
close in on him.

Go and secure a wider perimeter for us.
You will have to travel far, so be sure to be prepared.

Stay alive at all cost, tamer!
Process:
Go deep into the B2 area,
and you will discover two new areas.

Stay alive at all cost, tamer!
Complete: Well done, tamer.  Thank you for your hard work.

Body:
Well done, tamer.
I regret to see you so hard at work because of the enmity between me and Devimon.

Anyway,

while you were out and about,
I did some work of my own.

I found another device.
(Leomon (Devimon's Nemesis) handed over the device to me.)

I would like you to take this to its rightful owner as well.
(What looks like a Communicator has the name <Megumi Shirakawa> written on it.)

Go on, then, tamer!

%qs2Deliver Megumi Shirakawa's Communicator%qe  %cc2 /%mc2
Process:
That cursed Devimon...
He has been using the so-called Black Cogwheels
to cause pain and suffering for digimons.

This is unacceptable!
Complete: This is the Communicator!

Body:
Oh, this is my Communicator!
I had lost it as I came deeper into B2.
I've been using a different Communicator since.
Thank you for finding it for me.

My name is Megumi Shirakawa.  I'm from Dats Center.

I just heard from <Miki Kurosaki> over the Communicator
regarding the Black Cogwheel.

<Miki Kurosaki> has told you about the digimons
in the area having turned violent, I assume?

It seems that an evil digimon called <Devimon>
has brainwashed the digimons in the area
with his <Black Cogwheel>.

I would greatly appreciate any assistance you can offer
in this investigation.

Have you heard of a digimon called <Hagurumon>?

There are <Hagurumons> in the area,
and they know how to fly.

I need them for my investigation.  Please, help.
Process:
Hagurumons attack from the air.

They look like saw blades.
They may look rather cute, but you will feel
differently when they start attacking.

We need to get this done for the investigation.  Please, hurry.
Complete: Thank you for bringing me the Black Cogwheel.

Body:
You have the Black Cogwheel.  Thank you.
The data you have collected is helping us greatly
in our investigation of this region.

This time,
I would like you to investigate Wendigomons.

They are sometimes also called Chocomons,

Body:
Thank you, tamer.  Thanks to you,
Dats Center is seeing great progress in its investigation.

We have learned a lot of things
from the data you collected for us.

As you have no doubt discovered in collecting the data for us,
digimons in this area have been under the control of
one called Devimon, the self-titled <Messenger of Darkness>.

It has been using something called <Black Cogwheels>.
It puts the cogwheels in the body of the digimons in the region
to control them at his will.

Now that we have found this out,
please extract <Black Cogwheels> from the digimons
to save them from their pain.

I would appreciate it if you would extract
<Black Cogwheels> from <CyberDramons>.

Oh, and you should also meet with
 <Pajiramon> on your way.

In passing, it told me that it had something to say to you, tamer.

Body:
I am Pajiramon.  You have sought me out.

You do understand that I am one of the Great Twelve, do you not?
The Great Twelve are the twelve zodiac digimons.

Sinduramon whom you saw in this area
is one of the Great Twelve.
I, too, am one of the Great Twelve.

I know not whether you know this yet,
but the enemy digimons in this area are suffering
because of the <Black Cogwheels>.

I would ask that you go and liberate
the many digimons who are suffering.

First, go and liberate
Monodramon
Keramon
and Sinduramon
from their pain and suffering.

I big you good luck!
(I felt that there was something strange about the way Pajiramon looked at me.)

I am very grateful to you.

Hagurumon
Wendigomon

I should be able to find my body as well.

This is my final favor that I will ask of you.
Slay some Candlemons and Bearmons,
and I will grant you passage to Digimon Maze 2F.
Thank you.

I am Etemon, the most powerful digimon in existence!

What?  Why am I in a place like this, you ask?
Shut yer cakehole!
It ain't none of your business.

I like to be noticed by others,

Anyway, you, tamer, must also obey my every whim.

What?  I'm being rude to a stranger, you say?
You still don't get it, do you?

No matter.  I have my reasons for being here,
so don't go on prying.

Bah!
Maze 2F is way too complex.

You work for me now,
so I command you to scout for me.

as well as the <Path of Stillness> area.

Oh, shut up and just do it!

This is my final favor that I will ask of you.
Please tell Starmon what just happened.

I will soon grant you passage to Digimon Maze 4F.
Thank you.

Body:
Once upon a time, the Primeval Digital Era comes to an end,
and the Ancient Digital Era began.
Yet, peace never came.
Humanoid digimons and beast digimons began their fight.

The cause of this fight traces back to the Three Great Angels.
Seraphimon and Ophanimon loved humanoid digimons.

However, Cherubimon, an angel digimon in the form
of a beast, loved beast digimons.
The will of the Three Great Angels was divided,
and Cherubimon declared war on humanoid digimons.
The war raged on.

Then, a digimon by the name of Lucemon suddenly appeared.
He stopped the war and restored peace.
But, before long, Lucemon became corrupt.  He went into the
Fallen Mode and began to threaten the entire Digital World,
until the Ten Warriors appeared, sealed Lucemon, and disappeared
leaving their spirits behind.

However, this was all in the past..

Still, Mercurymon and SaberLeomon open a new chapter,
and a new story is about to begin.
A new story of war between humanoid digimons and beast digimons.

Find out who has the bomb, get it and bring it to me.

Complete:
Now I will give you the strength of the Royal Knights that only the chosen can get, Culu!
However, you have to have a heart of justice at all times as long as you are going to be the Royal Knights.

Body:
You have to complete various missions to evolve into a Jogress. Culu! 
First, solve the problem at Snowman Village, Culu! 
There is a problem right now at Snowman Village. Seadramons are tormenting the nice Digimons. Catch the Seadramon Leader, Culu!!
Process: I think something is wrong at Yokohama Village. Culu!
Complete:
Thank you. Snowman Village has become calmer now thanks to you. 
I think there is a problem at Yokohama Village, too… Culu.

Body:
The phones are not working at Yokohama Village…Culu...
We found out that Infermons are causing a problem. 
Go to Digimon Maze 3F and catch the Infermons (Inferno), Culu!!
Process: We have to solve it before something bigger happens, Culu!
Complete:
It looks like the phones are working properly now, thanks to you, Culu! 
Why does something not feel right? I feel like we missed something. Culu…

Body:
I checked and found that something big has happened, Culu!! 
Diablomon is trying to blow up the Real World. 
If the bomb goes off, the Real World could be in danger. Culu ..
We can find Diablomon if we go to the Unlimited Ice Bow. 
The problem is, I don’t know who has the bomb. 
Find out who has the bomb, get it and bring it to me. 
Please solve the problem, Culu!!!
Process: You are the only one who can solve this problem. Culu!
Complete:
Whew, we almost had a huge problem at Real World, Culu… 
We just need to complete the final mission now. 
Remember, you have to have a tamer level of 70 or above to complete the last mission. Come back to see me when you reach level 70.

Body:
Right! I will teach you how to get new strength, Culu!! 

It looks like some of the Keramons that caused a problem at Yokohama Village have been hiding and they have evolved strangely into Armagemons.
Catch the Armagemons at Digital World with your fellow Digimons, Culu!!
If you use this item at the Digimon Maze Entrance, you can call the Armagemons, Culu!!

Catch them and bring me their blood as proof. Culu!
Process: Hang in there. You might be able to get new strength. Culu!!
Complete:
Now I will give you the strength of the Royal Knights that only the chosen can get, Culu!
However, you have to have a heart of justice at all times as long as you are going to be the Royal Knights. 
The strength of Royal Knights is the strength of light,

Body:
Hmmm… why are the phones not working… 
Ask Donglemon at the Dats Center. 
Culuemon will know what the problem is.
Process: Go to the Culumon at the Dats Center and find out how to solve the problem.
Complete:
The phones are not working at Yokohama Village… 
Culu … This is terrible. 
Ah, we just got some news.

Body:
Have you heard of...
the Twelve Heavenly Generals of Digimon?
Rat, Ox, Tiger, Rabbit, Dragon, Snake, Horse, Sheep, Monkey, Rooster, Dog and Boar.
The explanation above
explains the Twelve Heavenly Generals of Digimon.
This month of [December]
is the month of the <Ox /Vajiramon >.
If you handle the enemy digimons that are spread out all over the map
for a month...
you will get a <Crystalloid of Twelve Heavenly Generals>.
If you collect all of them...
You will reach your goal and good things will happen.
Process:
Have you heard of...
the Twelve Heavenly Generals of Digimon?
Complete:
Have you heard of...
the Twelve Heavenly Generals of Digimon?

TitleText: The Great Twelve on the Move
Body:
You must know more about the Great Twelve than me now!
They are the mouse, the ox, the tiger, the rabbit, the dragon, the snake, the horse, the sheep, the monkey, the chicken, the dog, and the boar.
There is a Digimon for each animal: 
<Mouse / Kumbhiramon>, 
<Ox / Vajramon>,
 <Tiger / Mihiramon>, 
<Rabbit / Antylamon>, 
<Dragon / Majiramon>, 
<Snake / Sandiramon>, 
<Horse / Indramon>, 
<Sheep / Pajiramon>, 
<Monkey / Makuramon>, 
<Rooster / Sinduramon>, 
<Dog / Caturamon>, 
and <Boar / Vikaralamon>
The power of the <Great Twelve> will be activated.
Now that you have gathered them all, something good will happen, not to mention the achievement of it all.
Simple: The Great Twelve on the Move
Process:
The power of the <Great Twelve> will be activated.
Now that you have gathered them all, something good will happen, not to mention the achievement of it all.
Complete:
The power of the <Great Twelve> will be activated.
Now that you have gathered them all, something good will happen, not to mention the achievement of it all.

Body: With Pumpkin Bomb I give, hunt pumpkin monsters and collect 30 candies.
Process: I don't have enough candies. Bring me more!
Complete: Here. I will give you this item as I promised.

Simple: Conversation with Gallantmon of the Infinite Ice Wall
Helper: Conversation with Gallantmon in the Middle of the Infinite Ice Wall
Process: Have you met Gallantmon?
Complete: It is the plan of Yggdrasil, huh…

Body: I will give you items if you bring me candies.
Simple: Get Rid of Arkadimon and Find Gallantmon's Records
Process: Did you find my records?
Complete: Hmmm...

Body: The X antibodies brought with them survival of the fittest among Digimons. I think Leomon, who failed the competition for survival, is around here. Help him.
Helper: %qs1%qe Speaking with  X Antibodies Predator Leomon %cc1:%mc1
Process: Have you met Leomon?
Complete: What is it?

Body:
I seized all the X antibodies I could get to stay alive... To survive. Digimons' survival of the fittest? Huh... Is it too much to think that this might be part of Yggdrasil's plan?

Is it time for my X antibodies to become prey...?

I do not have much longer to live, but I am getting angry... I have no strength in my body...
Process: We... Do not... Have... Much time left now...
Complete: You have done something useless. I do not have much time left now. Take this. These are my X antibodies. I do not need it anymore.............. You must ...... Survive....

Body:
Your hidden strength will have awakened with the X antibodies I gave you.
I have hurt other Digimons and taken their X antibodies to stay alive, but I always thought about whether it was right.

Go! Go to the Culumon at the Dats Center and find your way. You have made me feel a little bit more comfortable...


... Thank you
Helper: %qs1%qe Speaking with Culumon at the Dats Center  %cc1:%mc1
Process: There is not much time left...
Complete: That happened to Leomon, I see...

Body:
Death-X-DORUgoramons will appear through the Terminal Gate I provided. The Terminal Gate can be used in <Gloomy outer Area> of the North-western Outskirts 
Terminal GateA-Death X antibodies A
Terminal GateB-Death X antibodies B
Terminal GateC-Death X antibodies C
Terminal GateD-Death X antibodies D
You can buy Transfer Terminal Gate A from Death-X-DORUgoramon.
By defeating it, you can obtain the Gate B and the Death X antibodies A for certain amounts of rate. If you couldn't receive the Death X antibodies A, you will again have to face the Death-X-DORUgoramon to receive it.
After receive the Death X antibodies A, you will have chance to fight against the another Death-X-DORUgoramon from the Gate B and by defeating the monster from Gate B, you can obtain the Gate C and the Death X antibodies B for certain amounts of rate.
This process continues until the Death X antibodies C and D which you will have to collect 4 different types of Death X antibodies A, B, C, D and bring it to me.
Simple: Collect Death X antibodies A, B, C, D
Helper:
%qs1Death X  antibodies  A%qe  %cc1/%mc1
%qs2Death X  antibodies  B%qe  %cc2/%mc2
%qs3Death X  antibodies  C%qe  %cc3/%mc3
%qs4Death X  antibodies  D%qe  %cc4/%mc4
Process:
Death-X-DORUgoramons are dangerous... They might destroy Digimon World...
Get rid of the Death-X-DORUgoramons...
Complete: You have defeated the Death-X-DORUgoramons, Culu! Digimon World has been relieved for the moment from the danger of Death X evolution. Thanks, Culu!

TitleText: The Legend of the Savior Dragon
Body:
Have you heard of the legend of the Dragon King, Culu?

It is a new legend on the dragon type Digimons that did not exist in the old Digital World... However, it is just a legend...

Legend has it that the Dragon King saves the world.. That is all I know. Ask the Culumon at the Snowman Village for more information, Culu.
Simple: Conversation with Culumon of the Snowman Village
Helper: Conversation with Culumon in front of the hill in the middle of Snowman Village
Process: Is the Dragon King legend nothing more than a legend?
Complete: They are researching the Dragon King legend?

TitleText: The Legend of the Dragon King.
Body:
You want to know more about the new dragon type Digimons, Culu?

The dragon of the legend is known to be awakened from a jewel called the Aqua Orb. However, I do not know the location of the jewel... I have to check the records on the Dragon King legend to find out the location of the Aqua Orb.

I have Detection Stone of Aqua Orb, but... Detection Stone must be used in the place written in the records, Culu!! 

They say the records about the legend are in water that does not make things wet, Culu. However, I heard you can sometimes find it on the Seadramon that goes in and out of the water as it pleases.

Get rid of the Seadramon and find the records on the legend of the Dragon King, Culu!
Simple: Get rid of the Seadramon and look for records on the legend of the Dragon King.
Helper: %qs1 Records on the legend of the Dragon King%qe  %cc1/%mc1
Process: I can't get rid of the Seadramon because I am too weak... I could not read the records.
Complete: Wow!! These are the records. I will read it and tell you what it says. Wait, Culu!

TitleText: The Legend became reality.. Aqua orb
Body:
Ah.. I see, Culu. The records show that it is a place close to hear, Culu, Culu.

It says the Aqua Orb is near the water, Culu!
It says it is where the penguins are. Hmm... The penguins are to the northwest of here.

And if you find the <The Place Where the Aqua Orb Is at Rest>, use this Detection Stone. The Detection Stone the Aqua Orb will react and the power will transfer to you, Culu!
Simple: Find <The Place Where the Aqua Orb Is at Rest> near where the penguins are and use the Detection Stone.
Helper: Use the Detection Stone at the place where the Aqua Orb rests.
Process: Have the powers of the Aqua Orb transferred to you?
Complete: You have found the Aqua Orb! I saw the powers of the Aqua Orb transfer to you with the light. The legend... Has become reality!!

TitleText: Who will this sword fight for?
Body:
The legend of the Dragon King has become reality! But who should this sword be used for?

What is Yggdrasil's idea of justice, which is trying to use the X-program to purify Digimon World and open a new world?

Or Digimons that are trying to change Digicore themselves and survive?

I do not know the answer... What choice should be made at the Road of the Sword?... I do not know, so talk to Culumon at the Dats Center.
Helper: %qs1%qe Speaking with Calumon at the Dats  %cc1:%mc1
Process: Have you met Culumon at the Dats Center, Culu?
Complete: The road of the sword... I do not know... However, I have a favor. Solve the problem and think about it more.

Body:
You came, Culu!
Death-X-DORUgoramons produced at oil refinery-3 are invading to eat all the remaining Digimons, Culu!!

Go to oil refinery-3 and get rid of the Death-X-DORUgoramons. Collect the 'Spoiled X antibodies' they ate and spoiled, too.

If the spoiled X antibodies are purified, it will be possible to hand out the X antibodies to more Digimons. And then, think about...the Road of the Sword.
Process: Purify spoiled X antibodies so no more Digimons are attacked by the X-program.
Complete: Whew... What a relief, Culu...

Body: This interrupts the plan of Yggdrasil....
Complete: Stop the evolution of Death X!

Body: I do not know if the road you chose is the right one. The evolution of Death X is continuing to interrupt the plan of Yggdrasil. Combining strength with Alphamon... It is a relief for me.
Complete: Do you have your answer? I will not think too hard. Gallantmon and I are different. I hope you do not regret the road you chose...

Body: You have collected 4 types of Death X antibodies, Culu! It is almost over now, Culu. Talk to Omnimon and try to get new power! Save Digital World, Culu!!
Process: Have you talked to Omnimon?
Complete:
This is the last road to Jogress. Did you develop enough strength to get the power of Jogress?? Remember, you need to be at least tamer level 70 to complete the last mission..

If you have enough strength, talk to me.

Body: You have defeated all the Death-X-DORUgoramons, Culu! It is almost over now, Culu. Talk to the Omnimon and try to get new strength! Save Digital World, Culu!!
Process: Have you talked to Omnimon?
Complete:
This is the last road to Jogress. Did you develop enough strength to get the power of Jogress?? Remember, you need to be at least tamer level 70 to complete the last mission..

If you have enough strength, talk to me.
