Body: Welcome to the Digital World. I hope I didn't startle you. As for this place, you will gradually come to know this place piece by piece.
Process: This is the Digital World!
Complete: I'm excited for our adventures together in the Digital World!

Body: It looks like your friend is in danger! This place is not just full of  cute and well-behaved Digimons like me. There are plenty of nasty and intimidating Digimons around here. We gotta be careful!
Process: Hmm?  Whose voice is that?
Complete: A Tsunomon?  Hmm...  Tsunomons are not aggressive.  Maybe they were just playing?  Anyway, your friend is safe now, thanks to my excellent hearing.

Body:
Want to know what this place is? Now that your friend, Izzy, is here, maybe I'll explain it again.

Like I said before, this is the Digital World. This is where Digimons like me live. You were sent here from your world by some strange force.
Process: This is the Digital World!
Complete: Frankly, I don't really know much more about that.  We will find out bit by bit, so don't worry!  I will help you.

Body:
I like flowers. That's why I like this forest. It feels kinda bad to pick them, but... whatever. Of course, I don't pick them to eat them.

Would you bring me some blossoms off of Upamons?
Process: I love flowers!
Complete: What beautiful flowers!

Body:
I would like to tell you more like this world, but I'm starving... Give me something to eat, would you?

I saw Tsunomons carrying something around.
Process: Do you have any food yet?
Complete:
*crunch crunch*
Wow, this is good!  You humans have such delicious things in your world.

Body:
I have a friend who likes flowers like me. Why don't you go and teach those Tsunomons and Upamons a lesson for harassing the flowers?  You can then tell my friend about it.

I'm going to go on a flower picnic with him!  Don't go by the water.  You need to go right from here.
Process: Are you done already?  You need to tell my friend!
Complete: Thank you.  You must be the one Agumon mentioned.  Agumon's friends are my friends.

TitleText: Tell Me More, Tell Me More.
Body: You want to know more about this world, don't you?  Well, let me introduce you to a friend who knows far more than I do.
Process: Go on.  He is a good friend of mine.
Complete: If you want to learn more about this world, you have come to the right Digimon.  I don't mean to brag, but I do know more than Agumon.

Body:
Digital World was a peaceful place.  It's not like we need to eat.  (Agumon likes to eat, though...)

There was no need to fight, you see, even if there were aggressive Digimons among us.
Process: I'm not sure when things changed...
Complete: Something is different these days.  And there are scary-looking black Digimons appearing, too.  When will peace be restored to the Digital world again, I wonder?

Body: I think this is all because of the Black Cogwheels...  I only know what they are called.  I don't know any details.
Process: I hear someone left a record of those Black Cogwheels.
Complete: Well, let's look for the clues together.

Body:
I used to have notes on the Black Cogwheels.

I took brief notes of what the White-bearded Guru told me, but I must have lost them when I was picking some flowers.

We should be able to learn a lot from those notes.

I'm pretty sure the Palmons near the flowers have them. Go get those notes from them.
Process: Did you find them all?
Complete: This should tell us something about the Black Cogwheels.

Body:
Have you seen Koromons on your way back, by any chance?

I want to build a flower garden, but they keep interfering. Would you help me?
Process: Are you finished already?  You are quick!
Complete: Thank you.  I should be able to build my flower garden now!

Body:
I'm sorry to impose, but I'm not giving up on my flower garden!

Bring me some Floral Bines from the Koromons nearby. They do nothing but interfere with my work. Hrmph!
Simple: Find Red Floral Bine to koromon
Process: Do you have the bines?
Complete:
Thank you.  The flower garden will be finished soon!

As long as Koromons don't harass me, I should be able to finish it quickly!

Body:
Pretty stones are a must for a garden!  I saw Tanemons playing with them.  Teach them... not-so-harsh a lesson and bring me the stones, would you?

I will invite the Tanemons to my garden later and cheer them up!
Process: Do you have the pretty stones?
Complete: Thank you!  With your help, I have now finished a pretty flower garden!

Body:
You haven't been explore to the whole area yet, have you?  If you go farther to the right, you will see a high ground.

Talk to the Terriermon there, and he'll show you how to get to the top where you will be able to look down at the whole region.
Process: Go on, then.  Fly away like me!
Complete: There's nothing like the view from the top!  If you have to get to a higher ground, you have come to the right Digimon!

Body:
You are looking for the highest ground around here, you say? Just follow this path up the hill. Before you go, though, can you give me a hand?

I've made a Two-Way Wooded Path, but Kunemons are gnawing away at the trees and ruining the path. I would like you to teach them a lesson.
Process: I need to protect the Two-Way Wooded Path.
Complete: Wow!  Thanks for your help!  Don't take the Two-Way Wooded Path yet.  Wait until the trees grow.  It'll be so pretty!

Body:
There's one thing I forgot.

I need equipment to maintain the forest, you see. But Kunemons have stolen a precious garden trowel from me.

Find the garden trowel those Kunemons stole.
Process: Do you have the trowel yet?
Complete: Thank you.  With this, I should be able to make the wooded path even prettier.

Body: To make the wooded path more... well... wooded, I will have to scatter more seeds. Bring back the Sapling Seeds that Dokunemons stole away for their snacks.
Process: Do you have seeds?
Complete: Thank you.  The wooded path will be so nice!

Body:
You want to take a look around the File Island?

Oh, dear...  I have lost my telescope, you see.

I think I might have lost it where Patamons are not too far from here.
Process: Do you have the telescope?
Complete: You found the telescope.  Now we can look around this place.

Body:
What's wrong with you?  Why are you so out of breath?

Something flew at you and almost hurt you?

It was probably a Kuwagamon. It's a very aggressive Digimon.
I'm scared... *trembles*
Process: Kuwagamon is perhaps the most aggressive Digimon in this region.
Complete: Kuwagamon is scary. *trembles* Be careful not to run into him.

Body:
It know he's a scary one, but go and defeat Kuwagamon (Terror of High Hills) for me. Go up farther from here and you will see him a top the hill.

He is an evil Digimon that ruins the forest and, most importantly, threatens other good Digimons with his own power.

But I can't go. I'm scared of him.
Process: Did you manage to defeat Kuwagamon (Terror of High Hills)?
Complete:
Kuwagamon (Terror of High Hills) fled, you say?

You must be really powerful.  But you'd best be careful from now on.  Kuwagamon will threaten you even more aggressively in the future.

Body:
I bet the reason Kuwagamons have turned violent is the Black Cogwheels. They might have been aggressive in the past, but they never hurt one another. Somewhere along the way, though, everyone began to threaten everyone else.

I'm not even sure what the Black Cogwheels are. If you want to know more about it, talk to Armadimon.
Process: Ask Armadimon about the Black Cogwheels.  I'm not sure whether he knows anything about it, but it's worth a try...
Complete: I'm a smart Digimon!  You can see it in my eyes, you know?

Body:
Why am I here, you ask?  Well, it's a long story...

There is something that you can only see from here...

Curious?
Process: It's something hidden deep inside the forest.
Complete: I miss her...

Body:
I keep my eyes fixed on the Unknown Forest, but Salamon doesn't get it. He keeps hassling me.

He wants me to come down now. Would you ask him for me why he hassles me like that?  If I talk to him, we'll just end up quarreling.
Process: Have you talked with him yet?
Complete: It is no easy task to understand each other.

Body:
In this forest, there is a hidden area called the Unknown Forest.

It's hard to find.  It's even invisible.  But the one place where I can see it is right here.  From time to time, I see the Digimon that I long to see.

That is the happiest moment of my life.  The Digimon I'm talking about is Lillymon.  If you happen to see her, would you give this to her for me?
Process:
The moment is brief but filled with joy.

Please, please get this to her.  It doesn't have to be right away.

The Unknown Forest is quite far from here.  Just keep the note with you until you run into Lillymon.  Then give it to her!
Complete: And who might you be?  You have something Terriermon for me, do you?

Body:
Ah, you must have me Terriermon on the High Tree Hills...

It's not that I don't understand Terriermon.  I'm simply worried that he is so fixated on the Unknown Forest.

We need to protect Terriermon, and he probably doesn't know what's going on.
Process: There is something Terriermon does not realize.
Complete: Please, help me.  I can't do this alone...

Body:
Since Terriermon went up to the hill, Betamons appeared.

I think they want to occupy a hill with a good view and drive out all Digimons who live there.  Please help me and fight the Betamons!
Process: Let's protect Terriermon together!
Complete: It's not over yet, but this gives us some room to breathe...

Body:
Betamons are not the only Digimons targeting the High Tree Hills.

Elecmons also want this hill.  Help me defeat them, too!
Process: Let's protect Terriermon together!  Help me!
Complete: The battle will continue, but we are safe for now.  Thank you.

Body:
I would like to cheer up Terriermon with a gift.

I want to give him a necklace, and I need you to find the material for it.  I want to make it a really pretty one.

Bring me White Necklace Material from Elecmons and Betamons.
Process: Do you have the material?
Complete:
Thank you very much.  This will do nicely.

If you see a necklace you like, please, take one.

Anyway, how long is Terriermon going to be up there?  I hope he comes down soon.

Body:
Oh, where did you get this?  This is a floral bine that I made with Salamon.

Ah, that brings back memories.  I think I might have seen Elecmons carrying White Floral Bines...
Simple: Find White Floral Bine to Elecmon
Process: Thank you for bringing these to me.
Complete: Thanks a lot for bringing these to me.

Body:
Now that you've fought Kuwagamon, you want to become more powerful, do you?  You've come to the right place, then.  Let me tell you about the basic attributes of Digimons.

Basic attributes of Digimons can be largely divided into three categories: Data, Vaccine and Virus.

These three attributes are correlated.  If you understand their relationship to one another, it will help you greatly in your adventure throughout the Digital World.
Process: If you understand the attributes thoroughly, it will help you greatly in your adventure throughout the Digital World.
Complete: Data, virus and vaccine are also the foundations of the Digital World.

Body:
First, let me tell you about the Virus attribute.  Virus is powerful against Data.

Virus penetrates Data and distorts it.  This is commonly called an infection.  Infected Data, that is, Data that have been distorted by Virus don't function properly.  In severe cases, they are even damaged.

Data is weak against Virus.  Go and fight some Data Digimons.  If you pit Virus Digimons against them like I told you, you should be able to defeat them more quickly and with greater ease.
Process: Have you fought Data Digimons yet?
Complete: Wow!  You are a quick learner.  This will help you greatly in your adventure throughout the Digital World.

Body:
Secondly, let me tell you about the Vaccine attribute.  Vaccine is powerful against Virus.

Vaccine finds any Virus hidden in Data, removes it, and fixes the distorted Data.  So, the greatest enemy against a Virus Digimon is a Vaccine Digimon.

To summarize, Virus is weak against Vaccine.  Go and fight some Virus Digimons.  If you pit Vaccine Digimons against them like I told you, you should be able to defeat them more quickly and with greater ease.
Process: Have you fought Virus Digimons yet?
Complete: Wow!  You are a quick learner.  This will help you greatly in your adventure throughout the Digital World.

Body:
Thirdly, let me tell you about the Data attribute.  Data is powerful against Vaccine.

While Vaccine is greatly effective against Data distorted by Virus, Vaccine is powerful in and of itself.  That's why Vaccine Digimons are weak against Data Digimons.

To summarize, Vaccine is weak against Data.  Go and fight some Vaccine Digimons.  If you pit Data Digimons against them like I told you, you should be able to defeat them more quickly and with greater ease.
Process: Have you fought Vaccine Digimons yet?
Complete: Wow!  You are a quick learner.  This will help you greatly in your adventure throughout the Digital World.

Body:
Aside from the three attributes of Data, Virus and Vaccine, there is another, special attribute.  It is the Unknown attribute, marked by "Un".

Digimons with the Unknown attribute are powerful against all three attributes of Data, Virus and Vaccine, because Digimons of these three attributes have no data on Digimons with the Unknown attribute.

Digimons with the Unknown attribute are few and far between.  If you happen to come across a Digimon with the Unknown attribute, it will be a great boon in your adventure in the Digital World.
Process: I hope you come across lots of Digimons of Unknown attribute.
Complete: I have rarely ever seen Digimons with the Unknown attribute.  If you happen to run into one, make sure to talk to him.

Body:
Do you see why you need to become stronger?

Digimons that are influenced by the Black Cogwheels become violent.  So, we need to train ourselves and become much stronger.

Defeat Kiwimons, RedVegiemons and Tentomons.  You will find Heavy Stones on them.  Bring me 15 of them.
Process: Too many, you say?  I don't think you understand the gravity of our situation here with the Black Cogwheels!
Complete: Ah.  It was no easy task but you've done well.

Body:
The Black Cogwheels symbolize the power of darkness.

When one of these stick to or enter a Digimon, the Digimon becomes larger or vicious.
Process: I hope that gives you some general ideas about the Black Cogwheels.  Do you need me to explain anything further?
Complete: There is something more I need to tell you.

Body:
When a Black Cogwheel gets lodged in the body of a Digimon, the Digimon becomes larger and its skills can sometimes mutate.

That is to say, Black Cogwheels are an instrument that twists Digimons to become evil and cruel.  You have to be careful!
Process: So, do you need more training?
Complete: It is important to know about the Black Cogwheels, but becoming stronger is even more important!

Body:
I have a friend who has been attacked by Kuwagamon.

I need to train other adventurers, so I can't leave.

Would you go and check in on Gabumon?  You will find Gabumon half-way between here and the Three-Way Lake.
Process: How is Gabumon doing?
Complete: I'm doing well.  No need to worry!

TitleText: What in the Digital World Happened?
Body:
Kuwagamon has been cutting down the trees in the center of the forest.

Thankfully, I wasn't hurt as Armadimon thought.

If you see him later, tell him I am doing okay.
Process: I'm doing all right.
Complete: I'm doing all right, but there is something I could use your help with.

Body:
I am more worried about Piyomon.

While he was running away from Kuwagamon, he dropped a necklace in the lake.  Since then, he has been staring into the lake all day and doesn't want to leave.

Would you go and check in on him?
Process: How is Piyomon doing?
Complete: Hmm?  What is it?

Body:
With Kuwagamons flying around and creating great winds, the apple seeds that I have been preparing all vanished.

I think Birdramons picked up the seeds.  Please find them.
Process: Have you found the apple seeds?
Complete: Thank you so much!  I put in a lot of effort into preparing these, you know.

Body:
I lost grape seeds along with the apple seeds.

I believe Sabirdramon took them away.  Please find them for me.
Process: Do you have the grape seeds?
Complete: Thank you so much!  I put in a lot of effort into preparing these, you know.

Body:
Oh, Gabumon sent you to check in on me?
I am doing just fine.

A necklace?  Oh, that necklace.

I forgot about that a long time ago.

I found something - someone - more beautiful.  Who is she that is gazing upon me from that lake?

Isn't she beautiful?
Process: Ah, I am so happy...
Complete: She is just so beautiful!

Body:
Who is that beautiful Digimon?

By the way, whenever Seadramons move nearby, the water is disturbed and that beautiful Digimon's visage becomes obscure.

I need to continue to gaze upon her.  Go and drive out the Seadramons.

And tell Gabumon that I am doing well.
Process: Hurry!  Her visage keeps getting obscured!
Complete: Is Piyomon doing okay?

TitleText: Piyomon Is Okay...  In a Sense
Body:
So, he's doing better than we expected, is he?

I will have to go see him myself.

Hmm?  He really seems okay?

Well, then...  I guess I won't have to pay him a visit after all.  Thank you checking in on him.  It makes me feel much better!
Process: I'm glad to know that he's okay.
Complete: He's really doing okay, right?

Body:
Simply gazing upon her will not do.

I will send her a sincere gift to let her know just how much I love her.
Sorry, did you say something?

I can't take my eyes off of her, so you will have to get that gift for me.  Move, move!

You will find Mushroomons in a dark and dank corner not too far from here.  Go!  Quickly!
Process: Are you still here?
Complete: Well done.  Now give me some room and go away, will you?

Body:
You want to defeat Kuwagamons, you say?

It will be difficult on your own.  Go and speak with Cherrymon.  He is known as a guru because he has lived in this forest the longest.

I'm sure he can help.
Process: Have you seen Cherrymon yet?
Complete: Ahem.  I am Cherrymon the Wise.

Body:
You want to know about Kuwagamons, do you?
This place is filled with troublemakers, I see.  Well, let me speak from my fantastic wisdom.

Before you came here, you probably heard a lot about the basic attributes.

If you knew Kuwagamons' attributes and had a Digimon that is powerful against it, it would help you greatly, right?

Kuwagamons' basic attribute is Virus and elemental attribute Darkness.

Now, what do you think you will need to face these attributes?

That's right.  The basic attribute must be Vaccine and elemental attribute Light.

Don't be discouraged because your Digimons don't match those attributes.  If you keep at it, you will be able to defeat Kuwagamons eventually.
Process: Kuwagamons' attributes are Virus and Darkness.  Remember that as you fight.
Complete: Kuwagamons have the Virus and Darkness attributes.  Don't ever forget!

Body:
Defeat Kuwagamon (Raid) and restore peace to Silver Lake.

You can find Kuwagamon (Raid) over the hill where the trees have been cut down.
Process: Kuwagamon (Raid) is strong, but I trust in you!
Complete: Great work!  You are a lot more powerful than you look.  Finally, peace will be restored to Silver Lake.  Woo hoo!

Body:
Hmm...  You want to return home, do you?  I've lived a long time but I've never heard anyone say that before.

Maybe, if you explore the deeper part of the File Island, you just might be able to find a way home.

Oh, wait!  Maybe you should talk to Babamon.  She has lived longer than I have and is wise.  You will find her in the Silent Forest.

To get there, go east from here a little ways and you will be able to teleport there.
Helper: Speak with Babamon in the Silent Forest.
Process: To get to the Silent Forest, go east from here.  When you get there, talk to Babamon.
Complete: Welcome to the Silent Forest.

Body:
Those cursed rocks...

One day, those arrogant stones just began to claim that they are the most powerful and coolest Digimons in the forest.

We will have to teach those pebbles a harsh lesson.

Defeat Gotsumons and Rockmons in the forest and then speak with the captain Rockmon.  I would be dying to see his reaction.
Process: Have you taken care of Gotsumons and Rockmons?
Complete: Who the devil are you?  Why are you wreaking havoc here?

Body:
Oh, is THAT what those trees said?
Those sticks have a big mouth!

You owe us for hurting Gotsumons and Rockmons.  You will need to do something for us.  If you don't listen to us, you are in trouble.

I think it's time that we taught them a lesson of our own.

Defeat Woodmons and Cherrymons and then speak with the captain Cherrymon.  I can just see the expression on his face.  Hehehehe.
Process: Have you taken care of Woodmons and Cherrymons?
Complete: Whose side are you on, anyway?

Body:
Stop fighting?  Our pride and dignity are at stake here.  You can just buzz off.  Hmm?  How long are we going to keep this up?

Who knows?  Be quiet and just begone.

Fighting sometimes brings people together, but now right now.  Those stupid pebbles!
Process: What, are you still here?
Complete:
You still have something to ask about?  I have nothing else to tell you.  Ahem.  To win this battle, we will have to use the Crane Formation.

Listen up, Woodmons!  Team 1 will take the Crane Formation and Team 2 the Snake Formation.

Body:
Unknown Forest?  I have heard of it before, but I don't know any details.

The Digimons who have explored the forest the most extensively are Terriermon, whom you've met already, and Tanemon.

Go and speak with Tanemon.
Process: Have you met with Tanemon yet?
Complete: This forest is truly awe-inspiring.  There are lots of secret places of beauty.  I highly encourage you to explore it all.

Body: Ah, I was hoping you'd come by.  You have something to ask me?  Can I ask you to do something for me first?  DemiMeramons are out to burn up the entire forest.  Take this bucket of water and use it on them to put out the fire.
Process:
Please, hurry.

If you delay, the whole forest will get consumed by fire.

You didn't throw away the bucket of water or anything, did you?  If you don't have it anymore, abandon the quest and try it again.
Complete: Thank you.  I'm glad the forest is intact.

Body:
Unknown Forest?  That place is hidden in the deepest regions of Silver Lake.

Still, it's not that difficult to find it.

I hear that, before someone created a trail, the place was hidden.
Process: Is it that far from here?
Complete: Why are you looking for the Unknown Forest?

Body:
I take my vocation to be the protection of this forest.

The recent increase in the number of vicious Digimons in the area concerns me.

Please help me.
Help me before you leave for the Unknown Forest.

Along with DemiMeramons, Candlemons are also out to set the forest ablaze.  Candlemons sometimes set things on fire by accident because the fire on their heads get onto other things.

Defeat Candlemons and protect this forest.
Process: Are you done already?
Complete: Thank you.  Although there are still many enemies about, the forest will be a little safer.

Body:
We need fences to protect the forest, but I can't leave this place.

But you can help me.  Find some fence material for me, would you?

With the fences up, the forest will be safer.  Bring me the material off of Candlemons and DemiMeramons in the area.
Process: The fences will slow down our enemies, right?
Complete:
Thank you.  You have been very, very helpful.

Oh, no!  Come to think of it, fences can burn down, too.  Well, I guess it's better than trees burning down.

Body:
If you happen to find the Unknown Forest, try planting this White Four-Leaf Clover in the ground.

That will energize the Unknown Forest and make it glitter.  I hope that the entire forest will be energized like that.
Helper: Unknown Forest - Use White Four-Leaf Clover
Process: Have you tried planting the White Four-Leaf Clover?
Complete: Amazing.  Thanks for your help.

Body:
Terriermon?  I didn't know he thought of me in that way.  I would love to leave the Unknown Forest and fly around Silver Lake freely.  But, it's easier said than done.

I have Lillymon friends here that won't let me leave.  I can't even talk to them anymore.

Would you mind intimidating them just a little?  I would like to fly even for a little while during the commotion.
Process: Don't be too harsh with my friends.
Complete: Thank you.  I will take this opportunity and see the outside world even for a little while...

Body:
That boulder at the entrance is one of the reasons why this Unknown Forest is so hidden.

The largest and the strongest of all Lillymons in this area blocked the entrance with that boulder.

She says that she did that to protect the fireflies in the area, but I don't know...

In order for the Unknown Forest to be open to the rest of the world, we must first defeat the Lillymon.

She's strong, so be careful.  If it's too difficult, you can come back later when you are stronger.
Process: Be careful.  It doesn't have to be done right now.
Complete:
Wow!  You are so powerful.  With that Lillymon defeated, I'm sure more Digimons will visit the Unknown Forest now.

... including Terriermon, of course.

Body:
Hmm??  You must have crossed over from the Lost Historic Site. We have lots of dangerous Digimons here.  We haven't had any visitors from the Lost Historic Site to the File Island Waterfront for a while.

Did you have any trouble while you were at the Lost Historic Site?  We have plenty here...  This is all because of Devimons, their underlings and the Black Cogwheels.

There is much you can do to help, Tamer.  But, first, go and speak with Gawappamon.  He will tell you all about the troubles over at the Beach.
Process: Have you spoken with Gawappamon yet?  You should be able to see him from here.
Complete: You have come from the Lost Historic Site, have you?  I suppose danger abounds there as much as here.

Body:
Welcome to the File Island Waterfront. You must have had quite an adventure to get here.

When you hear the word "Waterfront", you may think of rest and leisure, but things are not so comfortable on the File Island Waterfront.

You are looking for a place where you can look at the entire region, you say?

Beyond the beach and the forest, go up the rock mountain.  From there, you can get to the Infinite Mountain, the highest point on this island.
Process: Welcome to the File Island Waterfront!
Complete: The highest point on this island is a rock mountain.  It was once a green forest, though...

TitleText: The Story behind the File Island Waterfront 1
Body:
This is your first time an the File Island Waterfront, so there must be a lot that you want to know.  I'm glad you came when you did. There is a lot you can do to help us.

If you help me, and I will tell you many things about the File Island Waterfront and what you need to watch out for.

Lately, Zudomons have been far too noisy. Drive them out for me, will you?
Process: Did you drive out the Zudomons?
Complete: Ah!  Thanks to you, some peace and quiet.

Body:
The File Island Waterfront was a peaceful place at first.
But, at some point, it turned into a desolate place of strife and territorial rivalry.

This all happened when Monochromon changed. He loved the mountains more than anyone else.  Monochromon changed when that evil Digimon appeared.
Process: He loved the mountains more than anyone else...
Complete: The File Island Waterfront will become gradually more desolate...

Body:
If Monochromon loves the mountains, I love this beach.

But we've been seeing evil Digimons around here, too, and they are defiling the beach!

Lopmon has sent me here to take care of it, but I can't do it alone. Take care of Silphymons and tell Lopmon what's been happening here.
Simple: Defeat 10 Silphymons and speak with Lopmon.
Process: Look at this fine sand on this beach.
Complete: Thank you.  I am going to protect this beach to my dying breath.

Body:
We need you to stop the rift on the File Island Waterfront.  The File Island Waterfront is made up of the beach, the forest and the rock mountain.  Although, that rock mountain wasn't so rocky to begin with...

Visit Lopmon. He'll be able to tell you more about the File Island Waterfront.
Process: Have you spoken to Lopmon yet?
Complete: Thank you.  We need to do something about the File Island Waterfront!

Body:
Who goes there?!

Oh, Gawappamon sent you?  I'm sorry for the yelling.

I'm rather edgy what with all the evil Digimons on the beach lately.
Process: You are not a bad person, are you?
Complete: The beach used to be a really beautiful place...

TitleText: The Story behind the File Island Waterfront 2
Body:
As I said before, there are more and more Digimons who seek to destroy the File Island Waterfront.

When the situation on the beach is stable, we'll talk more. Remove Rapidmons for me.
Process: Did you take care of Rapidmons?
Complete: Thanks.  This really helps.

Body:
It's not just Rapidmons that are out to destroy the beach.  I need you to take care of Arcadimons (Ultimate), too.

What's with all these Digimons out to ruin the beach?
Process: Sorry about dumping all these requests on you.  But I need your help.  I can't do it alone.
Complete: Thank you so much.  I can just feel the beach getting better already!

Body:
There used to be lots of pretty pebbles around here. You couldn't find those on the beach, so we used to get them as gifts from the mountains.

But, since Rapidmons and Arcadimons appeared on the beach, those pebbles just vanished.

Defeat Rapidmons and Arcadimons.  Recover the Lost Pebbles for us.
Process: Do you have them?
Complete: Thank you.  These make the beach so much more beautiful, you know!

Body:
Since *that* Digimon appeared on the File Island Waterfront, Monochromon began to become vicious.

Monochromon used to love the mountains and the trees.  Yet, when the Black Cogwheels got stuck on him, he started to demolish the mountains and the trees that he spend all his life building with his friends.
Process: He used to love the forest more than anyone else...
Complete: Will you go to the mountains and help Monochromon?  Just remove the Black Cogwheels, and he'll come back to his old self.

Body:
We are waiting for the 'Children of the Rumor'.

I've only heard Gatomon mention it briefly. Talk to him for more details, but I know this one thing:

The Children of the Rumor are on our side.
Process: Have a chat with Gatomon.
Complete: The Children of the Rumor, huh?

Body:
What in the Digital World is that Digimon?

That rectangular Digimon over there!  Do you know who he is?  Pay... phone?  That's not a Digimon?  Oh, I see.  What's that for?

It said something to me, so I approached it.  But then it just repeated itself over and over again.

Oh, and I found this round thing while I was playing in this area. Do I need this?

Examine that strange contraption, and then tell Gatomon your findings.  Gatomon and I are very, very curious about that piece of machinery.
Helper: Examine Payphone and speak with Gatomon
Process: Coins?  Phones?  You humans use strange words.
Complete: Hmm...  Things didn't quite work out as you'd hoped, did they?  You know, Palmon is the smartest Digimon on the Waterfront.  Speak with him and he may tell you something important.

Body:
You want to know about the Children of the Rumor?  Well, I would be happy to tell you more about them.  But, first, you have probably seen how desperate we are on the beach.  You spoke with Gawappamon and Lopmon, right?

If we take care of business around these parts, the beach should be stabilized somewhat.

Help me defeat the Digimons on the beach.  Those are evil Digimons that ruin the beach.
Process: Did you take care of them?
Complete: Thank you.  But we still have a long way to go...

Body:
You defeated MegaSeadramon?

You must be really powerful, Tamer.  But, here, we have something more fearful - Arachnemons. They look the part, too.  Will you defeat them for me?
Process: Did you take care of them?
Complete: Thank you.  I hope this gets all settled soon.

Body:
On this side of the beach, MegaSeadramons crawl around.

In order to discover their weakness, we need two kinds of scale, MegaSeadramon scale.  Could you get some for me?

Some MegaSeadramon scale is also venomous.  They are all very useful for the research.

Find me those two types of scale.  It will be no easy task.  Good luck!
Process: Do you have it?
Complete: Thank you.  I will do my best to drive out the MegaSeadramons!

Body:
So, you have heard about the Children of the Rumor, have you?  Yes, there is a rumor that is going around in the Digital World.

The rumor speaks of the Chosen Children from another world who will come in our darkest hour to rescue the Digital World.

We don't know when this will be.  All we can do is wait for their arrival.
Process: When will they come, I wonder?
Complete: We await their arrival.

Body:
I am told that the Chosen Children have the power to evolve Digimons.

Apparently, you can evolve Digimons beyond the Ultimate stage by using a certain crest and necklace.
Process: Are you the Chosen Children?
Complete: Seeing that you have suddenly crossed over into the Digital World from another world, it is likely that you are a 'Chosen Child'.

Body:
There was a time when nasty Digimons called Giromons (Forest Destroyer) went on cutting down the trees in the forest indiscriminately.

They carried electric saws, you see.

This angered Monochromon.  He fought the Giromons (Forest Destroyer) and eventually defeated them, but he, too, sustained grave wounds.

Those Giromons remained quiet for a while, but...

Now that Monochromon has changed, they are here again, mowing down the trees.  Will you stop them for us?

They are powerful.  Be careful out there!
Process: They are so vicious that I can't even get close...  Those fearsome eyes and the horns...  They are scary...
Complete:
Thank you so much.  You are keeping the forest safe.  You are successful where we have failed.

Who cares if you are not a 'Chosen Child'?!

Body:
It is probably best for you to go to the rock mountain yourself.  From there, you will be able to view the entire File Island.

While you're at it, tell my friend, Hawkmon, the good of news of Giromons defeated.
Process: Have you met with Hawkmon?
Complete: I've heard a lot about you.  From here, you can get to the rock mountain.

Body:
What?  You defeated Giromons (Forest Destroyer)? You must be really powerful.

As you can see, we have problems of our own here. Cherubimons (Good) and Cherubimons are blocking the way. Defeat them and open the way to the mountain.

Once you do that, speak with Greymon and he will tell you about the mountain.
Simple: Defeat Cherubimons (Good) and Cherubimons and speak with Greymon.
Process: The way to the mountain is full of danger.
Complete: So, how do you like the rock mountain?

Body:
So, Gatomon thinks you are the Children of the Rumor?

Hmm...  He could be right.  But, then, he could be wrong.  I'm not sure.

But, if you all have something in common in relation to the Digital World, it's possible that you really are the Chosen Children.

I don't mean whether you all went to the same school.  We need something more than that.  By the way, I remember seeing a diary written in a language that is not from the Digital World.

I have a feeling that this diary will be very helpful to you, if you can read it.

Cherubimons (Good) in the area must have it.  I couldn't take it from them - I'm not that strong.  But you should be able to.
Simple: Retrieve File Island Waterfront Diary from Cherubimons and Cherubimons (Good).
Process: Have you found the diary?
Complete: Hmm...  As expected...  I can't read this, so you try it.

Body:
It's you.  I knew you would come here...

You are all witnesses to the incident on the Hill of Light..

All of you also met Digimons four years ago.  Yes.  You are the 8th Chosen Children.

The Digimon that helped you back then was Greymon.  That's me.
Process: Good to see you.  You seem rather familiar...
Complete: That you are all here means that the time is nigh when we will put an end to this chaos.

Body:
The incident on the Hill of Light, the Chosen Children, the Black Cogwheels...  Has it "clicked" yet?

To put an end to all of this, you have no choice but to face Devimon.

You must defeat Devimon in order for you to become unnecessary beings in this world.  That is to say, you can return home.
Process: Are you starting to understand why you are in the Digital World now?
Complete: Now, prepare yourselves to go up to the Infinite Mountain.

Body: Devimon has many underlings we need to take care of, still.  Defeat SkullSatamons and CyberDramons to weaken Devimon's influence.
Process: Have you defeated the underlings?
Complete: Thank you.  Your showdown with Devimon is approaching.

Body:
Devimon is the greatest threat to the File Island right now.

But the Waterfront is also fraught with problems.  As you probably saw along the way, Monochromon is causing lots of trouble here.

I would like you to help me remove the Black Cogwheels from Monochromon.

But, first, this area is filled with Devimon's underlings because this area leads up to the Infinite Mountain.  Slay his underlings for me.
Process: Have you defeated the underlings?
Complete: Thank you.  With this, Devimon's influence will gradually shrink.

Body:
Devimon's underlings carry a special mark.

This mark has the image of Devimon's horn. The rumor has it that this amplifies their evil powers.

Bring me these marks and I will examine them.  I will reverse the process to weaken Devimon's power.  That will help you greatly as you fight his underlings in the future.
Process: Have you found the Black Marks of Devimon?
Complete: Well done, Tamer.  I will put them to good use.

Body:
You will find Devimon in the Infinite Mountain Dungeon on the Infinite Mountain through the gate next to me. Please, slay him and restore peace to the File Island.

You have other things you must do in the meantime, like removing Black Cogwheels from Monochromon.

You need to do this for us.  Ask Resolute Leomon about how to get to Monochromon.  Follow this path up a little farther and you will find Resolute Leomon.
Process: Have you met with Leomon?
Complete: You are doing many good things for the File Island Waterfront, Tamer.

Body:
I will help you in your fight against Monochromon.  In exchange, why don't you help me restore this desolate mountain?

PileVolcamons are interrupting our restoration work on the mountain.  Defeat them.
Process: Have you defeated them yet?
Complete: Great work, Tamer.  PileVolcamons were hard to deal with because of their rocky body.

Body:
I haven't given up hope of speaking with Monochromon yet.  I want to see him return to his old, kind self.

But he is not willing to talk.  Is there really no other way but to use force?  The root of this problem lies in the Black Cogwheels on him, so the best way to go about this is to pull them out.

Pull out the Black Cogwheels off of Monochromon and help the File Island Waterfront return to its former glory!
Process: Did you remove the Black Cogwheels off of Monochromon?
Complete:
Thank you.  Thank you so much.  You really removed the Black Cogwheels off of Monochromon.

The File Island Waterfront will be restored now.  With Monochromon's love for the mountains and the forest, I am sure we can make the Waterfront even more beautifu

Body:
There is nothing like White Feathers for bedding!

Crowmon's feather is especially comfortable.  Sand doesn't even come close!

I'm going to make a clean and soft bed.  Will you gather the feathers for me?

If you do that, I will let you lie down on the bed for a little while.
Process: Crowmons can be mean to us, but... their feathers are good!
Complete:
Great!  I'm going to make bedding for my friends who are fighting throughout this region.

No more fatigue!

Body:
Before Devimon showed up, Black Feathers were a symbol of good fortune on the File Island Waterfront.

I hear that you can sometimes find Black Feathers off of Waspmons and CannonBeemons.

They are mechanical, and yet they carry Black Feathers for good luck.  Isn't that kinda ridiculous?

Find those Black Feathers for me, would you?  I'm sure good fortune will come to you, too, for finding them.
Process: Did you find Black Feathers?  I'll let you keep one, if you'd like.
Complete: Thank you.  I bid you excellent fortune in the future, Tamer!

Body:
Since Monochromon's change, strange Digimons began to rage out of nowhere.

I would like to go drive them out, but they look... rather scary.  Would you go beat up those CannonBeemons for me?
Process: Have you defeated them?
Complete: Yowza!  You did it!  Thank you so much!

Body:
When will Monochromon come back to his old self, I wonder?

Now that you have defeated CannonBeemons, could you also beat up Waspmons?
Process: Have you driven out Waspmons?
Complete: Ah, this area will be a little safer thanks to you.

Body:
I hear that the forest is not the only place crowded with Digimons.  The beach and the rock mountain are both crowded, too.

Lots of things are happening here.  Drive out Crowmons for me.
When will peace be restored to the File Island Waterfront?
Process: I miss the peaceful Waterfront.
Complete: Thank you.  Thank you so much.  I couldn't have done this on my own.

Body:
Where did those mechanical Digimons come from?  They don't really fit in here in the forest.

They are pesky, for sure, but it's not all bad!  I've been building a vehicle that will fly over the peak of the rock mountain.

Will you collect some Waspmon Wings for the vehicle?  It'll be so exciting to fly to the sky over the shiny sand on that beach!
Process: Have you found all the wings?  Please, help me with my research.
Complete: Thank you.  If I just analyze this mechanical part, I'm sure I can discover something.

Body:
I should be able to make the wings for the contraption with the CannonBeemon wings.  As with any research, I need some material to extract data from it.

Will you defeat CannonBeemons and bring me their wings?  If I just have those wings, I should be able to finish the 'vehicle'.
Process: Do you have them?
Complete:
Thank you.  When it's done, I will let you take a ride on it.  Hehe.

Hopefully, those bees won't attack me during my research.

Body:
There many fabulous female Digimons.  I would LOVE to declare my love to them, but...!

I, the SuperStarmon of Love, am way too good for them.  I can't give in first.  Hmm?  You think I'm just afraid of rejection?  No, no, no!  Never!  They do look rather strong and somewhat vicious, but that's not why!

*Ahem* Let that Lillymon know of my love, would you?  Those beautiful colors...  Ah, how beautiful you are, Lillymon!
Simple: Target Lillymon and use the Red Heart from the inventory.
Process: So?  How did it go?
Complete: What?  Lillymon almost beat you up for it?  How dare she!  Hmph!  She was just an ugly Digimon to begin with, anyway.  This is unforgivable!

Body:
Why would I want to fall in love with someone nasty like Lillymon when QueenChessmon is so full of grace and elegance?  The beautiful copper-tone skin and the contrast of the golden outfit.  Ah, how beautiful you are!

What?  You think I change my mind too quickly?  Sh... shut up!  Just... just tell QueenChessmon how much I love her!

Heh.  The moment she lays her eyes on my sunglasses and the charming, star-shaped face, QueenChessmon won't be able to help falling in love with me.

You should be honored to be the messenger of my love.  Hahahaha!
Simple: Target QueenChessmon and use the Red Heart from the inventory.
Process: So, how did it go?
Complete: What?  QueenChessmon actually managed to beat you up?  How badly???  This... this is preposterous!

Body:
It's all over for me...  Hmm?  You think I'm giving up too easily after only two tries?  Wh... what would YOU know?!

What?  How about LadyDevimon, you say?

.....................................................

You know, LadyDevimon is just too....  Ah, forget it.  It's all over for me.
Process: It's all over for me...
Complete: This can never be!  How dare they mock my love?  They will regret this!

Body:
Teach them a lesson!  A nasty, harsh lesson!  Teach them the consequence of rejecting my love!!!

Why should you do this?  Well, you played the messenger, didn't you?  You gotta finish what you started.  It doesn't make sense, you say?  Shut up!

Now that it has come to this, you are just as responsible for my emotional suffering.  You need to make me feel better.  What?  You don't want to...?

....................................

Please, help me.  I'm not strong enough to do this.  Please!

Hmm?  Really?  You will help me?  Thank you, thank you, thank you!  First, teach QueenChessmon and Lillymon a lesson.  They rejected my love.
Process: This will make them realize what they have done..
Complete: Thank you.  Thank you.  This makes me feel a little better.

Body:
LadyDevimon needs to learn a lesson, too.

What?  You didn't deliver my message of love to her?  It doesn't matter!  They are all the same! Teach that LadyDevimon a lesson, too!
Process: They think they've got it all just because they're pretty.
Complete:
Ah, this makes me feel much better.  Thank you.  Maybe... maybe I can love again.

Hmm?  You think I need to make up my mind, do ya?  Shush!  I'm not going down that easy.

TitleText: A Heart of Love Part Deux
Body:
The Red Hearts of Love that you delivered to QueenChessmon and Lillymon should have turned black.  I... need to restore them.  This is rather different, you say?  Of course!  My love is unique!  Yup!

Anywho...

Bring me the Black Hearts.  I will need to make them red again.
Simple: Retrieve Black Hearts of Deep Love from QueenChessmon and Lillymon.
Process: Come back to life, my heart of burning love!
Complete: Thank you.  My love begins once again!

Body:
To be frank, the reason I avoided LadyDevimon is because... well... she stole my Red Hearts.

She has too many Red Hearts.  If I'm not careful, she may get too clingy to me.  That's a frightening prospect.

Why am I so cowardly all of a sudden, you ask?  You don't know how fearsome LadyDevimon is, do you?  Those red eyes...  Just the thought of them chills my bones.

To squelch her interest in me, we need to retrieve those hearts.  Please, help me!  This is the most important thing!
Process:
(Quietly...)
Did you find them all?
Complete:
Thank you.  Hopefully, LadyDevimon won't be so interested in me anymore.  I'm going to go find someone else to love.  Good luck to you, too.

If you keep trying, you will be able to live a life so full of passion.  Just like mine!

Body:
I'm sure you've learned a lot of attributes by now.

Now, there is one last type of attribute I need to teach you about.

This time, you're going to learn about the relationship between four attributes of Light, Darkness, Steel and Electricity.
Process: How are you doing with elemental attributes?
Complete: Knowing about the elemental attributes will help you great as you journey through the Digital World!

Body:
The first elemental relationship you will learn is Light against Darkness.

Light is powerful against Darkness.  What makes the night retreat is the bright ray of the sun.

Go and fight some LadyDevimons in the area.  They have the Darkness attribute.

If you pit a Light Digimon against them like I told you, you will be able to defeat them more quickly and with greater ease.
Process: Have you fought against LadyDevimons, the Darkness Digimons?
Complete: Wow!  You are a quick learner.  This will help you greatly in your adventure throughout the Digital World.

Body:
The third elemental relationship you will learn is Electricity against Steel.

Electricity is powerful against Steel.  Even the most powerful steel in the world that can destroy anything is nothing more than a conductor against electricity.

Go and fight some QueenChessmons in the area.  They have the Steel attribute.

If you pit an Electricity Digimon against them like I told you, you will be able to defeat them more quickly and with greater ease.
Process: Have you fought against QueenChessmons, the Steel Digimons?
Complete: Wow!  You are a quick learner.  This will help you greatly in your adventure throughout the Digital World.

Body:
The fourth elemental relationship you will learn is Steel against Light.

Steel is powerful against Light.  All that light can be against steel is to be reflected.  It can't do anything to it.  A well-crafted steel sword can cut light.

Go and fight some Cherubimons (Good) in the area.  They have the Light attribute.

If you pit a Steel Digimon against them like I told you, you will be able to defeat them more quickly and with greater ease.
Process: Have you fought against Cherubimons (White), the Light Digimons?
Complete: Wow!  You are a quick learner.  This will help you greatly in your adventure throughout the Digital World.

Ugh, this is way too hot!  You are a strong one to brave this hot weather, kid!
Do you want to know why it's so hot here?

Hurry!  Go and find out why Meramons are raging!
Process: Is this your first time in the Unknown Forest?
Complete: You did it!

Over here...  Keep your footsteps light!  If she finds us, we are done for...

Get that treasure for me, will you?
Simple: Find Treasure of Hope Forest from meramon

Complete: Thank you.  I'm going to win some brownie points from Babamon.  Hehe.

Ogremon...  Ogremon...

The reasons that Meramons, Goblimons, Sharmamons and Soulmon have been enraged is all because of Ogremons.

*ring ring* Ah, you're here!  At the southernmost edges of the Silent Forest, there is a small beach.  There are Digimons that protect the area, but go fight them and bring me some water you will need in this container.

Yes, yes, yes.  Well done.
A comrade of mine is patrolling Battle Forest to the southeast.
Tell him about our situation here and see how he's doing over there.
Process: Haven't you found Leomon yet?  He is patrolling Battle Forest.

Yes, yes, yes.  Well done.
We have real Black Cogwheels from Ogremons.
We will have use for them later, so keep them safe.

I will write a letter.  Take it to the Leomon who's on a patrol duty to the southeast.

Helper: Speak with Leomon at Battle Forest

Yes.  I am Leomon.  I'm patrolling these woods.
Monzaemons are wreaking havoc, blocking the way to the Ruins.
If we don't suppress them, we have no access to the Ruins.

Go and suppress those Monzaemons!
Process: Are you afraid?

The path is opening up.
The way to the Ruins is opening up!

Body:
Yes, I really AM Leomon.  Quick clicking me, already!
Now, a new chapter is beginning.  Onward to the Ruins!
When you get to the Ruins, check out the Fruit Forest.
Someone will be welcoming you with arms wide open.

Complete:
Welcome to the Ruins - where you can encounter the living history of the Digital World.
I would like to throw you a big welcome party, but we have trouble brewing here.
You probably know this already, but I think what they call 'Black Cogwheels' are cau

Go to the Silent forest and defeat Meramon (Raid) the Lord of Fire!

Until then, peace will not be restored to the Silent Forest.
Process: Meramon (Raid) is incredibly powerful, isn't he?
Complete: Excellent work!

Body: Slay Ogremon (Raid).  He is scheming something at the Ogremon Hideout.  Slay him and I will give you a gift!
Process: Are you done yet?

Great work.  This will come in handy someday...
Keep it safe until then.

Body:
It's hot...
I can't pass through here.  It's too hot with Meramons around.
Create a pathway for me, would you?  Pretty please?
Process: I said get rid of those fiery Meramons!
Complete:
Thank you ever so much!
Gotsumon!  Hey, Gotsumon!!
Where are you?!

Body:
I am looking for a friend of mine.
A while ago, there was an earthquake on the File Island.
The ground split, separating me and my friend, Gotsumon.

I haven't been able to find him since.
Could you find my friend for me?
If you do find him, give him this letter.  He will know that I am well.
Process: Gotsumon...  I hope he's okay.
Complete: He looks... rather familiar.

Body:
Let's see..
Gotsumon...  Ah!  I think I saw him north of here.

It looks like Sharmamons have taken over the pathway, though.
Anyway, my guess is that Gotsumon is near the Shadow Forest to the north.
Simple: Speak with Gotsumon in Dark Shadow Forest
Process: No luck finding him yet?

I can't leave the Black Shadow Forest because Sharmamons and Goblimons are blocking the way.
Get rid of them so I can get out of here.
Process: Are you afraid of them, too?
Complete:
Wow, thank you!
Shall we leave this place, then?

Body:
I'm doing well.
I was investigating the strange energy in the Silent Forest.
I plan on heading over to the Ogremon Hideout.
Now, would you do me a favor and give this letter to my friend, Pumpkinmon?

Let's look around near the Ogremon Hideout.

Ah-ha!

Body:
Yes.  Since he gained power with the Black Cogwheels, Monochromon has been gathering evil friends.

One of them is Argomon (Ultimate).  He's more of an underling than a friend, though.

We're almost there.  Please, finish strong as we strive to restore peace to the File Island Waterfront.
Process: Did you slay them?
Complete: Hmm...  You just might be able to take on Monochromon...

Body:
There is another Digimon that is ruining this place - GrandisKuwagamons...

Only a select few GrandKuwagamons can evolve into them.  I'm not sure how they came to take on such a form, though.

No matter.  They are enemies right now.  Slay them and let's work to undo Devimon's evil schemes.
Process: They are not that easy to take on, are they?
Complete: You are very powerful.  I guess they weren't kidding when they said that you took care of problems on the beach and the forest.

Body:
You probably heard about the Mark of Devimon from Greymon on the way here.

The Digimons close to the cliff here on the rock mountain carry the White Mark of Devimon.  I hear it is more powerful than the black counterpart.

You can't hope to prevail against Devimon without any preparation.  You need to analyze him thoroughly before you take him on.

If you come across the White Mark of Devimon on <Argomons (Ultimate)>, <PileVolcamons> and <GrandisKuwagamons>, will you bring it to me?
Process: Do you have the White Mark of Devimon?
Complete: So, these are the marks.  The showdown is not too far away.

Body:
How are you enjoying your travels on the File Island Waterfront?  This is a beautiful place, but we've been having lots of problems lately.

The File Island Waterfront used to be a place where White Five-Leaf Clovers grew.

Do you have White Five-Leaf Clovers where you are from, Tamer?

When the evil Digimons arrived here, they began to pick the clovers one by one.

As you fight the Digimons on the Waterfront, you will find <White Five-Leaf Clovers>.  They are rare, though.

Collect them and bring them to me.  I will give you my cherished <Green Clover of Luck>.
Process: Did you find any White Five-Leaf Clovers?
Complete: Wow.  It's been so long since I last saw one.  You can turn them in again and again, so feel free to stop by anytime!

Body:
This place is called the <Scattered Memory>.

I don't know the details, but, from what I know, Monochromon fought Devimon on top of that cliff over there.  There, he was brainwashed with the Black Cogwheels.

Monochromon resisted as hard as he could.

In that chaos, Monochromon fell to the bottom of the cliff.

When he fell, he became unconscious and eventually succumbed to the Black Cogwheel.

...............................................

Since then, Leomon who lives at the top of the rock mountain has turned this place into training grounds.

He hopes to use this place to recover the scattered memory.

Use these Shining Pebble at the <Scattered Memory>.  Three Monochromons will appear.

They will each have different health and attack power.  Defeat them all and return to me.  I will give you a big gift.

If you want to join the training, you will need <White Five-Leaf Clovers>.

Monochromons that appear here are very powerful.  You will need the help of other Tamers.
Simple: Turn in 5 <White Five-Leaf Clover> for a <Shining Pebble - Monochromon>.
Process: Did you take care of them?  If it's too much on your own, be sure to bring other Tamers with you.
Complete:
Wow.  You are so powerful!  I didn't think you would actually make it.

Continue your training, Tamer, and protect the peace on the File Island.

You can keep training, but you can only receive the rewards once a day.  You can receive the reward through t

Body:
I trust that you've heard about this place?

The fight against Monochromons will be difficult, but don't give up!

You can receive the rewards from the fight only once a day.

Of course, you can find a variety of precious items on the Monochromons themselves.

It will be a very difficult fight on your own, so be sure to bring friends with you.

---------------------------
Now, let me tell you how to enter the fight.

Use a <Shining Pebble - Monochromon> at the 'Scattered Memory' and three Monochromons will appear.

Top 15 Tamers will receive 'Green', 'Red', and 'White' Four-Leaf Clovers when you defeat them.

Bring me the mark of the fight, Three-Leaf Clovers, and I will give you the promised reward.

Each Monochromon will give you clovers of different colors depending on his name.

Sharp Horn - Green Four-Leaf Clover
Thick Tail - Red Four-Leaf Clover
Giant Paw - White Four-Leaf Clover

You have to collect all three.  Good luck!

Body:
Around the Giromon (Forest Destroyer), you will find the smaller Giromons (Dismantler).

Giromons (Dismantler) have dismantled the small wooden houses nearby.

They should have the remains on them.  Will you find them for me?  We have a rather talented Palmon around here.  He might be able to do something with it.

There are three types of remains - <Cloth Fragments>, <Wooden Pieces> and <Broken Bolts>.  Bring them to me.
Simple: Collect Cloth Fragments, Wooden Pieces and Broken Bolts from Giromons (Defuser).

Complete: Ah, the remains...  I am grateful and yet... sad.  I will bring these to Palmon.  I look forward to seeing you again.

Body:
Thank you for the material you gathered.

I'm not sure what he is creating exactly, but I think Palmon is making something that will cheer up all the Digimons who are depressed around here.

But Giromons (Dismantler) may appear at any time to destroy it.  Will you go take care of those Giromons (Dismantler) and protect Palmon's plans?
Process: Palmon is working really hard on whatever it is he is making.
Complete: Wow!  With this, Palmon should be able to carry on with his research in peace.  Thank you so much!  Whenever it is done, I will be sure to invite you to come and see it!  Thanks again!

Body:
Read the diary.  And Greymon is waiting for you on top of that boulder over there.

-----------------------------------
xx, xx, xxxx / Weather: clear / Place: File Island Waterfront

I get it now.  I think I saw that Digimon when I saw the light.  We were drawn to the light and came to this place.  We had an amazing adventure.

Those eyes were piercing yet kind.  That Digimon, he protected us then and he is protecting us now.

I'm not looking forward to leaving my friends that I made here.  I will never be able to forget them.  When I return home, is it at all possible to take my friends with me?

...  How did the 'Chosen Ones' who came before me deal with this?
------------------------------------

We meet again...
...............

I missed you.

Body:
Shh!  Careful!

*looks around*

Okay, I think we are clear.

I saw him.  I saw the Phantomon standing there on the Waterfront and then just vanishing.

You see him ever so seldom, but I definitely saw him.

He'll vanish one moment, and then just appear again the next.

If you happen to come across Phantomons, be careful.
If you see them, please drive them out.  They are making other Digimons nervous.

Also, tell me later how often you see one, and how many of them there are on the Waterfront.

Shh!  Careful!
Process: Have you seen a Phantomon?
Complete:
Hmm...  So, you are saying there there are about three Phantomons in total on the File Island Waterfront, and one appears every hour or so, right?

Where do they appear?
..........
..........

The place of their appearance is the most important thing!

..

Body:
My heart pounds...
And the world is a beautiful place once again.
Love has come to life again at last.
The moment I laid my eyes on her, I knew it.
Wait...  Where are you going?  Hear me out.  Don't you think it's rude to just take off without asking who it is or what makes her so charming?
It is none other than her royal majesty, the QueenChessmon (Royal).  Is she different from the other QueenChessmons?  Of course!  Listen.
The aura that gently rises from the bottom.
The way she doesn't even cast a glance on the Cherubimons surrounding her.
And the sheer size - she could embrace the entire world!
She is my life! But she is too difficult to approach...  Call it a royal charm.  But I have a plan.  Go and beat her up just a little bit.  When she's feeling down, I will come and comfort her.
That is your assignment!  Go and be my Cupid.  Don't go too hard on her.  But keep her pride intact - get beaten up every now and then.  If you leave a scar, though, you are a dead human, ya hear me?!
Process: Ah!  My love begins again!
Complete: Great work!  You didn't leave a scar anywhere, did you?  All right.  It's my turn now.  Fantastic job, my friend.  I hope love finds you soon, too!

Body:
...

Thank you.

I can't thank you enough.

I won't say much.

Defeat Devimon.

Keep this 'Monochromon's Mark'.  You will need it when you enter the Infinite Mountain Dungeon.
Process: Go now.
Complete:
Devimon is powerful.  You will need to be prepared.

You have come across many enemies on your travels.  Silver Lake, the Silent Forest, Lost Historic Site, the Waterfront...

But Devimon is more powerful than any of them.  But don't lose your courage.  K

Body:
I haven't given up hope of speaking with Monochromon yet.  I want to see him return to his old, kind self.

But he is not willing to talk.  Is there really no other way but to use force?  The root of this problem lies in the Black Cogwheels on him, so the best way to go about this is to pull them out.

Pull out the Black Cogwheels off of Monochromon and help the File Island Waterfront return to its former glory!
Process: Did you remove the Black Cogwheels off of Monochromon?
Complete:
Thank you.  Thank you so much.  You really removed the Black Cogwheels off of Monochromon.

The File Island Waterfront will be restored now.  With Monochromon's love for the mountains and the forest, I am sure we can make the Waterfront even more beautifu

If you need more of them, bring me @<tc:900>100 <Energy of Thunder God> which you can find from the monsters of <Digimon Maze>@</tc>.
Once you do that, I'll exchange extra pass for those materials.

Keep up the good work then!
Process: Let's go to Qinglongmon and get this problem solved!
Complete: What else could we do now?

Body:
Qinglongmon may have been watching us from the first trial we've went through.
This may be a chance…! Qinglongmon should be aware of your faith and courage!
There was a request from Qinglongmon for you to visit him, so would you like to pay a visit?
Simple:

Defeat Antylamon
Defeat Mihiramon
Defeat Majiramon
Defeat Qinglongmon

Qinglongmon told me that he was impressed with your skills.
He also said that he has confirmed your faith and courage, so he could rely on you for the peace of Digital World and Real World!! This is such a good news..!
You're truly worth becoming a hero!

Body:

If you think you need more of them, bring me @<tc:900>50 <Energy of Steel> which you can find from the monsters of <Server Continent Desert> or <Server Continent Canyon>@</tc>.
If you do that, I'll exchange them to an extra pass.

Keep up the good work then!
Process: I hope Baihumon can help us soon.
Complete: What else is there for us to help?

Body:
The second elemental relationship you will learn is Darkness against Electricity.

Darkness is powerful against Electricity.  Inside the emptiness of darkness, there is nothing electricity can do.

Go and fight some SkullSatamons in the area.  They have the Electricity attribute.

If you pit a Darkness Digimon against them like I told you, you will be able to defeat them more quickly and with greater ease.
Simple: Defeat nearby SkullSatamons, the Electricity Digimons.
Process: Have you fought against SkullSatamons, the Electricity Digimons?

Body:
So you want to hear about the story?
Hear me out, this is what happened.
There's a place which resembles village of the beginning, but of another dimension over a wall of fire.
By investigating that place, I came to conclusion that Apocalymon is behind.
I couldn't stop the path from opening, but fortunately I managed to relocate the fire wall before Apocalymon arrive.
However, now there is another problem.
Apocalymon's mind has been embodied, went through the fire wall, splited in to pieces and scattered all over that place, blocking me from approaching.
I'm upset that I can't continue by investigation, but I think this is my dead end, so I'll just stop it and report to DATS Center.
Since you've helped me so far, I'll give you this teleporter.
But I want you to be extremely careful with it.
Process:
Even though Apocalymon couldn't get through, his mind has created evil beings that got in and they're quite horrifying!
I've managed to arrange the fire wall to stop Apocalymon himself, so you don't have to worry about him though.
Complete:
I really don't recommend you to go there, since I know how danger the place is.
I don't want to put someone who helped me into great risk!
And there are still lots of other cases to investigate!
Expert:
Even though Apocalymon couldn't get through, his mind has created evil beings that got in and they're quite horrifying!
I've managed to arrange the fire wall to stop Apocalymon himself, so you don't have to worry about him though.

TitleText: [Repeat] Something that will bring my attention
Body:
I'm Omegamon of the Royal Knights. What made you come to me?
I apologize if you just came here for a chat.
But if you have a purpose, you don't have to hide it from me.
Process: Do you have something to show me?
Complete:
What's this? It seems like some kind of virus data, but I haven't seen this type yet.
Can you bring me more of these, tamer?
If you do, I'll reward you this emblem.

Body:
Hehehe. Can you say hello to my good old pals for me?
Please say hello to them and tell them I'm fine.
Simple:
Wind Valley Jijimon
Silent Forest Jijimon
Lost Historic Jijimon
Helper:
%qs1Talk to Jijimon%qe  %cc1/%mc1
%qs2Talk to Jijimon%qe  %cc2/%mc2
%qs3Talk to Jijimon%qe  %cc3/%mc3
Process: Do you remember all the locations?
Complete:
Great, I guess you've done very well on delivering my message to them.
Take this gift as my appreciation.
Expert:
Oh, you've came a long way to say hello.
How impressive!
I'm doing just fine, and please say hi to him too.

Body:
Valentine's Day is getting very close…
But I haven't finished making all the chocolates I need.
Can you help me with preparing the ingredients? If you do, I'll give you some of the already made chocolates!
Process: I just need cacao and milk, don't worry about the others.
Complete:
Thanks for getting me the ingredients!
Look! Here's the completed chocolate.
I hope you like it.

Body:
Greetings! Are you planning for a hopeful new year today?
If you do, what about trying some fireworks?
It is believed that fireworks can bring you a great fortune for the whole year.
I can give you these for free now and some more when you visit again tomorrow~!
Process: Don't you get curious of how the fireworks will look like?
Complete: Don't forget to come by again tomorrow and take the fireworks!!
Expert: Don't you get curious of how the fireworks will look like?

Body:
You seem to be questioning why is it so freezing cold than usual?
The temperature has dropped down because Yukidarumon has taken away the Red Flower of Warmth.
It's the only thing to keep us warm in winter, so it must be returned.
If you happen to find Yukidarumon, please take the flower back for us.
Process: This flower is like a bonfire.
Complete:
Finally, we have the Red Flower of Warmth again.
This flower will fade away the coldness.
Thank you!

TitleText: [Daily] Challenge against the Lord of Pride
Body:
I think it's time for your next challenge.
The next opponent will be the Lord of Pride, Paradise of Loss, Lucemon.
It should be your last opponent among the Seven Great Demon Lords.
The true aspects of Lucemon is Lucemon Falldown Mode.
If you succeed on defeating his first form, I'll give you the challenge scroll.
Process: Consider this mission as your training.
Complete:
Good. I'll give you the challenge scroll.
When you wish to see stronger Lucemon Falldown Mode, go to Digitamamon and exchange it for higher level challenge scroll.

TitleText: [Daily] Challenge against the Lord of Envy
Body:
Welcome back, tamer. I've been expecting you.
This time, your opponent will be the lord of envy, also known as the Abyss of Despair among the Seven Great Demon Lords.
Syakomons are the minions of Leviamon.
When you succeed on defeating them, I'll give you the challenge scroll.
Process: Syakomon is in form of a giant clam, so it won't be so difficult to spot them.
Complete:
Good. I'll give you the challenge scroll.
When you wish to see stronger Leviamon, go to Digitamamon and exchange it for higher level challenge scroll.

Body:
I can sense that suspicious beings have appeared..
It doesn't feel like they are that powerful, however, I'm suspecting that this is somewhat foreshadowing our jeopardized future.
Then all we can do is completely eradicate the origin of all possible harms.
Take care of those Bakemons of the Real World, Chimeramons of Western areas, Yukidarumons of Glacier areas and Devimons of File Island areas right now.
According to the reports, they appear to roam around in random places of the stated areas, so don't forget to search for them yourself before you can start doing whatever you must do.
Simple:
Defeat 'Bakemon', Real World
Defeat 'Chimeramon', Western
Defeat 'Yukidarumon', Glacier
Defeat 'Devimon', File Island
Process: Did you successfully handle all of them?
Complete:
These guys seem like they appear every single day, so it looks like I might have to call you up again.
Take this certificate for now.

Body:
Ah, that ugly looking Digimon again? I don't really feel like looking his face anymore culu~
By the way, not only his looks are bizarre, but he may be able to mentally evolute in an unordinary way.
Process: What? I don't feel like telling you an advice now, culu!
Complete: Haha, still hanging around with that worthless looking Digimon?
Expert:
Are you asking me about evoultion? Never! I’m not going to tell you culu~!
This Digimon will turn into a terrifying creature when he evolves!

Body:
Did you say that Chimairamon can evolute into a total different form?
That's an interesting story.

Chimairamon is a creation of various data mixture, so fusing with another Digimon's soul should be possible.

So why don't you do a favor on researching the Digimon's soul?
Bakemon in the graveyard of Silent Forest should be a good subject.
Process:
Why don't you make yourself useful?
Bakemons won't donate their data to you by themselves, so you know what to do now, don't you?
Complete:
I can see that its rebirth is near…
You've done well… for your level.

TitleText: Collecting Enormous and Evil Mind Data
Body:
Huh… I've already tried with injecting Bakemon's data, but the result wasn't so satisfying, because that Digimon is weak!

Which means it requires data from a larger and more psychic subject.

How about Monodramon wandering in the Silent Forest?
Collect Monodramon's Mind Data and bring it to me.
I think the result will be more interesting this time.
Process: Go and collect some data. What's so difficult about that?
Complete:
Good. It's getting more closer now…
Impressive!

Body:
Ha! So you were… still remaining here?
Injecting the mind data to Chimairamon succeeded this time and it created an enormous psychic Digimon.

But unfortunately, this worthless creature did not obey to me and left this place!!
It seem to be heading Distorted Data Village, but a creature who cannot obey to its master is still worthless!
Process:
Digimon who does not obey to its master? How worthless!
I don't really care about worthless beings!
Complete: I've sensed energy of great evil from the direction of Distorted Data Village. It disappeared soon though.

Body: What? You're telling me that the creature that appeared in Distorted Data Village was a substantiation of Millenniumon?
Process: MoonMillenniumon is known to be extremely dangerous, so you should better watch out!
Complete: Ah, I'm not sure if this is the right thing I'm doing…
Expert:
I was expecting from the beginning that it will turn out be MoonMillenniumon after the evolution from that weird psychic Digimon...
Looks like I cannot stop it, culu!
So I'll tell you about the evolution, culu!

Body: Are you still hanging around with that evil Digimon? I can't understand… culu!
Process: No, I'm not going to tell you how he evolutes, culu!
Complete:
The Digimon beside you…
It can be reborn into an enormous Digimon by an extraordinary method.
Expert:
It's unusual that you're out of trouble with that Digimon.
Are you asking me about his new method of evolution?
I don't think I'm going to tell you that, culu!

Body:
The Digimon beside you…
It can be reborn into an enormous Digimon by an extraordinary method.

So, you should be eager to discover that method by now?

If you want to figure it out, you should collect some more information to complete this evolution.

Cerberumon from the Digimon Maze Enterance has the key to this information, so go and get it!
Process: I'd be more careful if I were you. Not to be driven to hell if that's the case… (chuckles)
Complete: Good! That'll be enough of Cerberumon's Data.

Body:
Hahaha… finally, the invisible psychic data will complete this experiment. It is certain that Cherubimon (evil) possess this data.

Go and extract psychic data from Cherubimon (evil), as much as you can!
Process:
I'm sure that Cherubimon (evil) has the required data.
Any better ideas? If not, you should be listening to me.
Complete:
Hahaha… that's very nice… and satisfying indeed…
Fusing the psychic data of Cherubimon (evil) and that Digimon will make a very interesting result! Haha…

Body:
Oh my gosh!! Did I just made a mistake? Unbelievable!
Wha... What are you still doing here? I thougth you were leaving.

Are you asking what I'm doing now? I'm glad you asked.
The numeric value of result made by Digimon and mind data fusion was much greater than I first expected.

However, that result has already gone to Distorted Data Village.
Process:
It's gone to Distorted Data Village. Isn't that enough information for you?
You're on your own now!
Complete:
Gees! So you've done it… that creature…
What? You defeated him already, culu?

Body: What? You're telling me that the creature that appeared in Distorted Data Village was a substantiation of Millenniumon?
Process: MoonMillenniumon is known to be extremely dangerous, so you should better watch out!
Complete: Ah, I'm not sure if this is the right thing I'm doing…
Expert:
I was expecting from the beginning that it will turn out be MoonMillenniumon after the evolution from that weird psychic Digimon...
Looks like I cannot stop it, culu!
So I'll tell you about the evolution, culu!
