Process: Let's go to Qinglongmon and get this problem solved!
Complete: What else could we do now?

Body: This is the map that can guide you to the Shadow Labyrinth. I can give you 2 of them a day. It will be vanished whether you use it or not, so make your decisions quick.
Process: Be prepared.
Complete: The evil energy is known to be strong enough to destroy the balance of Real World.

Body:
We have a serious situation here.
Fanglongmon has been sealed and isolated underground in the Descending Thunder God area.
We sence a wave of force flowing out of that place and it seems to be growing.
I hope it's not too late.
Process: Fanglongmon must have broke free from the seal.
Complete:
With the help of Four Holy Beasts, Fanglongmon is no more angry now.
He said he will not interfere now, giving us a chance.
Thanks. And you've done a great job of getting over all the trials. You're truly a hero after all!

Body:
You'll need the pass to go through the boundaries of Fanglongmon. I can give you only 2 of them per day.

If you need more, bring me @<tc:900>100 Yin and Yang Spirits from monsters of <Verdandi Terminal>@</tc>.
Once you do that, I'll make you extra passes.

Do your best and never give up!
Process: We must stop Fanglongmon's fury.
Complete: Is there anything else we could do?

Body:
I'll give you @<tc:900>3 Scar of Water Crystal [Hard] pass cards a day.@</tc>
Please use it to protect the Real World.

This place is overwhelmed by the powers of Xuanwumon.
For protection, you'll need @<tc:900>30 Scar Essence from monsters of <Ice Area>@</tc>.
Bring them to me
Process: I believe in you!!
Complete: Cheer up. Nobody can finish it except you.

Body:
I can give you @<tc:900>3 Passes [Uprising Flame] [Hard] a day@</tc>.
Please help us save the Real World.

This place is overwhelmed by power of Zhuqiaomon who became much stronger than before.
You'll need protection, so bring me @<tc:900>30 Pieces [Uprising Flame] that can be found from monsters of <File Island>@</tc> area.
Process: I rely on you!
Complete: Great! You'll be able to get in there now. Be safe!

Body:
I'll give you @<tc:900>3 passes for Trace of Black Steel [Hard] a day@</tc>. 
Please use them to protect the Real World.

This place became overwhelmed by Baihumon's massive power and it is much stronger than before.
Please bring me @<tc:900>30 Energy of Steel which can be found from monsters in <Server Continent> area@</tc> and I'll make you a proper protection.
Process: I have faith in you!
Complete: Here are the passes. Take care.

Body:
I can give you @<tc:900>3 Passes [Descending Thunder God] [Hard]@</tc> a day. Please use it for the purpose of saving the Real World.

The place is overwhelmed by Qinglongmon's power, so you'll need a proper protection when you get in there.
Please bring me @<tc:900>30 <Energy of Thunder God> which you cand find from the monsters of <Digimon Maze>@</tc>, and I'll make you the protection.
Process: I have faith in you!!
Complete: Here you have it now. Take good care of yourself.

Body:
You'll need the pass to go through the boundaries of Fanglongmon. I can give you only 2 of them per day.

If you need more, bring me @<tc:900>50 Yin and Yang Spirits from monsters of <Verdandi Terminal>@</tc>.
Once you do that, I'll make you extra passes.

Do your best and never give up!
Process: We must stop Fanglongmon's fury.
Complete: Is there anything else we could do?

Body:
It's been a while for you to be here, since your last mission. Anyway, now I want you to investigate a place. It's about a new area we recently discovered.
Agent Miki has been sent there earlier, but she told us that the wild Digimons there are too tough to deal with alone. This is why I'm asking you to continue the investigation.
Further instructions will be delivered by Digivice.
Process: Unfortunately, there's not much information about the new area yet. You'll be able to reach Verdandi Terminal from the D-Terminal.
Complete: Who... could you be?

Body:
It's good to see you again here, as I was needing some serious backup. The wild Digimons in this place are too strong, so I couldn't make any progress.
We should find a safe zone, to send research data to DATS Center without any mistake.
First, please defeat Leomons in the path, so we can move on.
Process: Did you face Leomons? They seemed to be insane.
Complete: Good…! You're the most reliable member of DATS.

Body: Both of them needs treatment. Dorumon doesn't seem to be injured badly, but stressed out. So please calm him down first, and cure him with the first-aid kit. I'll take care of Leomon.
Process: It's not me who needs healing. Talk to Dorumon.
Complete: What is it?
Expert: Oh… no…

Body:
Are you a companion of the human who healed me?
I appreciate your help, but you don't have to worry about me now. Please take care of Dorumon first.
Process: (Suddenly, he stopped breathing.)
Complete: I have a bad feeling about this…
Expert: Looks like he just drew his last breath.

Body:
I've heard about overall circumstances of the area from agent Miki.
The Dorumon which you're protecting now will be very helpful in our investigation.
So keep it away from danger surrounding you, and defeat any hostile Digimons that can become a threat.
Process: Are you strong enough to resist and continue the mission?
Complete:
Wow! You came back safely! I was worried.
Commander always assign difficult duties!
Expert: How was the place nearby?

Body:
I can see that there are many incidents happening in this area. We have a lot of information to research.
This place seems quite dangerous so we should be more careful when moving.
Can you talk to Dorumon and see if there's anything we should be aware of?
Complete: I don't know much about this place.
Expert:
This place? I really don't know. I don't even remember how I got here.
All I know is that the Digimons here tries to steal each other's core and survive.
I don't know what exactly they are after, but some of them were chasing and attacking me.

Body:
Seems like he's not a native of this place!
Then I guess we should patrol the place ourselves. I'll take Dorumon with me to a safer place. Please continue the investigation meanwhile.
Simple:
Take picture Leomon
Attach Transmitter to Leomon
Take picture Kunemon
Attach Transmitter to Kunemon
Helper:
%qs1Take picture Leomon(Insane)%qe  %cc1/%mc1
%qs2Attach Mini Transmitter to Leomon(Insane)%qe  %cc2/%mc2
%qs3Take picture Kunemon(Evolved)%qe  %cc3/%mc3
%qs4Attach Mini Transmitter to Kunemon(Evolved)%qe  %cc4/%mc4
Process: Do not hesitate! We don't have much time.
Complete: Good job!
Expert: Well done~!

Body:
I think this is very strange. Leomons here seems to be much stronger than we know.
Leomon is a Champion form Digimon, but Leomon's in this place are strong and fights like a Mega form Digimon.
It needs more research!
Take this scanner with you and use it on any one of them.
Take them down when necessary.
Simple:
Defeat Leomon(Insane)
Use Digimon Scanner to Leomon(Insane)
Process: I know you're working hard. Just keep it up!
Complete: Information sending is successfully completed. Great!

Body: The headquarters is analysing the research data sent through the scanner, but there seems to be not much progress yet. If we send more data, it should be helpful.
Simple:
Defeat Leomon(Insane)
Use Digimon Scanner to Leomon(Insane)
Process: This is a Commander's request, so it must be something important.
Complete: Finally!! Good job as always~!

Body:
I've been searching all over the area but this whole place is packed with danger!
So I decided to change my mind. Let's clear a spot.
Can you take care of Leomons and Kunemons nearby?
When you drive some of them out here, this spot will become a safe zone.
Process: I don't think I'll get used to this place!
Complete: Thank you~!

Body:
Nooooo!! It's still not over yet! I wonder where these guys are coming from, regardless of how many we've driven them out.
It's really getting into my nerves!
Please keep these Leomons and Kunemons out of this area.
Process: I really hope to see the end of this madness!
Complete: Oh… yeah this should be good enough for now. Even though they may return again soon. Thanks!

Body:
Dorumon was here but he disappeared all of a sudden!
He's not fully recovered from the injury, so I'm worried.
He was attacked before I met him, and this place is too dangerous for a Digimon to run around alone!
Please help me find him! Please search the forest, while I search the other side.
Simple: Enter to Forest of Jungle Law
Process: Damn it, where did he go to?
Complete: Stop it! Quit it!

Body:
Have you found Dorumon?
What? He's being harassed by Mushmons?
Oh my god! You don't have to ask me what to do!
Just go help the poor guy!
Process: Don't ask me, just go!
Complete: Is it you?
Expert: I can't take this anymore!!

Body:
Why are the Mushroomons being such nuisance?
It's quite annoying!

Anyway, first thing's first!
Please tell me when you find somewhere we can take rest.
Process: Hmm… I couldn't find it… have you?
Complete:
Great… that place is also dangerous as I thought!
But it's same here, so we should keep moving!

Body:
Good News!
I found a spot we can stay safe for a while!
Can you bring Dorumon with you?

Just be careful on the way!
Process: Don't forget to check your current location!
Complete: Good! You've made it!

Body:
I've done nothing harm to others, but all these guys here are hostile against me.
It's really painful to resist.

Is there a way out?
Process: Sorry, but please leave me alone for a while.
Complete: All right, if you insist… I'll think about it.

Body:
Mushroomons here are much stronger than I used to know… It is really a mystery…

I think we should also investigate on them. How?
Just like we did with Leomon!

I know it's a hard work for you, but please do me a favor.
Thanks again!
Simple:
Defeat Mushroomon(Violent)
Use Digimon Scanner to Leomon(Insane)
Process: This is getting really weird… First, it was Leomon, and now Mushroomon looks the same…
Complete:
Excellent~! Now shall we start the analysis?
Don't worry, I'll handle this!

Body:
As I was expecting, DATS Center requested me for more data.

So I think I should ask you for favor again.
The data we need is from the Mushroomons.
Simple:
Defeat Mushroomon(Violent)
Use Digimon Scanner to Leomon(Insane)
Process: You're doing great so far! Keep it up!
Complete: Great! I just sent the recent data and received a positive feedback from the headquarters! Thanks to you!

Body:
Data research is successfully completed as planned!
So we can take some rest now.
What? Are you asking me some more things to do?

Oh well… then how about a duty of bringing justice?
Do you remember the Mushroomons that were harassing Dorumon?
Use this condiment to teach them a lesson.
Simple:
Use Strange Condiment to Mushroomon(Ill-tempered)
Defeat Mushroomon(Ill-tempered)
Process: How would the harassers feel when they are harassed themselves?
Complete: Have you seen the expressions on their faces? I feel much better now.

Body: There was a contact from the headquarters.
Complete: Hmm… what should I do? I was told that they're mutants.
Expert: I've heard from the headquarters of the research results. The Digicore is larger than normal and it means the Leomons here are not the Leomon we know, but mutants. Some kind of an unknown antibody is included in the core, which makes it larger than normal

Body:
Information we can get from scanning isn't much enough.
So we should find some alternatives.

I think we should start collecting datas directly.

Please collect data from the Digimons in this forest regardless of their type!
Process: This place is really weird… but let's bring peace here together!
Complete: Done already?

Body:
There was another request from the headquarters.
They are asking us again for more research data.
I wonder why they don't ask us for correct amount at the first time (sighs).

Anyway, duty is duty, so let's get it done fast.
Process: Have you collected the fragments enough already? Wow!
Complete: You're the best agent indeed, just as Mary told me. Great job!

Body:
Since we've become used to this place, I think we should expand our research area.
I'll be moving with Dorumon, so meanwhile, you can go ahead and patrol by your own pace.
By any chance if you meet any human or Digimon possible to communicate, get all the information you can!
Simple:
Enter to Waterfalls and forest
Talk to ???
Process: Look for the big waterfall ahead. It should be easy to find.
Complete: Huh?? Who could you be?
Expert: Wait! Stop right there!

Body:
I asked who you are first, and you are asking who am I? You're truly a weird human.
I'm WarGreymon X, leader of Resistance, a group of wanderers in Verdandi Terminal.
Process: I told you who I am. Now, it's your turn to introduce yourself.
Complete:
Is that so? You've came long way just to investigate this place?
All right, I get it now.
Expert: Please keep some distance, human!

Body:
This entire place is Verdandi Terminal. It's part of New Digital World that got ruined by X-Program. We have came so far escaping from the effect of X-Program, but still struggling to survive. Recently, there are some evil Digimons who are loitering and attacking younger generations that come from the Digital World, so we were having a hard time. Can you give me a hand on this?
Kuwagamon will appear when you attack Kunemons.
Process: I'm asking you a favor, human. You look strong enough to do this.
Complete: Thank you!! You've done it really fast! I can trust you now!

Body:
Hello, human friend! If you have some time, can I ask you for another favor?
I know you helped me last time, but there are still those evil Digimons doing the same thing!
Please show them no mercy!
Process: You're doing good job so far! Please continue to save the innoncent Digimons!
Complete: I appreciate your effort!! Your abilities are very impressive!

TitleText: The Land of Jungle Law, Verdandi Terminal
Body:
I guess you need some explanation of this place.
This whole place Verdandi Terminal, is cursed by X-Program that spread to entire New Digital World by Yggdrasil.
Only chosen Digimons could survive this hell-like place, but we Resistance are a group of unchosen Digimons who survived from this hell.
All of us Resistance members are very desperate to survive, and still having a hard time. Will you listen to me for more stories?
Complete: I have one more favor to ask you.

Body:
As I told you, we're group of Digimons that immigrated from Digital World. So we're unwelcomed guests in this world. This is why the chosen ones are aggressive against us, and try to get rid of us. What's worse is that, the Royal Knights is with the chosen ones and they're causing a lot of damage, even deaths.
So we're trying to negotiate with the chosen ones recently. It'd be much better if you can help us with it. If we fail to negotiate, we may have to fight the Royal Knights. To be honest, we're risking our lives here.
Complete: You have no hesitation on my request! I greatly appreciate it!

Body:
I really feel confident as you've become our reliable ally!
However, the rest of my group don't seem to trust you. Regardless of my explanation, they still aren't changing.
So I've thought of you earning their trust right away. It may be a tough task, but I'm certain that it's effective.
There is GranKuwagamon in this forest, that appears in this forest. If you beat him and return, all of us must gain faith in you!
GranKuwagamon will appear when you attack Kunemon, Kuwagamon, and Okuwamon in the forest.
Simple:
Defeat Grandkuwagamon
Collect Grandis kuwagamon's Horn
Process: I know it's a very tough task. But at least I have faith in you that you can succeed!
Complete: I was totally right about this! You're truly astonishing!

Body:
Thank you! As you've proven yourself by bringing evidence showing your strength, everyone of us has expressed their trust on you and agreed to assign you as our representitive.

Now, it's time for us to go and negotiate with the chosen Digimons. We may find peace if it succeeds, but we should also consider fighting them when it fails.

We don't know what will happen, so get prepared.
I'll lead you to the place.
Simple: Enter to Hidden forest between cliffs
Process: You'll get to find the area in the way. I'll meet you there.
Complete: Are you ready?

Body:
When we arrive at the meeting place, there may be a lot of risks, and even chance to have difficulties on moving. So get prepared as much as you can before you leave.
If you wish, you can go up ahead and check the situation first. I and the rest of Resistance will be there as all of us are completely ready.
If you're ready, talk to me and tell me to send you to the meeting place.
Complete: Welcome. Are you ready to join us with the meeting?
Expert: Oh! There they are.

Body:
We arrived here as planned, but the situation is not good.

The chosen Digimons don't seem to wanting to listen to us, but only getting in position to fight us. I guess we have no other choices than to fight back.

Let's show them that we can resist.
Simple:
Defeat Apemon
Defeat Blossomon
Defeat Andromon
Process: Let's get this over quickly.
Complete: I wonder if they change their mind now.

Body: Now, shall we start the real negotiation with their real representatives?
Process: Let's see how they would react.
Complete: Is there no way to persuade them?
Expert:
You're totally under a delusion. We have no intension to coexist with you, nor let you stay in this place!
Because you're just a bunch of intruders that trespass our territory and broke the peace!

Get out of here! We have no intention to negotiate with y

Body:
Oh… so this is what happens now!
Andromon declared war against us. This place is dangerous now!

Royal Knights will be here in any minute!
Please buy us some time, so our members who cannot fight will escape.
Process: Damn… the Royal Knights should be coming!
Complete: Here! Get yourself to somewhere safe! I'll take care of the Royal Knights now.

Body:
Did you leave the place? We're having combat nearby, so please take off at once.

I'll send you the coordinates, so please come! Hurry!
Complete: Great job!

Body:
Oh… that's what happened so far?
WarGreymon X, not only different from the looks but is much stronger than WarGreymon that we know of.

I could see that he can face Omegamon evenly!
What is this place and how could this happen?
A Mega form Digimon fighting a Jogress Digimon doesn't seem to make sence at all...
Anyway, this isn't the issue now.

Dorumon was looking for you. He said that he has something important to discuss.
Process: Keep going!
Complete: I have something to ask you.
Expert: Are you ok? You didn't hurt yourself?

Body:
I've made a friend through WarGreymon X.
This friend has relied on me much, and is pretty young.
By the time I first met him, was seriously injured.

I expect that he should be recovered by now, but I'm still curious of his current status!
Process: I hope my friend is fine.
Complete: How about you?
Expert: Oh, you must be the human WarGreymon X was talking about. You look strong as he told me.

Body:
WarGreymon X is safe. Tell him not to worry.
The reason why he's not showing up is because he's still taking rest in the secret base.

By the way, I have something to ask you.
As WarGreymon being injured badly and due to his vacancy, the tasks he's been doing were left out.

So if you don't mind, can you help with the tasks, before WarGreymon X is fully recovered?
Process: I know it's not easy, but I beg you!
Complete: Thanks a lot! You're really strong as WarGreymon X told me.

Body:
If you don't mind, there's a little more of unfinished duties.
There are more ferocious Digimons in another area.
Process: I look forward for your success!
Complete: Great! You're truly magnificent!

Body:
These ferocious Digimons never stop appearing.

Can I ask you once more to keep them out?
Good luck!
Process: I wonder when this will end.
Complete: You're always awesome! Thank you!

Body: Ah, WarGreymon X isn't in a very good condition yet. Even though he's one of the strongest member of Resistance, he's not invincible. That also proves how much strong Royal Knights are. Anyway, we need more treatment for WarGreymon X to fully recover, but we ran out of cure, so it became impossible. Hopefully, I'm aware of the materials to make new cure. So can you help us by collecting them?
Simple:
Collect Crude Remedy
Collect Empty Capsule
Process: Have you collected all the materials for the cure?
Complete: I guess this is enough to make a cure. Thank you!

Body:
Not only we need cure for WarGreymon X, but we also need cure for the rest of the members.
We usually are hiding ourselves in the base, so cure run out easily.
Can you help us making new cures for our members? I'd greatly appreciate it if you can continue to help us.
Simple:
Collect Crude Remedy
Collect Empty Capsule
Process: Did you get all the materials?
Complete: Wow! You've got the materials so fast. I can't even imagine the situation without you now.

Body:
I really don't understand why is this miserable incidents keep happening!!
Dorumon is not returning, and I'm sure something has happened. He went out to play with a child by request from WarGreymon X while ago, but there's no sign of him until now.
Please search Dorumon for us! I've heard that Omegamon is loitering the areas nearby. He'll be in deep trouble if he gets to face Omegamon in his path! Please find him and return to Historic Site immediately!
Complete: You've finally arrived. Now, let's take off!
Expert: Owww… This whole thing is giving me a headache!

Body:
First, we should find Dorumon as soon as we can!
It will take too much time for just two of us to do this, so we need to call Resistance for reinforcements!!
Process: Where could he be?
Complete: What are you talking about?
Expert: What is it? What has happened?

Body: Me and my friends here will continue to patrol and find Dorumon all seperately. So if you happen to find Dorumon, please use this to give us a signal!
Simple: Use Flare Gun in Desperate Struggle
Process: Don't forget to signal when you find him!
Complete: What is wrong with you? We didn't harm anyone!!
Expert: Stop!!

Body:
Did you really find him? I'll send a message to WarGreymon X about this, so hold on!
Let's make sure Dorumon is safe and settled down.
He even challenges Omegamon when he's gone mad.

Let's get Dorumon into a safer spot!
Complete: Run away? Can that be possible?
Expert: We just don't want to die, that's all!

Body:
Good! We've just arrived!!
Let's get together to fight back the arrogant Royal Knights!
Process: Gees!! He's too much strong!!
Complete: What is this?

Body: MetalGarurumon X is dead!?
Complete: You must be…?
Expert: This doesn't make any sence!!

TitleText: Project Arc, Real Intention of Yggdrasil
Body:
It's been a while, but can you allow me a moment for me to say farewell to my old friend?

Thank you.
Complete:
Leave this place to me and you guys escape.
I'll remain here to save the diginity of my old friend and have a rough conversations with the one who's responsible for all this. Don't worry about me and just focus on escaping at this moment.
Expert: It's good to have you safe.

Body:
Let's retreat as Gallantmon suggested.
Power of Royal Knights is tremendous as we first expected.
Even though we joined our forces together, we couldn't stand this battle…

After retrating, we should take some rest and healing.

Meanwhile, you can return to where you're from.
We'll be at our secret base.
Complete: We had a hard time. Let's take some rest now.
Expert: Welcome. You've worked hard for us.

Body:
We thought this place is safe, but it actually wasn't.
This area is known to be Omegamon's active territory.
Right now, we can't face Omegamon directly, so to clear us an escape route, we need to clean up the surroundings!
Please take care of the Digimons around this area!
Process: Have you found anything significant?
Complete: I hope this will make us safer.

Body:
The conclusion made from the headquarters is to support the Resistance.
As we help them, they can help us to continue our investigation. And also, they are not hostile against us like the other chosen ones such as Royal Knights.

Go and ask WarGreymon X to see if he and his members have made a decision.
Process: I've kept in touch with Resistance while you were away, so it'll be easy for you to ask.
Complete: I agree with some of your opinions.
Expert: You've came.

Body:
I think this is an obvious result, but we Resistance are very positive on cooperating with your group of force.

However, I'd like to ask you for a favor as allies.
As MetalGarurumon X has been killed in battle, Resistance force became weaker than before.
So I want you to help us until we regain our full force.

First, please get rid of the Digimons nearby, that becoming threat to us Resistance.
Process: I'm aware that this is a troublesome task. But you're the only hope for us now.
Complete: I won't have to regret making allies with you humans.

Body:
You helped us clear the surroundings so we can have an escape route.
But somehow the ferocious Digimons have brought their reinforcements and the place became occupied again.
So I have to ask you this favor again.

Please clear us a path, like you did before~!
Process: I wonder what's making them so strong.
Complete: This area became a little more safe! So it should help us proceed our investigation!

Body:
It would be grateful if you can help us a little more.
It seems like death of MetalGarurumon X is a great loss in our force. It is not easy for Resistance to regain his vacance.

Please help us like youj've done before.
Process: I feel sorry to ask you for something difficult everytime.
Complete: Thanks to you that it became much easier for our members to secure our borders!

Body: Since we've became allies now, I think I should inform you about the X-Antibody, which evolved us.
Complete: I can say that the evolution is found from the will to survive. We call it X-Evolution.

Body:
Dorugamon has been kidnapped by Magnamon!

I don't know for what purpose Dorugamon is kidnapped, but first thing's first!
Use the tracking device from the location where Magnamon has vanished and we may get a clue!
Process: Please let me know as soon as you find any clue!
Complete: For what has Magnamon taken away Dorugamon with him?
Expert: What is this?

Body:
Good! You found the trace, so let's continue using the tracker from a distance now! I hope Dorugamon is safe.

I hope we can find a clue to track down Magnamon.
Simple: Use Tracker in Exterior Site Ruins
Process: So this is what Royal Knights have done?
Complete: What a pity!

Body:
What a shame! We were really close!
We've almost reached the objective, but it wasn't successful.

How about getting help from the Resistance?
Process: I could use some help, definitely.
Complete: That's it. That's how it was done.
Expert: How is tracking Magnamon?

Body:
I'm sorry to hear that you've lost tracking Magnamon.
We Resistance, will help you with the search.
Since this place is very wide and risky, it may take some time.

While we search this area, I think it's good for you to search other areas.
Process: How's the search going?
Complete: I see. He's already heading to Royal Base.

Body:
I found a signal from the Tracker.
Even though I don't know if this is Magnamon or something else, I assume that we need to investigate.

Please go to the location and check what's there!
Process: Have you found the location?
Complete: Are you the human who's after him?
Expert: How about you?

Body:
Dorugamon is unconscious, but he's not hurt. I'm just taking care of him to fully recover consciousness.

By the way, we could use some hand now. Can you help us?
We are members of Resistance and we're finding stuffs we could use.
I'll give you a shovel, so you can find anything useful buried in the grounds.
Process: Hmm… The place is messy, so it won't be easy to find stuffs.
Complete:
Oh, you've returned sooner than I expected.
But there was nothing useful?
Maybe it's because of them…

Body:
Hmm… To keep us safe from the Royal Knights, we need various items.
Of course we're short of these things now… and always was.

I've thought of the reason why this place became so empty is probably because of the Datamons and Dracmons around. Go and see if they have any stuffs in their pockets!
Process: Just make a few good hits on them, and you'll see if they drop some stuffs or not.
Complete: Great! These stuffs will be helpful.

Body:
I really appreciate your help last time.
Anyway, we still need more stuffs.

I might keep asking you for help, for a price of course.
Are you willing to help?
Process: I know it's not a easy job. I really appreciate your help.
Complete: Thank you. This will help us to protect ourselves from Royal Knights.

Body:
Roachmons are showing up in this area recently, and this means the ferocious Digimons here are becoming threat because of X-Antibody, or willing to survive.

As you see, this area is an essential place to find things we need, so we should get rid of the trouble makers.
If you don't mind, can you help us with this?
Process: I hope the Dumpsite doesn't get messed up by them.
Complete: I can't thank you enough. You've saved our day.

Body:
I've found the trouble makers making trouble again in the Dumpsite.

Can you kick them out like you did before?
Process: They are such a pain in the butt.
Complete:
Thanks, but this thing may happen again tomorrow.
Will be you able to continue helping us?

Body:
Today's target quantity has been filled up.
So I'll be able to distribute all the items to my friends.

By the way, your friend Dorugamon has not awaken yet, so I'm trying to take him to our headquarters.
I'll send you the coordinates of our base, so you can stop by later.
Process: We will carry Dorugamon safe and sound, so don't worry about your friend.
Complete: Come in. It's much safer inside.
Expert: Good to see you. Wizardmon has told about you before.

Body:
Welcome to the headquarters of Resistance.
Wizardmon told me that your friend Dorugamon is not in such a good condition.
But unforunately, we do not have enough medication to cure him.

Recently, Dracmons are loitering around our base and constantly stealing our supplies.
I bet they also have the Digimon Cure.
Process: We'll take good care of your friend until you get the cure.
Complete: Oh! I think this is more than enough.

Body:
We have enough medication to heal your friend Dorugamon now. He'll be fully restored in no time.
Meanwhile, you can visit Wizardmon.
I've heard that he's looking for you.
Process:
Wizardmon is in the place you first met.
Don't worry about your friend Dorugamon.
Complete: You should be the human WarGreymon X was talking about.
Expert: You've came.

Body:
WarGreymon X told me that you helped him too, just like you helped me before.
We Resistance owe you a great debt.

However, there is a situation. It's about Dorugamon.
Complete: This is the current situation.
Expert:
Because Dorugamon came from another place, our companions seem to put a distance against him.
Even though I told them that he's not a member of Royal Knights, some of us seem to be afraid of him.

Body:
I know that you won't like this situation.
I really appreciate your help. But to make all the members understand is not very easy.
So I've thought of a way of solving the problem.

Recently, a group of DexDoruGreymons is confronting us and being a threat to our members.
If you can chase away from our sight, our members should gain more trust in you and not be afraid of your friend Dorugamon anymore.
Process: Meanwhile, I'll make the members to calm down.
Complete:
Excellent!
As you've driven out DexDoruGreymons, our members seem to be relieved.

Body:
Regardless of your friend Dorugamon, the members are still uncomfortable because of the DexDoruGreymon loitering outside.

If you don't mind, please chase them away like you did before.
Process: Feeling insecured even in home is not such a joyful thing.
Complete: Thank you so much for enlightening the mood!

Body:
This is Miki! I've spot a pack of DexDoruGreymon heading to Resistance headquarters!!

Me and WarGreymon X is heading the way to the headquarters to stop them, but I'm not sure if we can make it before it's too late.

Are you and the Resistance members safe there?
If you are, please notify Silphymon about this right now.
Process: We're still on the way. Please keep the base safe!
Complete: Worse things happen in such bad times! Right when WarGreymon X is not in the place!
Expert: Human, we need your help!

Body:
WarGreymon X is on the way of returning.
Meanwhile, MetalGarurumon X who we thought to be dead has returned all of a sudden and is defending the headquarters from DexDoruGreymons!

I'll get our injured members to evacuate from the base for just in case, so please buy me some time!
Process: The evacuation is just for the worst case. I'll return with them when defense succeeds.
Complete: This may be difficult!

Body:
With your help, we could defend our headquarters.
However, MetalGarurumon X is still against the hostile DexDoruGreymons.

Can you help him in the battle?
If you defeat the DexDoruGreymons around the base, it will be a big help!
Process: I'll do my best to keep the base safe!
Complete: With your great support, our injured members could return safely. Thanks to you that we're safe now!

Body:
Their attack is still lasting!
MetalGarurumon X is still guarding the behind of our base.

At the meantime, we can go inside and warn the rest of our members.

We also need members that can fight back with us!
And if we can clear the path in the way, it would be much better!
Simple:
Defeat DexDoruGreymon
Enter to Resistance secret base
Talk to Wizarmon
Helper:
%qs1Defeat DexDoruGreymon%qe  %cc1/%mc1
%qs2Enter to Resistance secret base%qe  %cc2/%mc2
%qs3Talk to Wizarmon%qe  %cc3/%mc3
Process: There's not much time, we should be leaving!
Complete: The situation here isn't very good.
Expert: Royal Knights… What are they thinking?

Body:
MetalGarurumon X is guarding us from one side.
But there are a lot of injured members inside, and not many of us can join the fight.

We have to find a solution, at least to resist until WarGreymon X arrives.

Human, you're the only hope we can rely on now.
Please keep the DexDoruGreymon away from the base.
I trust you!
Process: WarGreymon X should be arriving in any minute!
Complete: What a hectic day we're having!

Body:
Your friend Dorugamon is still not fully recovered yet and the recent attack of DexDoruGreymons is only making it worse.

And the number of casualties are increasing as the fight is lasting longer, so we're running out of medication again.

By looking at their habits, devouring anything in their sight, I'm sure that some of them should have our medical supplies swalled.

When you defeat them, please look for the stolen medical supplies.
Process: I'll take good care of the injured members, along with your friend Dorugamon!
Complete: Great! This should be enough!

Body:
By the attack of DexDoruGreymon, number of casualties are still increasing.

So we are still running short of medication again.
I'm trying my best to find the lost medical supplies, but getting into a limit.

If you are capable, please help me retrieve the medical supplies from DexDoruGreymons. Thanks!
Process: We are getting new injuries before the already injured members fully recover. This is such a madness!
Complete: Thank you as always! I think you've brought enough supplies for today.

Body:
Not even a single moment for the injured members to recover!
The attack of DexDoruGreymone is insane!

I just need to buy some time!
Yes, it was always about the time, but especially now I'm more desperate!

Please get those greedy bastards out of this place!
Process: The injured members are in recovery without any problem. I just hope there'll be no more injuries.
Complete: Great! With your help, the number of injuries are decreasing.

Body:
The recovery of your friend is completed, but for some reason, he's not fully conscious.
It doesn't look like it's a cause by a physical injury.

So we've decided to take him to the Lake.
We'll be carrying him to the Lake, so me up there.
Simple:
Enter to Lake
Talk to Wizarmon
Process: Once we get to the Lake, we'll find a way to make him conscious.
Complete: We have a situation again.
Expert: It doesn't make sence. This place wasn't exposed to anyone!

Body:
It's like we are facing monsters from hell, devouring everything in their sight, as if today's the end of the world.

How can this be happening?
Complete: We have to find a way to stop this madness! We are survivors!
Expert:
This secret base was never exposed to the Royal Knights.
And there is no way that it can be exposed. So how can this situation be explained? Can it be the influence of Yggdrasil?

Body:
We have companions!
And we have you, who we can rely on.

I and other members will resist to survive!
When WarGreymon X arrives here, we may be able to turn the table!
Process: We can still hold on!
Complete: For our companions, and allies!!
Expert: You've waited for a long time!

Body:
We're still fighting back on DexDoruGreymons to defend the base!

MetalGarurumon X is still guarding one side of our base, but we could use a hand.
If you can, please get rid of more DexDoruGreymons!
Process: We must keep our companions safe!
Complete: I hope we can take some rest soon!

Body: Thanks to you that we could evacuate the injured members during the attack!
Complete: I will never give up! I'll put all my efforts in…
Expert: The situation is not getting any better. Even with your help, we can't stop all the members from getting injuries.

Body:
Don't get confused! We have a trial to overcome!

We're in emergency situation now.
Please help us by stopping the DexDoruGreymon!

We can't leave our injured companions into danger again.
Process: Hurry! We don't have much time!
Complete: Calm down everyone! Being nervous won't help the situation!

Body:
This is a confusing situation!
For what reason is Dorugamon in the same form of the bad guys over there?
Is this the worst scenario that we can imagine?
Complete: WarGreymon X?
Expert: How come Dorugamon evolves into a form same as the one who's attacking us? This is chaos.

Body: Calm down everyone!
Complete: He's become one of us now! Don't doubt a friend! Just trust him!
Expert: Regardless of how he looks now, doesn't matter with this situation now. Dorugamon… or DoruGreymon is still our ally and will help us fight back no matter what!

Body:
WarGreymon X is right! It's just his looks that is similar to DexDoruGreymon, but that has nothing to do with the fight!
Because he's on our side now and fighting for us!
Right now, I'll request our headquarters for reinforcements. So we can secure our base and keep our companions safe.
At the meantime, please protect me and the signal device from the enemies!!
Process: Getting the signal device ready is not a problem, but it should be kept safe from any attacks.
Complete: Good job! I'll now send the reinforcement request, so hold tight!

Body:
This is Richard Sampson from DATS Center.
I just received backup request from agent Miki.
We'll be preparing for the backup soon, so hold on until then.

As the result of data I received, the DexDoruGreymon seems to be coming out from the Royal Base.
Complete: We'll have someone reliable other than DATS Center!
Expert: Really? I have a good news for us too!

Body:
Hopefully, we have a new reinforcement arriving soon.

WarGreymon X and MetalGarurumon X are becoming exhausted by their continuous attacks, and the headquarters can be invaded in any minute when the defense line collapses.

But if our new reinforcement arrives, I'm pretty sure we can reverse the situation!

Please tell this to WarGreymon X!
Process: You need to tell this to WarGreymon X fast!
Complete: What did you say?
Expert: Just a little more time!... The members of Resistance must be safe!

Body:
I see! A new reinforcement is arriving? That's a good news.
It can be awakward to say in this situation now, but I really appreciate your help.
Without your help, we probably couldn't have come this far.
Complete: Listen up! Resistance!
Expert: There's nothing better than a reinforcement joining us in this situation! The members will be happy to hear this!

Body:
Reinforcements seems to be on the way now, but we have a situation.
DexDoruGreymons are continuing to attack us!
We'll not hold out if unless we make a breakthrough.
Can you help DoruGreymon to barricade enemies in the frontline?
Process: We don't have much time left now!
Complete: Damn! We need reinforcements right now!
Expert: We don't have much time left now!

Body:
The battle is being extended. Our members aer getting exhausted and injured.
But we can't give up now. If we lose, we'll all be dead.
So we must get through this trial.
Please keep up the good work. I appreciate your help.
Process: Can there be something done?
Complete:
Who is the Digimon in front of me?
I have to keep my position, so please check for me.
Expert: Can there be something done?

Body:
I Gallantmon, has returned from the Data Universe to retrieve justice in this place.
Thank you human. I came back with MetalGarurumon, but the situation here seems worse than I expected.
Please help our injured members to escape. WarGreymon and MetalGarurumon will be joining you.
Helper:
%qs1Talk to WarGreymon X%qe  %cc1/%mc1
%qs2Talk to MetalGarurumon X%qe  %cc2/%mc2
Process: We must hurry!
Complete: That's good. Perhaps we can talk now.
Expert: All right. I'll start moving now.

Body:
I've been questioning Yggdrasil's will all the time I was wandering in the Data Universe, but could not reach to a conclusion.
Instead, I've been convinced by Dorumon's shout.
I believe that DoruGreymon has a proper motivation.
I'll open the path for you, so you can go and talk to DoruGreymon.
Process: Get along with the message.
Complete: Is that what Gallantmon has said?
Expert: So, what about you?

Body:
My existance…
The enemies ahead…
And Yggdrasil…

Finally, I've made up my mind.
Process: It's the only choice I can make.
Complete:
I'll head to Royal Base.
It's time I can ask a question of myself.
Expert: It's the only choice I can make.

Body:
So that's how DoruGreymon determined.
Then let's clear a path in front of him.
There's another swarm of DexDoruGreymon coming towards us now.
Process: I can see your faith!
Complete: On your way, DoruGreymon!
Expert: I can see your faith!

TitleText: Need Backup? I Don't Think So.
Body:
Dorugreymon is the key to resolve this situation, so I've sent him to the Royal Base.
But Royal Base is not an easy place to enter and I'm out of energy ever since DoruGreymon has left. Right now, we need the Royal Knight's approval.
To be thorough, you need to be certain to be prepared to stand against the power of Yggdrasil.
I know the way, but I want to ask if you're really ready.
Process: We'll have to make a conclusion to this incident.
Complete: So, have you made your decision?
Expert: We'll have to make a conclusion to this incident.

Body:
All right, if that is your will. I understand.
I need a moment to make gateway, so those nuisances must be defeated.
The Colossal DexDoruGreymon seems to be summoning the army of them, so please get him out of here.
And don't forget to return once you get the job done!
Process: Have you defeated it?
Complete: Good. We can buy some time.
Expert: Have you defeated it?

Body:
The next thing to check is your strength.

All the remaining Digimons here are survivors of extreme jungle law environment.

When you can beat the Digimons on battle, I'll trust you.
Simple:
Defeat GranDracmon
Defeat TigerVespamon
Defeat GrandisKuwagamon
Defeat Dorugoramon
Complete: Great!

Body:
That was actually impressive. You've managed to beat all of them.

So you have done this before? I see. Now I begin to understand all the situation.

It'd be a joke if I still can't trust you.
Process: A relationship between a human and Digimon. Interesting...
Complete: But that isn't everything.
Expert: A relationship between a human and Digimon. Interesting…

TitleText: Too Early For a Happy Ending
Body:
Getting through the enterance of Royal Base requires massive energy consumption.

Fortunately, there are energy sources that can be used. They are spreaded widely in this area.

When you collect enough energy sources, bring them to me.
Process: Be careful when you collect the energy sources.
Complete: The energy sources may already have been fused by Digimons nearby.
Expert: Be careful.

Body: I've located several DexDoruGreymons' main rally points. Miki told me that she has the tracking device. Get the tracking device first.
Complete: It's good to see you're safe!
Expert: When do we get out of here?

Body:
Here's the tracking device. It's a precious supply from DATS Center, so please hand it carefully.

You can go talk to Gallantmon now.
Process: Keep going.
Complete: What is this device?
Expert: So this device is…?

Body: Gateways were destroyed many times so I had a hard time locating the enterance, but this device will make it a lot easier. Now, we can continue whenver you're ready.
Process: So you've come.
Complete: Are you fully prepared?
Expert: So you've come.

Body:
After condensing the energy sources for the gateway, with the support of the device you brought, I'll be able to create new gateway that allow us to enter the Royal Base.
Just give me a moment.
Process: Now it's done.
Complete:
I managed to open a gateway to Royal Base from the Historic Site.

Meet me there when you make up your mind.
Expert: Now it's done.

Body:
Getting through the enterance of Royal Base requires massive energy consumption.

I can make the gateway again for you if you request. But to do that requires more energy sources.

Bring enough energy sources and I'll create the gateway once more.
Process: It is time.
Complete:
The gateway to Royal Base is ready.
Go and show Yggdrasil our will!
Expert: It is time.

Body:
It seems that the Royal Knights have detected our intrusion. When you defeat them, you'll be able to move into the center of the base.
Deal with the Royal Knights in Royal Base and you'll be able to obtain their vouchers. But be careful while you're in there.
Complete: You returned safely as I expected.

Body:
X-Antibody… I think that's a suitable name of calling it.
It's the decisive matter to allow our partner Digimons to stand against the X-Program.
I wish to research further about it, so what do you think?
Complete:
Just a little more help.
I'm sure it will be a great aid to us.

Body:
You should be aware of it already. But anyway, Kunemons here are stronger than we expected.
Don't you agree with it?

I think this needs to be investigated also!
Can you take this Precision Camera with you and take some pictures?
Process: Why? Is the camera not comfortable for you?
Complete: Great! The picture looks good enough!

Body:
I sent the pictures of Kunemon to headquarters and requested for data comparison with the Kunemon of Digital World.
After a while, I've been told that the Kunemons in this world has another singularity. An instinct to fight and kill their same race, who's weaker than itself...
To prove this, we require the battle data of Kunemon.
Can you fight the Kunemons?
Process: See? How do they look? Can you also see the differences between them and the Kunemons we already know?
Complete: Hmm… hahaha… it's a little funny to think like this.

Body:
Pleased to see you.
I'm Gallantmon, a member of the Royal Knights. We serve Yggdrasil. The reason why I'm visiting is because you seem to be searching for something in common, which I also want to know. The will of survival that Digimons have in this place, is still a mystery. But as these Digimons are defined as our enemies, I had to come to you for cooperation.
Process: I know it's a difficult task. But it is necessary.
Complete: The reason why the Digimons become ferocious?
Expert: Oh! My human friend, did you just arrive?

Body:
Aha… that's what happened.
Explaining you the fact, we are not the native Digimons of 'New Digital World', but immigrants from the existing Digital World.
In the Digital World, something called 'X-Program' is keep spreading and causing many Digimons suffer and even to die. Some of the Digimons that survived from 'X-Program' has evacuated and that lead to this place.
I guess that's how the 'will of survival' got stronger.
Complete: A law that allows anything if it's related with survival? That's a little horrible. It's frightening.
Expert: Is that so? I never knew the place had such a story.

Body:
That's understandable. Even though the so called 'X-Program' seems to have no effect to humans, it's critical to our Digimons in the other hand. The Kunemons here seems to be evolved by the purpose of surviving.
I think we should collect the data of Kunemon in this world.
I'll give you a scanner, so use it to collect data, and if possible, get the cores from them too.
Simple:
Use scanner to kunemon
Collect Digimon's Core
Process: I'm busy right now. I'll do the analysis, so just get me the stuffs that I asked.
Complete: Very good~! Now take some rest, while I do the rest!

Body:
As we expected, headquarters is requesting us for more data. It looks like the data has never been seen before, so it's taking a lot of time and effort, and they need more samples because of that.

So let's collect more research data.
Simple:
Use scanner to kunemon
Collect Digimon's Core
Process: I'm getting tired of this repetitive tasks sometimes.
Complete: You've done well~. I'll be sending them to headquarters. So meanwhile, you can take some rest.

Body:
Please take this to Gallantmon.
The research result is pretty absolute.

It's been translated to Digimon font, so you won't be able to read it.
Or you can ask Gallantmon to read if for you, if you're curious.
Simple:
Deliver Research Report to Gallantmon
Talk to Gallantmon
Helper:
%qs1Deliver Research Report to Gallantmon%qe  %cc1/%mc1
%qs2Talk to Gallantmon%qe  %cc2/%mc2
Process: All Royal Knights seem to be arrogant and it's annoying.
Complete:
Thank you.
I've found some answeres to my questions now.

I've been questioning on the other aspects of ferocious Digimon when it evolved, rather that the ferocious Digimon itself.

If you were questioning the same thing, take a look on the Digimons who evolved into new form.
Expert: Yes? Have you completed with the research already?

Body:
We gave Gallantmon information he asked, so now we should get information that we need.

Refering to Gallantmon's information, there are not only Digimons of unknown forms, but ones that changed forms influenced by the environment.

This need to be investigated further.
I've found that there were some Kuwagamons that are evolved from Kunemons, and become a threat to us.
Please deal with them first.
Process: The Digimon in a shape of red insect, called Kuwagamon. He seems to be too violent.
Complete: Hmm… it's strange.

Body:
I found something strange.
At first, I could only see Kunemons in that area, but now I begin to see Kuwagamons.

How could this be explained, unless they can't just suddenly appear like magic or dropped from the sky?

From the opposite direction, Okuwamons are approaching and they look very aggressive.
Please defeat them, and collect their cores!
Simple:
Defeat Okuwamon
Collect Kernel Antibody Core
Process: This is weird, but not just weird… It's tooooo weird.
Complete: First the analysis! Result comes afterwards!

Body:
I heard that the scientists of DATS Center are amazed by the research data extracted from Okuwamon. The data is very different from the other existing Digimons, is what they said…
So the next request is to attach transmitter on Okuwamons and get their action data and movement pattern results.
Simple:
Attach Transmitter to Okuwamon
Defeat Okuwamon
Process: It's painful just thinking about it.
Complete: Nicely done~!

Body:
During the investigation, I've heard a loud noise coming out of the forest. I recorded and analyzed this noise and it came out to be GranKuwagamon's roar.
If we don't do anything about this, we may lose Okuwamon in track.
So please deal with GranKuwagamon first!
Process: I hope the scientists of DATS Center learn some manners!
Complete: You've done a great work so far. Well done!

Body:
The GranKuwagamons have appeared again. They're disturbing our task to extract data from Okuwamons.
Then the solution is simple.
Let's get rid of the disruptors!
Process: This place is full of mystery. I wonder when I'll get used to it.
Complete: Finally~! Good job!!

Body:
Research results have arrived, and there is something very unique.
One of the GranKuwagamon was grabbing the transmitter we attached on Okuwamon.
That means… they didn't just appear from nowhere, but have evolved by themselves.

Well… this is just a theory yet, so we need to look further.
WarGreymon X may know the answer to this.
Process: Save all questions for the experts!
Complete: I see. So you've found such a strange being?
Expert: What is it now?

Body:
We are the finders of X-Antibody. We have earned it to resist and survive from the effect of X-Program.
As we gained X-Antibody, we became stronger than usual, and there were some remarkable changes into our bodies.
Evolving or changing in shape is just one of the ways of survival.
You'll be able to see that from the forest, because there's a perfect example to explain all this.
Look for GrandisKuwagamon in the forest.
Process:
You haven't found it yet?
I'll give you a hint. It's stronger than GranKuwagamon.
Complete: So the evolution was for survival…
Expert: Have you completed the research?

Body: If your objective of research is about the X-Antibody and evolution, GrandisKuwagamon can be a good example and research target. These Digimons are known to be more ferocious and violent compared to other Digimons.
Process:
I know it's a tough target, but at least it's not invincible.
You'll make it kneel before you.
Complete:
See? I knew you could do it.
Great!

Body:
As a result of your efforts and hard word, we could reach to a conclusion in a short time. Yggdrasil's will, and the will of Digimons we predicted to be extinct had the same main purpose. It was to 'Survive'.
X-Evolution is just a process for the objective. Everything there has the purpose of survival.
Thanks to you that now I have my doubts cleared now.
Complete:
I've managed to send all our data, including the ones received from Gallantmon to our headquarters.

They told me that the overall research data results we sent so far looks positive.
Expert: Gallantmon seem to be leaving somewhere, wasn't he?

Body:
You've done well.
I hope you can come back to headquarters and drop by.
Is that ok?
Process:
It should be a good news for you.
I'll be awaiting.
Complete:
We always need to adjust into new environments.
Our research of the X-Antibody has been succeeded.
So X-Evolution became enabled.
Expert:
Welcome.
By your devotional support, the scientists of DATS Center could successfully develop

Body:
Hmm… these are…?
Looks like we got more objects to research on.

These things seem to be somehow connected with the essential parts of Digital World.
Simple:
Collect Data Ocean's Flotsam A
Collect Data Ocean's Flotsam B
Collect Data Ocean's Flotsam C
Collect Data Ocean's Flotsam D
Helper:
%qs1Collect Data Ocean's Flotsam A%qe  %cc1/%mc1

%qs3Collect Data Ocean's Flotsam C%qe  %cc3/%mc3
%qs4Collect Data Ocean's Flotsam D%qe  %cc4/%mc4
Process: Those stuffs may be valuable, who knows?
Complete: Good! You brought the flotsams. I'll take a closer look now.

Body:
As we are collecting these flotsams from the Data Ocean, I sometimes get weird messages or voice files through my digivice. It's little… very creepy…
All the message includes the word 'Survive' in common.

Due to the experinces we had here, I presume that it's deeply related with this area.
I think it's worth for more investigation.
Complete: What shall we do now?

Body:
Since this is also a digital signal, I need more trackers installed around this area.
These trackers I have are not very expensive, but they'll do the job fine.
Please install them as many as you can in this area.
Simple: Use traker in Exterior Site Ruins
Process: It's kinda creepy, but I'm still curious!
Complete: Ah! The signal! It's detected!

Body:
I… want… survival… and to… learn…
You… want… to know… survival… help… required…
Complete: I don't know what to do with it.
Expert:
Was it a request for us to help?
From an existence we don't even know?

Body:
Some support request came from nowhere…
or from unknown existence in an unknown place…
I have no idea what will happen afterwards regardless of what this request is about.

I just know that the sender seems to be deeply related with the Digimons we can easily see from "Verdandi Terminal".
Complete:
I guess it's meaningless to hesitate now.
Let's find out who this may be.
At least we know that the existence needs help.

Body:
If this guy give a lot of meaning to survival, why not make him realize by the battles we have went through so far?
There are a lot of Digimons nearby…
I found Dorumons or a similar species hanging around this area.

Fight and defeat them one by one!
Simple:
Defeat Dorumon
Defeat Dolgamon
Defeat Dorugreymon
Process: Surive to survive… I think I've heard it somewhere?
Complete: Good! Still breathing today!

Body:
We seem to have some changes, but as nothing very impressive is found yet, message is looking awkward.

I'm not saying that it is meaningless, so the main concept remains the same.
Just focus on showing the will to survive with more attention!
Simple:
Defeat Dorumon
Defeat Dolgamon
Defeat Dorugreymon
Process: No matter how many times I try… Battle doesn't seem to fit me.
Complete: It's starting to talk better than before!

Body:
I… was… killing… Digimons… by… orders…
However… I… did not… like… the idea…
And why… were they… struggling… so desperately… just to… live…

I… want to… know…
What… is… the purpose… of… this will…
I… need… your… help…
Complete: Is that something nice?
Expert: Hmm… Is it recalling its memory?

Body:
This message of unknown being is really mysterious.
I mean… this guy don't seem to be nice.
But neither so evil too…

This is a rare chance of getting new information, but in the otherside, I feel like it's opening a Pandora's Box we should not be opening.
Complete:
But still, I think we should be cooperating.
Even for the purpose of continuing our investigation.

Body:
I… have faced… a lot… of Dragon type… Digimons…
I… may had… some… advantages… against… them…
many… Dragon type Digimons… engaged…
retaliation… no doubt…
memories… lost… impact…
on the… contrary...
Simple:
Defeat Monochromon
Defeat Darktyranomon
Defeat Reptiledramon
Defeat Allomon
Process: Familiar…
Complete:
Having some progress? What's with Dragon type Digimons?
Is this unknown guy being rough?

TitleText: Digimon Achieving Evolution of Endless Potential
Body:
We have to take care of the remaining tasks.
There still are dangerous looking Digimons loitering around.

Especially, some guys like GrandisKuwagamons are on rampage.
Because of the impact, the area is messed up and supplies we find from there are running short.

Please get those Dorugoramon out of the area.
Process: Is it so strong?
Complete:
Awesome! This place will be more quiet now.
So, what could this be?

TitleText: [Daily] Digimon Achieving Evolution of Endless Potential
Body:
Despite of your effort last time, these trouble makers are occupying the area continuously.

Can you drive them out like you did last time?
Thanks!
Process: You can handle this like last time, can't you?
Complete: Wow! Great! You're truly amazing!

Body:
The… that… that shield… there!
That's it… I… I am…!!
Complete:
What? It suddenly screamed and it's not talking anymore?
It's not dead, is it?
Expert: What's going on now?

Body:
As the unknown being gets to see Gallantmon's Shield, it started to react intensely?
Wait a moment…
Why is Dorugoramon's holding this shield?
Have Gallantmon abandoned his shield?

I think we need to investigate this too…
Let's question this to WarGreymonX first, as he may know something about it.
Process: Gallantmon? I never though a strong being like him would be defeated like that.
Complete: But this surely looks like Gallantmon has been defeated.
Expert: Yes? What is it?

Body:
Because of the possible risks in this investigation, we couldn't go any further.
Instead, I found out something else that caught my sight.

Royal Knights seem to have an internal conflict.
It's happening between Omegamon and Gallantmon, and this isn't just an ordinary conflict, because they used to be close friends.

I think it needs to be investigated definitely.
The area is one of Omegamon's territory, so it's a bit risky, but since I trust you, we can...
Process: Gallantmon's defeat? It's unbelievable.
Complete: Hmm… How about?
Expert: Think there was a fierce battle going on?

Body:
This is just one of my predictions.
Can the unknown existence be deeply related with Gallantmon?
A companion, or subordinate of him, perhaps?

We found the shield from this location, so could there be a chance to find his spear? Let's continue this investigation and find out!
Complete: We should be stronger, not only from here.

Body:
I think we should fight the Digimons who are related with Gallantmon.
Dorugoramon was holding the trace of Gallantmon, so we may find a clue!

We may be able to find spear from the Dorumons, or Dracmons loitering around this area!
Process: I've observed with tracking device. It should be near us now!
Complete: See? I told you it was near.

Body:
I'll send these shield and spear to unknown presence by the form of data.
If this guy has anything to do with Gallantmon, there must be any kind of reaction.
Complete:
Data transmission is completed!
You're on your own now! Don't forget to be responsible for what you do next!

TitleText: I'm Gallantmon, a Royal Knight with Pride
Body:
First of all, thank you humans.
It's been a while.
You've done a hard work because of me.
It's such a shame that I've lost my memory, even after surviving from the Data Ocean.

I came all this way to find out the 'Will of Survival', so I've been hit by Omegamon and dragged myself down here.
Now it's time for me to regain my power.
Can you help me find the Digizoids from my companions?
Simple:
Collect Data Chrome Digizoid
Collect Data Red Digizoid
Collect Data Blue Digizoid
Collect Data Gold Digizoid
Helper:
%qs1Collect Chrome Digizoid%qe  %cc1/%mc1
%qs2Collect Red Digizoid%qe  %cc2/%mc2
%qs3Collect Blue Digizoid%qe  %cc3/%mc3
%qs4Collect Gold Digizoid%qe  %cc4/%mc4
Process: I know that it's a tough task. But I'm sure you can handle it.
Complete: Thanks a lot! Now it's time for a change!

Body:
Through your support, I and the Digimon beside me is able to return to the Digital World.

But it's not right now.
There is an exit, and we should find it to escape.
Don't worry about it though, as I'll take care of it myself.

I've earned much information, and learned alot from you guys. I appereciate all the support you've done for us.
Complete:
Huh? For what did he leave so much data behind?
Gallantmon has sent us massive amoount of data!
Can you choose one of these?
Thanks!

Body:
You succeeded on getting the vouchers. Good job.

I'll persuade the rest, so you can go further inside.

Go and find out the real intention of Yggdrasil.
Process: You can go on now.
Complete: The human and Digimon together. Thanks for coming all the way to here.
Expert: You must be…

Body:
The situation now is not very nice.

Dexmon is defending Yggdrasil from inside.

We need your help. You and I, Omegamon. Three of us will make a good team enough to defeat Dexmon.

Let's fight and survive!
Process: I'm already ready to initiate.
Complete: You've returned! Did you succeed?
Expert: Is this the end?

Body:
The digital world has retrieved peace again with your help.
Our comrades who struggled just to survive can now take some rest.
Thank you dearly.

By the way, Omegamon should be waiting for you.
You might want to talk to him too.
Process: Omegamon should have something to talk with you.
Complete: I was expecting you, human.

Body:
The aspects of me? Yes, as you can see I've accepted X-antibody.
My friend Gallantmon has said that the will to survive is X-antibody itself, but I still don't know about that.
But anyway, I believe that the peace we have now is the result of true justice.
Yggdrasil must have believed in another justice apart from us, but the result we have now is more important.
Thank you human. I look forward to see you again next time.
Process: Gallantmon seems to have something to tell.
Complete: Have you had conversation with Omegamon?
Expert: There he is.

Body:
Another human that came with you is waiting for you at Historic Site.

I think you should go there now.

Thanks for all the support so far.
Complete: Finally, you're back again! You didn't get hurt?
Expert: Hope he comes soon.

Body:
Afer the last fight , Dorumon disappeared.

But I found him!

Now, keep going!
Process: What are you waiting for? You should go now.
Complete: Who are you?
Expert: (Yawns) I'm sleepy now.

Body:
I've found this item from the Data Universe.
It seems to possess DigiSoul in it, but it doesn't fit to me.
It should fit for you instead.
How about we making a deal?
If you get the Royal Knight's vouchers and bring them to me, I'll give you this as an exchange.
Process:
A equipment fit to human, which possess DigiSoul?
It's very unusual to me. Do you guys evolve too?
Complete:
That's the voucher I was talking about.
Here, take this item.

Body:
Getting through the enterance of Royal Base requires massive energy consumption.

I can make the gateway again for you if you request. But to do that requires more energy sources.

Bring enough energy sources and I'll create the gateway once more.
Process: It is time.
Complete:
The gateway to Royal Base is ready.
Go and show Yggdrasil our will!
Expert: It is time.

Body:
Culu~

Do you hear that too, Culu~?

The sound of depressed Digimon voice?
The sound of the wounds?

It was a tragic to hear these voices, Culu…
But strangely, now the voices are fading…
Complete: Something must be going on… Culu!

Body:
That's not all of what so strange.
Along the fading voices, there was a voice of anger~ Culu!

The voice was in rage, but any kind of evil.
It was more like a shouting of justice, Culu!

And the voices were coming from the cold Ice Area!
I think it's best to go there at once to find out the situation there Culu~!

And please check what caused the Digimon voice of rage, Culu!
Complete:
Human child?
What's your business here?
Sorry, but I'm not in such a mood for chit-chat now.

Body:
What?

Calumon has sent you for an investigation of this Ice Area?
Hmm… I see that Calumon still has an incredible sence…

As a response to Calumon, I can tell you that Ice Area is in a middle of war.
Many Digimon became the victims of war and many died.
Complete:
Leomon who fell down here has also became a victim of this war.

It's such a pity…

Body:
I'm restoring the data of war casualties who didn't make it.
Their data will reborn as new DigiEgg after being restored.
That's why I came to this place, which is frequently at war now.

I've first thought that what I do is a contribution to peace.
Granting new life to Digimon that'd live longer without war was what I've been doing so far.
I prayed for them to reborn in the place where there is no war, so they can live their second life happily.

However, as I kept repeating this procedure, my thoughts have been changed.
I started to think that what I do is just extending the war.
Complete:
Because I began to think the ones I helped may have reborned, evoluted, and return to war for their revenge.
That'll never end the war.

Body:
Therefore, I've changed my mind!

Consequentially, to end this meaningless war once and for all!

Ending the war to reclaim peace, and everyone forgets about war to live their new lives in peace!
Complete: If you agree and willing to stop the war, can you help?

Body:
Cause of the war?
Pardon me. I guess I've skipped the most important part. The cause of this war…

It is told that Human type Digimon and Beast type Digimon weren't in such a good relationship.
They were maintaining balance with careful understanding and tolerance, but suddenly it broke and lead to a war.

I don't know what flamed this war and who's responsible for it.
Complete: But I'm sure of one thing! That this meaningless war must be stopped!

Body:
I know it's too difficult to restrain both sides at once, so we should help one side to win and end this war.

So which side of Digimon force do you want to help?

I'm in a position to ask for your help, so I'll respect your choice no matter what. And I'll actively support you to make the side you choose to win from the war!
Complete:
So, have you made up your mind?
Which side are you going to help?

Body:
You want to help the Human Type Digimon?
Well, I suppose that you feel more fellowship to them as you're a human yourself?
Complete:
Aha…
Human, you also have a good sence of judgment.

Body:
Need some explanation for that?

Valkyrimon may not explained this part to you, but I think you should know.

The supreme leader of Beast Type Digimon turns out to be Cherubimon.
Cherubimon is one of the 3 Angel Digimon and put a lot of effort for maintaining peace.
But unfortunately, Cherubimon has fallen and became evil.

They say that Cherubimon fell to darkness and started this war.
Complete:
So the target becomes clear now.

Main target will be Cherubimon, and the objective is to defeat him!

Body:
Before taking down Cherubimon, taking down his minions will help!

To the information I've received, army is being trained from Digimon Maze F2.
And Grizzlymon are making the core troops among them.

If the troops of Grizzlymon are defeated, the force of Beast Type Digimon will be weaken!

Please go there and take down those Grizzlymon armies!
We'll guard this area from the Beast Type Digimon intruders!
Complete:
I see that you completed defeating Grizzlymon!
The force of Beast Type Digimon became weaker.

Body:
Since the armies have been defeated, now let's get rid of their leaders!

Cherubimon has 3 co-leaders…
They're Antylamon(Deva), MetalTyrannomon, and Mephismon.
These co-leaders have an enormous amount of armies, so it should be a tough task…

But to end the war for good, all of them must be taken down!
Simple:
Defeat Antylamon (Deva)
Defeat Sangloupmon
Defeat Gazimon
Complete:
You're greater than I thought!
I didn't expect you to take down Antylamon(Deva) so soon…

Body:
Our next target is MetalTyrannomon!

This guy is very vicious as he looks like!
Even his armies are vicious just like him.
They're known to inflicted most of the damage to Human Type Digimon…

So it may become more tough than when you fought against Antylamon(Deva)...

We're in desperate need of your help now!
Please encounter MetalTyrannomon, his armies and take all of them down to bring peace!
Simple:
Defeat MetalTyrannomon
Defeat DarkTyrannomon
Defeat Greymon(Black)
Complete:
I had a faith in you to defeat MetalTyrannomon and his armies, but it really is amazing to see it myself.
You're really a one big miracle!

Body:
Now, it's just one co-leader what's left of Cherubimon!
When Mephismon is taken down, Cherubimon will no longer has control over his minions!

Mephismon is a very cunning type of leader.
Even Omegamon of Royal Knights has once falllen into Mephismon's plan.

But if you stay focused, you won't have any problem on defeating Mephismon!

I start to see the light of hopes from Digital World's future that was covered only with darkness!
So please keep it up until it ends!
Simple:
Defeat Mephismon
Defeat Devidramon
Defeat BlackGatomon
Complete:
I knew it!
I had confidence that you'll succeed it as well!

Thanks to you that the war has come near to the end!

Body:
Hopefully, this will be the final task.
It's eliminating the source of this war.

When Cherubimon is finally defeated, our world will retrieve peace, and I won't have to restore data of Digimon who lost their lives in war…

I hope it will be my last request!
Please take down Cherubimon and retrieve the peace of Digital World!
Complete:
Thank you so much my friend!

I'm pretty sure that you're a true hero of this world!
It's not much, but I want to reward you for the peace you retrieved for us.

Please take it!

Body:
The thing I gave you is a type of amulet I've have been treasuring.

It's currently sealed, but Calumon may break the seal for you…

When you keep the amulet with you, the powers of amulet may enable your partner Silphymon's evolution.

It's my little reward for you my friend.
I hope you like it.
Simple:
Talk to Calumon
Deliver Sealed Aurvandil
Complete:
I've noticed that the voice of sadness and rage has turned to voice of joy, Culu~!
You must have succeeded your mission!

Wait, what is that stuff? A gift from Valkyrimon, Culu?
That should probably mean Valkyrimon greatly appreciate you for what you've done, Culu~!

Body:
Aurvandil is a bow that has been treasured by Valkyrimon and it even possess some of the powers of Valkyrimon, Culu~!

Giving the most treasured bow to someone…
that must mean Valkyrimon has been deeply impressed by your help~ Culu~!

To the sincerity of Valkyrimon, I shall break the seal of this item~ Culu!
Complete:
The item has been successfully unsealed now, Culu~!
When you use it on your partner Silphymon, she'll be able to evolve into Valkyrimon, Culu~!

I hope you can have the warm heart just like Valkyrimon you've met earlier, who mourn for death of the innocent and seek for peace.
