Body:
What brings you here, Culu~?
Have you talked to chief Sampson already? No?

Sampson has just recalled all DATS agents, Culu~.

I've sensed something bad is happening, and I guess it may be involved, Culu~!

Go and talk to Sampson to find what's going on, Culu~.
Process: Sampson has a serious face when I saw him. That may mean whatever happening is not just and average accident, Culu~.
Complete:
Mmm… I thought you'd come earlier…
Well, we're on an emergency state now, so I just want you to focus on my briefing.

Please pay attention to what I say.

Body:
I want you to go to Tokyo-Odaiba area.
First, search the whole area and report to headquarters right away when you find anything remarkable. Over!
Simple:
Go to Minato City
Investigate Minato City
Complete: Aarrgghh…

Body:
There's an organization called the D.A.A(Dark-Above-All) in Digital World…
It totally makes sence as their members are all formed up by Digimon of darkness.

Some of them weren't dark from the first time, but began to change after joining that organization.

Even if the new member has nothing to do with darkness, the boss of organization can easily turn him into darkness by injecting someting inside the body.
Complete:
That injection not only turns Digimon into dark color, but pulls strength upto their limit boundaries.
And for the price, they'll lose their mind and become very violent.

Body:
Ah… Hello? Can you hear me clearly?
@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>?
We have a situation!
We've received report of 3 dangerous Digimon re-arised in Minato City!
2 of them are showing destructive behaviors.
@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, you're the one who can stop them. Please stop the 2 Digimon before they destroy anything!
Good luck to you! Over!
Complete:
Have you defeated them already?
I see. That's nice work!
But the whole situation isn't over yet.

Body:
@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, have you visited Big Sight before?
Even if you haven't visited there yet, you'd probably heard of it before.
We detected a very dangerous Digimon from that area!

Agent Thomas was dispatched to Big Sight, so you'll be able to get a briefing from him! Over!
Simple:
Go to Big Sight
Talk to Thomas
Complete:
Are you the backup agent?
I'm glad you came!
You may have heard already, but the situation here is not good…

Body:
One of the very dangerous Digimon has re-arised here!
However, this one is not comparable to the others.

The appearance of it was Omegamon, but it was black.
The force of this Digimon was so strong that I couldn't bear moving a step once it came into my sight.
It's impossible for me to stop it alone.

But if you help, maybe we can stand a chance against that Black Omegamon!
It must be a very tough opponent, but at least we can try!
Complete: That's it! We won!!

Body:
I've received report from Thomas that you successfully defeated the re-arised Digimon, @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>! Good job!

But stay sharp though, because the whole situation isn't over yet.
I want you to head to Odaiba now.

We've received in report that Digimon with huge data is about to re-arise in Odaiba soon! So be there quickly!

And also take good care of your partner Digimon.
Calumon has told me that something not good may happen to your Digimon friend.

So now, I want you to focus on the current duty! Over!
Simple:
Go to Hideout of Odaiba
Talk to Omegamon Alter-S
Helper:
%qs1Go to Hideout of Odaiba%qe  %cc1/%mc1
%qs2Talk to Omegamon Alter-S%qe  %cc2/%mc2
Complete:
Is this it?
As I thought… something is not right…

Body:
@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>!
Be careful! It's the one that I warned you!
It's coming towards you!
Complete: Ugghh…!

Body:
This is Richard. How's the situation?

Hmm… so that's what happened?
Well, I guess we can't turn that back now.
We have to focus on things that we can do.
That is to minimize the damage we take!

First thing is first, we should stop Omegamon Zwart D!
I know it's a big burden for you, but try your best to block Omegamon Zwart D!

I'll contact other agents to send them there soon! Over!
Complete:
Have you defeated Defeat Omegamon Zwart D?
That's outstanding work!

How's the status of Omegamon Alter-S?

Body:
Turned black being affected by darkness?
Then Calumon was right about this.

I asked White-bearded Guru about the legend you once mentioned.
And he told me that it's not just a made-up story.
Then we have only one thing to do!

This time, we should stop Omegamon Alter-S who truned into darkness before the city takes any damage!
Our agents are heading to Odaiba in a haste!
Meanwhile, I hope you can buy some time!
I wish you luck! Over!
Complete:
Have you defeated him by yourself alone?
Incredible!

Body:
Oh, is that so?
You haven't defeated him, but made him unconscious instead?

I understood. Bring him to DATS Center with you.

We'll discuss what to do next. Over!
Complete:
Excellent!
We're still in middle of an urgent situation, so we shall discuss about your reward later!

Body:
White-bearded Guru told me that the variation of Omegamon Alter-S who turned dark is called by the name of Omegamon Alter-B.
Anyway, the issue now is what to do with Omegamon Alter-B.
I asked Nanomon in DATS Center to check the conditions of Omegamon Alter-B.

So if you go and ask Nanomon, you'll be able to check Omegamon Alter-B's condition. Over!
Complete:
Hmm… have you come for the results?
It's taking a while, but almost finished.
Just wait for a moment.

Body:
Mmm… This must be the Black Digitron.
I've heard of it many times but it's first time seeing this stuff and it's pretty amazing.
I sincerely appreciate for the great gift to me.

Now, back to the point, when this stuff gets into Digimon, it becomes difficult to separate it again.
However, if we can only nullify its weaknesses, it can become a blessing instead.
Complete:
It can be a tough task, but possible for me who could even duplicate Digivice.

Here, I'll give you a sample.
This sample of Black Digitron is extracted from Omegamon Alter-B, so it can only be used on Omegamon Alter-S.

So if you get a chance to face Omegamon Alter-S, you can try it.

It'd definitely work, because I've tested it many times myself already.

Body:
An enormous force is moving towards us, Culu!
Rumors say that Yggdrasil started to carry out its plan.
There's a survivor from that place, Culu.
The survivor is Dorumon in D-Terminal, so pay him a visit sometime, Culu.
Process: Go see Dorumon Culu!
Complete: That's it. You're the one…
Expert: Who could you be?

Body:
So… you must be a human guardian of this place.
I can tell you that Yggdrasil is threatning all the Digimons with X-Program.
We need stronger power, something new…

You're looking very strong. Can you help my friend Wiardmon, who saved me before?
Process: Wiardmon is somewhere deep in the forest.
Complete: You're a human?
Expert: Who are you? Identify yourself!

Body:
You're the one who Dorumon called. Then you came the right way.
To survive in this environment requires X-Antibody.
This is my personal thinking, but I don't believe that only the chosen one gets it.

I need more research. Please help me get the Digicores from the outrageous FanBeemons.
Process: Once you get the FanBeemon's Digicores, I'll tell you the results of my research.
Complete: As I thought, X-Antibody isn't just given to the chosen ones. It isn't related with type of Digimon.

Body:
I've heard that GranDracmon has appeared in this area.

His companions are immune to X-Program and they are attacking the innocent and weak Digimons.

It's not something tolerable! Please show them no mercy!
Process: It's getting more and more confusing.
Complete: What? Dracmons are looking for something? What could that be?

Body:
This is very suspicious. I want to investigate this further.

They are subordinates of GranDracmon, so I guess they should have something like document written with their master's instructions.
If you find it, please collect them as many as you can and bring them to me.
Process: Be careful. They are strong Digimons.
Complete: Great! I'll take a close look to these documents now!

Body:
It's ordering them to retrieve X-Antibody before it spreads to all the rest of Digimons.

I wonder what GranDracmon is upto.
I think we should encounter GranDracomon. But before that, I'll call for reinforcements, so please hold on!
Process: I have no idea on his power limits. I'll contact Resistance now.
Complete: You're really astonishing, human!

Body:
They are just my data pieces, but you've taken them down.
You're an interesting human.
X-Antibody is a blessing to bring evolution and power of curse at the same time.
You should be aware of the source well.
So let me tell you a secret.
Do you remember DexDoruGreymon that you've encountered?
You'll find out what the source really is when you look into its Digicore.
Process: The secrets will be revealed one day.
Complete:
Evolution of risking death?
So where is this X-Antibody coming from?

Body:
Damn, the Royal Knights has found this place.
Our patrols told me that they already started to appear from area nearby.
Examon is one of them and it started to attack Resistance.
Please save our companions. I can't leave them to die!
Process: Is Yggdrasil trying to eliminate all the possibilities.
Complete: We have another problem right after a problem! Gees!

Body:
The leader and the strongest member of Royal Knights has finally revealed himself.
It's Omegamon, and he's very dangerous.
Magnamon was a big threat to us before, but now a bigger threat has approached.

I'll help the members to evacuate.
Please stop Omegamon at the meantime!
Process: Do you think Yggdrasil also knows the secret of X-Antibody?
Complete: Have you felt something strange in the battle against Omegamon?

Body:
Magnamon, Omegamon, and the evolution of death.
X-Antibody is chaos itself. And it's a one big data that contains a lot of secrets.

However, I believe that you are capable of taking control over its power.

Now, my human friend. Please become the hope of Digimon.
Please become the balance of true justice and power.
Process:
Ask Calumon about the Antibody.
He's the one who's responsible for all evolutions, so he should be aware.
Complete: Huh? What did you say that you saw?
Expert:
You've came back safely, Culu!
You didn't get hurt, did you?

Body:
That's what happened Culu… and the truth of Omegamon was like that Culu.

The power seems to be unleashed from the potential of Omegamon Culu.
And the potential has grew inside you, so I'll help you grow it, Culu.

The answer is inside yourself, Culu.
Process: Are you prepared, Culu?
Complete:
It's all done Culu!!
To get used to this power, your level and Digimon level should reach 99 Culu.
Visit Omegamon when you're fully prepared.

Body:
Now, go and talk to Omegamon Culu.
I know that you've faced him in battle, so it can be a little awkward, but it's important to find out his intention Culu.
Process: Get going Culu!
Complete:
I see, that the power has been revealed.
Talk to me again when ready.
Expert: It's you again, human.

Body:
새로운 싸움이 또 다시 펼쳐지려고 해 동글.

D-터미널에 있는 동글몬이 널 기다리고 있어 동글.

한번 가봐 동글!
Process: 어서 돌몬한테 가봐! 동글
Complete: 대체 이그드라실은 언제까지..
Expert: 왔구나.

Body:
지금도 이그드라실이 X-프로그램으로 디지몬들을 위협하고 있어.

오메가몬이 네게 힘을 줬지만.. 아직 그와 로얄나이츠의 정의는 이그드라실이 있는 것 같아.

정의가 무엇인지 보여줄 때야. 일단 위자몬을 찾아가볼래?
Process: 위자몬은 숲 깊숙한 곳에 있어.
Complete: 너였구나.
Expert: 누구냐!! 정체를 밝혀라!

Body:
알고 있겠지만.. 이곳은 매우 혼란스러워.

디지몬들이 서로 살기 위해서 서로 죽이고 디지코어에 있는 항체들을 흡수하고 있어.

그런데 중엔 폭주를 하거나 악행을 일삼는 디지몬들도 있어서 머리가 아플 지경이야.

다시 우리의 동료가 되서 그들을 막아줘!
Process: 무운을 빈다.
Complete: 고생했어. 그럼 다음 미션을 알려줄게.

Body:
X-항체가 없는 디지몬들은 필사적일 수 밖에 없어.

그 결과는..응, 네가 보는대로야.

힘을 합쳐야될 때..이러고 있다니 젠장.

이번엔 다크티라노몬들을 진정시켜줘. 부탁한다.
Process: 싸움의 연속이로군..
Complete: 고생했어! 그런데.. 또 사건이 터졌어.

Body:
싸움이 점점 더 격해지고 있어.

그랜쿠가몬들과 그 부하들이 무차별적으로 동료들을 공격하고 있고 X-항체를 수집하고 있다고 해.

원흉은... X-프로그램과 그걸 만든 이그드라실인데..

그 녀석들은 쿠네몬들을 잡으면 나타나는데 하나씩 계속 처치하다보면 그랜쿠가몬도 모습을 드러낼거야.

어서 그 녀석들을 막아줘.
Simple:
쿠와가몬(진화한) 처치
오쿠와몬(진화한) 처치
그랜쿠가몬(진화한) 처치

쿠네몬(진화한)을 처치시 그랑디스쿠가몬들과
그 부하들이 출현
Process: 상당히 강한 녀석들이니 조심해.
Complete: 응 역시 그가 수상해.

Body:
예전에 그란드라큐몬을 만난 적이 있지?

최근에 그의 데이터 조각들이 눈에 띄게 늘어났다고해.
여러 일들 때문에 대충 넘어갔었지만 수상한 게 한둘이 아니야.

그 녀석한테 죽음의 진화와 X-항체에 대해 물어볼 때가 됐어.
또 그 녀석의 부하들이 방해하겠지만..돌파할 수 밖엔 없어.
갈 준비 됐지?
Simple:
그란드라큐몬(진화한) 처치

드라큐몬(진화한) 처치시

상굴몬,마타돌몬,그란드라큐몬 순으로 출현
Process: 준비 단단히 해.
Complete: 또 그대인가?

Body:
일을 방해하다니 귀찮게 하는구나 인간.

데크스돌그레몬으로 봐서 깨달았을텐데? X-항체는 죽음을 막지만 죽음을 부르는 데이터다.

내게 답을 구한다고 한들 의미가 없다. 직접 격어봐야 알지.
다시한번 그 녀석들을 만나보거라. 깨달음은 매우 쉬울 것이다.
Simple: 데크스돌그레몬 처치 후 불안정한 X-항체 수집
Process: 진화의 끝엔 무엇이 있을 것이라고 생각하나?
Complete:
그랬군.. 죽음의 진화. 그것은 생존을 위한 욕망이었어.
그것이 데크스를 만든 거야.

Body:
엑자몬이 다시 나타났어.

이번엔 제대로 할 생각인가봐. 여유가 보이지 않는다고 해.

부탁한다. 힘겹겠지만 그를 막아줘.
Process: 대체 언제까지 우리들을 없앨 생각인 거지..?
Complete: 큭, 이번에도 그가 나타나다니..

Body:
이번에도 오메가몬이 다시 나타났어.

아무래도.. 그의 정의가 이그드라실의 정의인 이상

여전히 이그드라실의 명령을 듣고 있는 것 같아.

이대로 지켜볼 수는 없어. 동료들을 부탁할게.
Process: 연이은 전투에 힘들겠지만 믿을게.
Complete: 오메가몬과의 전투에서 이상한 걸 느꼈다고?

Body:
겨우 하나의 시련을 넘겼어.

동료들은 지금 은신처에 숨어서 몸을 추스리는 중이야.

시련과 시련.. 살아남기 위해 죽음을 각오하고 싸워야한다니 그란드라큐몬의 말이 생각나는군.

…그 힘은 나로선 알 수가 없어. 일단 동글몬을 찾아가봐. 그 친구라면 뭔가 알고 있을 거야.
Process: 고생했어. 네 세계로 돌아가서 정비하도록 해.
Complete:
아, 다시 돌아왔구나 동글!!
음? 뭘 봤다고 동글?

Body:
그건.. 특별한 X-항체의 힘이 피어난 것 같다 동글.

아마 오메가몬 안에 있었던 잠재력이 싸움에서 나온 것 같다 동글.

아무래도 오메가몬이랑 싸우면 그 힘의 근원이 나올 것 같아 동글.

최근에 수수께끼 X-항체 인자이란 걸 스캔하면 여러 인자들이 나온다고 하니까

그걸로도 찾아봐 동글!
Process: 구하기 힘들겠지만... 새로운 힘을 위해서 힘내 동글!
Complete:
다 됐어 동글!!
새로운 힘에 적하려면 너의 레벨이 99이어야 하고
디지몬의 레벨은 99이어야만 해 동글.
레벨이 준비되면 오메가몬을 찾아가봐 동글

Body:
자 이제 오메가몬을 찾아가봐 동글.

오메가몬의 뜻은 아까와 같은 걸까 동글?
Process: 어서 가봐 동글!
Complete:
그 항체를 다시 찾아냈나보군.

내게 다시 말을 걸도록.
Expert: 왔군 인간. 그리고 가능성의 디지몬.

TitleText: Master Sitting on an Empty Seat
Body:
The empty seat… was that Digimon indeed.

Yggdrasil is justice. But through my old friend Gallantmon, I was doubtful to my thoughts. Willing to survive is an instinct. However, Yggdrasil is denying all these facts.

So I began to question myself. What it another justice? Is there answere to this question?

Now, please show me. The true justice you were talking about.
Process: Gallantmon, what have you been thinking?
Complete: Congratulations on becoming the master of the empty throne.

Body:
The empty seat… was that Digimon indeed.

Yggdrasil created absolute power to prevent Royal Knights from getting crazy. And the justice was put under the absolute power.

I began to wonder as I heard what Gallantmon said.
Process: Alphamon, and Ouryuken. Where will your sword point at now?
Complete:
Congratulations on becoming the master of the empty throne.

Use 'X-Antibody Factor: Alphamon Ouryuken Beta' to expand the evolution slot.

Body:
I can sence dark towers radiating strong negative energy from everywhere of Digital World, culu!
And the energy seems to be especially fierce from the Western Areas of Digital World, culu!
My friend Patamon left to investigate the area, so if you go there, you'll be able to meet Patamon, culu!
Process:
Patamon should be at somewhere in the Dark Tower Wastelands, culu!
Ask Patamon about the situation and you'll hear something helpful, culu!
Complete:
Welcome, my friends!
I'll tell you what's going on here!

Body:
I found a spider army constructing the Dark Towers.
There are lots of them, and the red spider Archnemon is their leader.
Please stop Archnemon and her minions before they become a big threat to the entire Digital World!
Process: Archnemon and her spider army are heading for Western Area: Outskirts.
Complete:
Thanks, my friend!
The world is one step closer to peace now!

Body:
Breaking news, my friend! The spider army that you confront was not the only suspect responsible for the evil plan!
A swarm of Flymons and Okuwamons are in rage to avenge for their leader Archnemon in the Wilderness Area!
Please go to the Wilderness Area and save our friendly Digimons from the risk!
Process: The swarm of Okuwamons are found from the center of Wilderness Area.
Complete:
Thanks, my friend!
Western Area became much safer now!

Body:
With your help, Digital World is free from potential threats, culu!
Thank you!
Complete: This Jogress is new and powerful, culu!

Body:
Good to see you again, culu. Your old master, that mad kid has caused lots of trouble and Digital World is in risk now.
Not to blame you, but if you can help the situation, head to the Ice Area and meet Hawkmon there, culu!
My friend Hawkmon left to investigate the area, so if you go there, you'll be able to meet Hawkmon, culu!
Process:
Hawkmon should be at somewhere in the Frozen Ground, culu!
Ask Hawkmon about the situation and you'll hear something helpful, culu!
Complete:
Oh, a reinforcement has arrived?
Then, I'll brief you the situation first!

Body:
I saw IceDevimon and Mojyamons constructing Dark Towers in this area.
I see that you've come a far distance to help us.
Then I'll guide you what to do from now.
IceDevimon is the leader in the group. So when you strike him down, the Dark Towers won't be increased anymore.
Process: IceDevimon is found from Snowstorm Village!
Complete:
Thanks, my friend!
Your passion is warm enough to let us stand in this cold place!

Body:
There's a bad news! It seems Apemons and Mojyamons that already contaminated by the Dark Towers are rampaging in Distorted Data Village! I guess we need your help one more time!
Please go to Distorted Data Village and stop the rampaging Apemons and Mojyamons!
Process: Apemons and Mojyamons are rampaging from Distorted Data Village!
Complete:
Thanks, my friend!
Ice Area became much safer now!

Body:
With your help, Digital World is free from potential threats, culu!
Thank you!
Complete: This Jogress is new and powerful, culu!

Body:
Culu!
I sence the energy of Dark Towers in the Real World now clearly, culu!

This means the Real World is in a risk, so go to Sampson immediately!
Process: Dark Towers in Real World is a very big disaster, culu!
Complete: I was expecting you to come. We have a situation now!

Body:
We have an emergency situation!
Dark Towers have created a monster in the Real World.
This creation of Dark Towers possess power transcending our presumptions!
We don't have a chance to face that monster directly.
Please ask Calumon if there are any countermeasures.
Complete: Creation of the Dark Towers? That's horrible… culu.

Body:
So master Sampson does not have any plans? That's a pity, culu.
However, we can't just give up and leave the Real World into danger.
I've been saving Qinglongmon's Digicore until now, and it seems to possess unmeasurably enormous energy inside it, culu!
Now is the time to use this to face the evil, culu!
Complete: Qinglongmon's Digicore has the ability to maximize your power, culu!

Body:
Good enough, culu!
With this power, you'll be able to face and defeat the incarnation of Dark Towers, culu!
Please get rid of the horrible monster from this world, culu!
Process: I sence Dark Tower energy from the Oil Refinery, culu!
Complete: Thank you, culu! The world regains peace once again! Culu!

Body:
Culu!
I sence the energy of Dark Towers in the Real World now clearly, culu!

This means the Real World is in a risk, so go to Sampson immediately!
Process: Dark Towers in Real World is a very big disaster, culu!
Complete: I was expecting you to come. We have a situation now!

This creation of Dark Towers possess power transcending our presumptions!
We don't have a chance to face that monster directly.
Please ask Calumon if there are any countermeasures.
Complete: Creation of the Dark Towers? That's horrible… culu.

However, we can't just give up and leave the Real World into danger.
I've been saving Qinglongmon's Digicore until now, and it seems to possess unmeasurably enormous energy inside it, culu!
Now is the time to use this to face the evil, culu!
Complete: Qinglongmon's Digicore has the ability to maximize your power, culu!

Body:
Good enough, culu!
With this power, you'll be able to face and defeat the incarnation of Dark Towers, culu!
Please get rid of the horrible monster from this world, culu!
Process: I sence Dark Tower energy from the Oil Refinery, culu!
Complete: Thank you, culu! The world regains peace once again! Culu!

Body:
Culu!
I sence a great evil Digimon in the Real World again, culu!

Go and talk to master Sampson, Culu!
Complete: You must have heard from Calumon. Good to have you here.

Body: The evil Digimon identified as SkullSatamon is found in the middle of Yokohama Village. It is much stronger than the common SkullSatamon we know. Much likely to be affected by Dark Towers. Go to Yokohama Village right now and save the people out there!
Process: SkullSatamon doesn't seem to have reached deep inside the village yet. But there isn't much time, so you'd better hurry!
Complete:
The energy is truly incredible. Is this the true aspect of Dark Towers?
Anyway, you've done an excellent job!

Body:
Culu!
I sence a great evil Digimon in the Real World again, culu!

Go and talk to master Sampson, Culu!
Complete: You must have heard from Calumon. Good to have you here.

Body: The evil Digimon identified as SkullSatamon is found in the middle of the Oil Refinery. It is much stronger than the common SkullSatamon we know. Much likely to be affected by Dark Towers. Go to Oil Refinery right now and save the people out there!
Process: SkullSatamon was found in the middle of Oil Refinery. The place is still quiet, but you'd better not waste time!
Complete:
The energy is truly incredible. Is this the true aspect of Dark Towers?
Anyway, you've done an excellent job!

Body:
Project Ark has been resumed and New Digital World is being stabilized.
But the intruders from old Digital World is creating chaos to New Digital World and it's becoming a mess.
I'm a messenger of Yggdrasil, and you're partner of Omegamon. So you should do your part with responsibility, human. Did you make up your mind?
Process: The order is upto Yggdrasil.
Complete: Are you prepared?

Body:
You should get rid of the intruders.
It's time for an execution!
Simple:
Defeat Dorumon
Defeat Dracmon
Defeat FanBeemon
Defeat Kunemon
Process: When you're done with the task, return to me.
Complete: You've done well. Here's the data with the voucher.

Body:
You should get rid of the intruders who oppose to Yggdrasil's plan.
Now stick to the plan!
Process: When you're done with the task, return to me.
Complete: Good job. Now I can move on.

Body:
Gallantmon denied to join us. He is questioning on Yggdrasil's decisions.

But our will is strong. Please tell him that.
Process: So you know where Gallantmon is at?
Complete: You must be the partner of Omegamon?
Expert: I find something odd.

TitleText: A Friend on the Other Side
Body:
Is that really the will of rest of the Royal Knights?
Human, what do you think about that?
About why this massacre has to be occurred. They're even trying to execute the ones who are about to die by X-Program.

I see. If that is your choice, you'll have to go through me first. Find me in another place.
Process: This is not the place to fight. I'll be moving to another area.
Complete: Gallantmon?
Expert: You're here.

Body:
A friend has left us…
But we can't lose the Digital World.
I've heard that there are intruders we had never seen before.
To deal with them, we need more information about them.
Please defeat Okuwamon and colllect some data.
Process: Okuwamon will reveal itself when you defeat Kunemon and their evovled ones.
Complete: You've brought the data of Okuwamon. Good! I'll start the examination.

Body:
X-evolution… Gallantmon has once said that.
The recent strangers must be related with it.
They are known to evolve by forms that are much stronger than the normal forms.
Please investigate them.
Simple:
Defeat Dorumon
Defeat Dorugamon
Defeat DoruGreymon
Process: They exist on Verdandi Terminal Desert.
Complete: How was the investigation? Did you find a clue?

Body:
This investigation starts from just a theory, so we need more information.

Please collect the data from those Digimons and hand them over to me. I think I can find a clue.
Process: The collecting of data is necessary for investigation.
Complete: I think this will be enough. Thanks.

Body:
I've been examining on the data you brought me.
Meanwhile, there is a possible threat found from somewhere.
A strong Digimon is found from the place where we found Dorumon last time.
It may become an obstacle for Project Ark, so we should deal with it.
Process: It will show itself when you defeat the Dorumons.
Complete: Have it been eliminated? Then we should have no problem on proceeding Project Ark.

Body:
X-evolution isn't part of Yggdrasil's plans.
The Digimon is just a mere experiment of Yggdrasil.

A Digimon to bring new order to the Digital World.

But how did it evolve into something that oppose Yggdrasil's will?
Complete: …What is this feeling?

Body:
Yggdrasil has executed a new Project Ark.
But it's not natural.
Destroying the world, that seems to be too impatient as a decision Yggdrasil would make.
Process: I've never heard of such plan!!
Complete: What? You mean you're going there?

Body:
Wait. The gate has been damaged by them, so you may not return when you go throught it now.
I think we should reduce their number first to prevent the gate being destroyed.
Please go and get them.
Process: Hurry! There is no time to waste!
Complete: Thanks. With your help, the gate is maintaining.

Body:
DexDoruGreymons left suspicious traces of data.
We need to find out where they come from.
Please collect the data and stop them from destroying the gate.
Process: I can find out where they come from when you bring the data.
Complete: This will be enough data. I'll start examining.

Body:
The data has been examined.
DexDoruGreymons are coming from the very center of Royal Base.
Are you really going to the center?

I see. You should have made up your mind. I'll hand you over the device.
[Condition: X-evolution quest [Ready to Risk Lives] completed]
Process: Things are getting more complicated.
Complete: You've came. Omegamon, and his partner.
Expert: We have unexpected enemies.

Body:
Yggdrasil has summoned Dexmon.

It seems Yggdrasil does not want to communicate with us.

Are you prepared to fight back?
Process: Watch yourself.
Complete: It's good to see you safe, human.
Expert: Is it finally peace now?

Body:
X-evolution… it is the will of life itself.
A will confronting death.
A form of hope in middle of darkness that fear and despair gave birth to.
I bet Yggdrasil is aware of it too.
Even though the incarnation of it was just Dexmon.
Do you want to understand the whole thing?
First you need the proof of it.
Process: The proof is with Dexmon now.
Complete:
So Yggdrasil also had it too.
Life that confronts death is more desperate.
I bet no one wants to die, for whatever the reason is.
So is the will of survival before death.
The records that you brought seems to speak for Yggdrasil.

Body: This is the strength to survive.
Complete: I hope you found the true means of survival.

Body:
Someone has called the Royal Knights, culu!

You're Omegamon's partner, so you should be there too!

Go on now to Verdandi Terminal, culu!
Process: I don't feel good about this, culu…
Complete: Omegamon, and human. I was expecting.
Expert: Project Ark has just begun.

Body:
Welcome. Meanwhile, I was about to find you, and you came to me.
So, do you know about Diablomon?
In the past, Diablomon has planned to destroy the Real World by distorting the data of Nuclear Missiles to launch them and strike the entire World.
I have a request for you to do dealing with this dangerous monster. Would you like to hear more?
Process: I have a feeling that this request may be very intense.
Complete: As I've expected! I knew you would accept my request.

Body:
Then I shall continue my speech.
Diablomon was once defeated by the chosen ones, brave children long time ago.
I was thinking Diablomon had vanished… but that was just a delusion.
Diablomon had backup data of itself, and it revived in current Digital World.
So what do you think of this story?
Do you still think you can handle a request with such great risk?
Process: The task may be very risky, but at least I can trust you on it.
Complete: Thank you! I had confidence that you would listen to my request. Hohoho…

Body:
I'll end my speech shortly.
Diablomon has been acting suspicious ever since it was revived.
Witness has said that it seem to transfer data to someone in Real World.
But there is no clue who it may be, and Diablomon was trying to hide the identity of whomever it was contacting.
Go and ask chief Sampson, as he knows Real World better than me.
Process: Thanks for listening to my request.
Complete:
Here you are.
I'll explain shortly and clearly.
So I want you to focus.
Expert: Talk to Richard Sampson

Body:
From what White-bearded Guru, Diablomon seem to be contacting someone in the Real World.
We have no information what the data is, and what their purpose is.
However, I have a strong feeling that the cooperater of Diablomon is Akihiro Kurata.
There could be no one else to do something insane like this.
But we can't suspect him without any evidences.
Go talk to director Hashima for now, as he may have a clue about Kurata.
Complete:
Location of Akihiro Kurata? Why would you want to know that?
Has the man caused trouble again?

Body:
That is absolutely right. Only a man like Kurata would think of such madness.
However, he seems to wake up and live quietly these days.
Could he be planning something stupid again from behind us?
I know it's not good to doubt other people, but it's obvious he's been doing so many stupid things so far.
I've recently heard that Kurata is researching something in Dark Tower Wastelands.
You may be able to find the answer from there.
Process: I don't want anymore trouble caused by Akihiro Kurata.
Complete: Huh?? What brings you all the way here, young agent of DATS?

Body:
Diablomon?
Yes, I've heard that name before. That creature seems to be totally nuts.
Launching all nuclear missiles from all over the world simultaneously? That could have created a very spectacle view!
Haha… it was just a lame joke, don't make a serious face.
I know what you think of me, but I'm not that kind of a freak.
And I haven't even seen this monster, so called Diablomon.
So I want you to get out of my face when you have no more business.
Process: What's holding you up? I thought you have no more business on me.
Complete: Did you realize that you're wrong to judge me?

Body:
If you really do, then let's talk about some business.

There's a Digimon I was researching personally, but the research data about it was taken by a green bug.
Bugs are bugs after all. They're disgusting.

You get the data back to me.
Get rid of those green bugs too so they don't bug me anymore.
Simple:
Defeat Dark Wormmon
Collect Akihiro Kurata's Research Data
Helper:
%qs1Defeat Dark Wormmon%qe  %cc1/%mc1
%qs2Collect Akihiro Kurata's Research Data%qe  %cc2/%mc2
Process:
They should be around this place.
Many legs, but not very fast…
Complete:
I appreciate your help.
I hope you got rid of those bugs definitely.
And you haven't peeked on my research data?

Body:
What? Who told you that you can look into my research data? If I didn't say it, you shouldn't have looked at it.
Haven't you been taught in school not to touch things that don't belong to you? It is common sense.
Armagemon is a Digimon which everything is obscure.
And I'm a scientist. What do scientists do?
They study about the unknown domains, don't they?
So my research is for the knowledge of mankind!
Stop looking at me like if I'm a mad scientist!
Seems like our businss is done now, so why don't you leave?
Complete: What? Did you just say Armagemon?

TitleText: Getting a Clue from Doctor Kurata
Body:
Armagemon? That name came out of Akihiro Kurata's mouth?
That is something frightening.
It's a Digimon that we only know it's name. Everything else are under veil.
I wouldn't worry if it was another scientist who do the research, but it is Akihiro Kurata.
I'm worried that this creature may appear in the Real World just like Belphemon did last time.
From now, you can stay near him and watch over him to see if he's doing anything suspicious.
If you find out, report to me at once.
Process:
Akihiro will certainly have doubts in you when he sees you again, but in other hand, he won't deny your help on his research.
He'll try to use you. It's not something very pleasant, but right now, that's the only way to find out what he's at.
So go and help him to find out what he's planning to do!
Complete: Why did you come back here again?

Body:
By the looks of you, I can tell you've been ordered to watch me. Right?
Haha… I'm a scientist, not an idiot. But that's fine with me.
You're not going to stare me all day here, so why don't you do me a favor?
I'm sure your chief don't want you to just keep staring at me like that.
I suppose you figured out Armagemon is a Digimon of unknown attribute?
There are more Digimons with the same attribute. They're Keramon, Chrysalimon, Infermon and all of them are in the Digimon Maze.
What you can do now is to collect Keramon's data for me.
So I can restart with my research again.
Process: You can find Keramon from Digimon Maze F1. I look forward to take a look of that data.
Complete: Finished so quickly? Good. Let's see what you've got.

Body:
Keramon, they devour massive amount of data.
They seem to enhance and evolute themselves out of it.
So if I research its data, I expect to find some interesting results.
Haha… to be honest, I appreciate your effort for bringing me such precious data.
Complete: That's good. Now, I want you to carry the backup data for just in case. I may lose the data when research fails, but I don't want that to happen.
Expert: Talk to Akihiro Kurata

Body:
Now, it's time to continue research on Chrysalimon.
It's a evoluted form of Keramon.
Get me its data for me so I can go on.
Meanwhile, I have to look more deeply into current data.
Process: Chrysalimons can be found from Digimon Maze F2. I wonder how the data will look like.
Complete: It took you more time than before. Did you get into trouble or something? Ah… nevermind.

Body:
Chrysalimon can evolute into next form when a lot of them are gathered together.
So if we could amplify its feature, something magnificent may happen.
For example, if I inject some kind of a vector to help the evolution, it may exceed the standard evolutionary stage.
It's just a theory yet, but who knows?
Complete: That's good. Now, I want you to carry the backup data for just in case. I may lose the data when research fails, but I don't want that to happen.

Body:
Now, I'm eager to research on Mega Digimon Infermon which is evoluted from Chrysalimon!

So what are you hesitating for?
Isn't it obvious that I need Infermon's data now?
Go and bring me the data of Infermon, immediatey.
We must not waste time on such a important moment!
Process: Infermons are in Digimon Maze F3. Value your time and be quick!
Complete:
What took you so long? I thought you lost in the maze.
Now, hand me the data.

Body:
Infermon hides its face and legs to its body and can greatly be enhanced on durability.

It becomes dull when it's hiding its face and leg into body, but when I research its data, I think I can extract the secret of durability only.

Thanks to you for bringing me such precious data.
Complete: That's good. Now, I want you to carry the backup data for just in case. I may lose the data when research fails, but I don't want that to happen.

Body:
You're doing great on watching over Akihiro Kurata.

Now you can return to headquarters and report of his actions, over.
Complete: Now, report about Akihiro Kurata.

Body:
The data he asked you to bring are of Keramon, Chrysalimon, and Infermon?
They have one in common, that they are all subordinates of Diablomon.
Then the assumption that Akihiro Kurata being connected with Diablomon should be true.
I'm not sure, but I think I'll have to interrogate after having him arrested.
Hopefully, he didn't get Diablomon's data yet, so we must have him arrested at stop the risk immediately.
Go to Dark Tower Wasteland and bring Akihiro Kurata at once!
Process: Akihiro Kurata is about to call a disaster again.
Complete: Hey, there! Just a second! We have a situation here!

Body:
We're in an emergency state! A Digimon with huge data has realized in D-Terminal B1!
Chief Sampson isn't aware of it yet, so please make a report to him as soon as possible!
Process: This is not good at all. I hope for no more trouble now.
Complete: What brings you back so early? Have you forgot something?

Body:
What? A Digimon with huge data has realized in D-Terminal B1?

A realize of huge data in a time when there is a great risk… that is awkward…

But the situation here must be taken care sooner.
Go to D-Terminal B1 and deal with the crisis there first.
Process: If the cause is Akihiro Kurata, the whole incidents probably won't end so easily.
Complete:
It's you again? What took you so long?
I almost fell asleep while waiting.

Body:
Welcome back, my faithful cooperator.

I successfully precede my research with your support.
You seem to be surprised?
Since you haven't brought me the data of Diablomon, but I manged to complete the research.
But from the beginning, Diablomon's data wasn't necessary at all. Didn't you notice it?
Have you had no idea who I was collaborating with?

Anyway, the incarnation of Armagemon is near!
Meanwhile, shall we play along with Diablomon?
Complete:
Hmm… that was faster than I thought.
Diablomon gets weaker once it starts splitting.
But I guess that was enough to buy some time.
Look now my friend, the time is over.

Body:
So Akihiro Kurata has caused another disaster.
I'm really sorry to give you tough tasks to you only, but in the other hand, there is no one else reliable.
I'll have to ask you to stop Armagemon and the ambitions of Akihiro Kurata!
Complete:
Don't you ever get tired of chasing me?
Is it because you're also eager to see Armagemon? (chuckles)

Body:
As an expression of gratitude for my loyal supporter, I'll show you the most splendid and glorious moment!
Open your eyes wide, and take a look at the masterpiece, Armagemon!!

It's Show Time~!!
Complete:
Aaaaaaaaaahhhhhhh!!!!
No way! This can't be true! It doesn't add up!!
You've tormented me by giving me a hope and then smashing it into pieces!!
But I never give up! At least before I see the true aspects of this world!
You'll never stop me!!

Body:
Did you defeat Armagemon?

I'm impressed again.
You've done such a great job.
Now you can return to headquarters!
Complete:
You've done great.
There is something you should do to put this to an end.

Body:
Akihiro Kurata never leaves us in peace.
Now we should think of what to do with the remaining data after Diablomon and Armagemon are defeated.

This isn't something for me to decide, so go and ask White-bearded Guru.
Process:
Treat the old man with manners when you ask him a question.
I'm confident that he'll give you the right answer.
Complete: Welcome back. I've heard what you did from chief Sampson.

Body:
Diablomon and Armagemon's remaining data?
Of course, it could be a headache.

It splits and multiplies itself, so we can't be relieved even though it's just a file of data.
Then there is just one answer to it.

We should keep an eye on it.
You are capable of defeating Armagemon, so it should be easy for you to take care of Armagemon.
I'll help you with it too, of course.

Use this vaccine program to surppress the destructive instincts. Then you'll be able to handle it.
Complete:
Please take care of it well.
I hope the burden isn't too much for you to carry on.

Body:
Have you heard of the news? File Island was under attack by a single Digimon, culu! As you may know, File Island is packed with lots of strong monsters, but they seem to be defeated by that Digimon. I really wonder who that'd be, culu!
Don't you want to know who it is too? If you get to know the answer, can you tell me to, culu? From what I've heard, it's a name called BlitzGreymon, culu!
Process: I really eager to know who it is~
Complete: I do not have time to play with little kids like you. So don't try to waste my time.
Expert: You look too weak to be considered as a challenger. Did you just come here to see who I am?

Body: Listen to me kid. I don't have time for jokes nor play with you. I don't even feel the needs to continue this conversation. But if you're here to challenge me, it'd be a whole different story. Even though you don't look to be so strong, I'll give you a chance if that is your will. I'm going to move on, so if you really want to challenge me, you'll confront me there.
Process: If you change your mind, that's fine. Because that's nature's fate.
Complete: Impressive! You're much stronger than I first expected. So what brought you here?

Body:
Calumon? The one who wants to see me? I've heard the name before. If I remember it correctly, it must be the one who knows the secret of evolution. I thought it was just a made up story or a myth, but you're telling me it's real? That draws my attention. Because if it's true, it can be very useful. So far, I was seeking for more power. If this guy reveals the secrets of evolution, I may be able to find a path to new evolultion.
Can you guide me to this guy? I'd like to meet and have a conversation myself.
Process: Lead the way, I'll follow.
Complete: Culu~? Who is this… oh wait! You must be the dominator of…!

Body: You came all the way to me for something, culu? Why? Do you want to know the secrets of evolution? I can understand. But I'm not going to help someone who is not qualified, culu! So what is the standard of qualify? That is not an easy matter, but if you still want to prove yourself, show it to me, culu! Engage GrandisKuwagamon in File Island, defeat at least 5 of them and come back! If you succeed, I'll think positively.
Process: But you're already strong enough, culu. Why seek for more?
Complete: Wow, you're strong and stubborn indeed! I thought you might give up, culu!

Body:
But promise is a promise, culu. BlitzGreymon, you've reached Mega form all by yourself, and that is very remarkable. However, you've reached a limit and cannot evolve further by yourself, since you've evolved in a different form compared to WarGreymon. But hopefully, you may still be able to evolve further by Jogress evolution. To make this possible, you need to find MetalGarurumon that made a different type of evolution. If you wish to continue, find and bring that MetalGarurumon of different evolution form.
Luckily, I have a good news for you. People said that MetalGarurumon of a different form had been found from Infinite Ice Wall. But that's all I know now, so I guess the rest is up to you.
Simple: Find Another Type of MetalGarurumon and Talk
Helper: %qs1Find Another Type of MetalGarurumon and Talk%qe  %cc1/%mc1
Process: It won't be easy to find though, culu.
Complete: I wasn't expecting to see you here.
Expert: Hmm… You must be?

Body: So we meet again in an unexpected place, BlitzGreymon. But first thing is first. I was in middle of conflict between me and a group of SaberLeomon. I can see that you've not come all the way here to fight me again. If so, why don't you help me first? Help me to chase away SaberLeomon, about 20 of them. After it's done, we can talk.
Process: Such a mess, huh? I'm sorry to drag you into a fuss even though you came from a long distance.
Complete: Now we can talk.

Body:
The last aspects of you I remember was a berserker who's only crazy about battle, but you look different now. Have you found enlightenment or something? The day I encountered you in File Island seems clear like yesterday, yet you've changed a lot. So what brought you here? Oh, a new type evolution Digimon? Shall I call this a fate or a coincidence? I'm CresGarurumon, another type of evolution from MetalGarurumon.

So you came to me without noticing? I see. But I haven't heard that further evolution is possible. I want to reveal the truth. All right, I'll follow you this time to find the answer. Please guide me to Calumon now.
Process: Haha… I have high hopes now.
Complete: Culu? Is he the one?

Body: Oh, you came earlier than I expected, culu. Anyway, regarding to my knowledge, you two can unite together and evolve into a complete new form, culu. It's called Jogress evolution, and the basic concept of it is equal to WarGreymon and MetalGarurumon's. Because you guys come from the same root. As it has been said, there is a Jogress form of WarGreymon and MetalGarurumon near us, culu. How about having a little conversation with Omegamon?
Process: What I told you is just a theory, but with high possibility. You may bring a surprising result if it succeeds, culu.
Complete: Good to see you, brave warriors. I'm Omegamon.
Expert: So you've came.

Body:
I'm Omegamon, Jogress form of WarGreymon and MetalGarurumon, as you may already know. Straight to the point, I can tell you that you also have the possibility to evolve into Jogress form. However, great power of Omegamon comes with great responsibility in the Digital World. If you need my assistance, let me test you to see if you're fully prepared for your Jogress evolution.

I'm looking forward for a positive result, as you have a good chance to become Omegamon yourself.
Process: There's plenty of time, so you don't need to rush.
Complete: I've checked your probabilities. You're ready for your next form, Omegamon.

Body: From now on, Calumon who knows the secret of evolution will guide you the path to Omegamon. I hope you'll contribute to achieving peace and glory in Digital World. I wonder what you'll look like.
Process: Go and talk to Calumon now.
Complete: A new type of Omega? It makes me curious too, culu!
Expert: You should have passed the test I guess!

Body: Great! You must have faced a long and harsh journey, culu! New type of Omegamon! Let's call you Omegamon Alter-S, culu!
Complete: Congratulations to become one of OMEGA! Omegamon Alter-S, culu!!

I couldn't bare to ignore such smell.

Wizardmon! We can't waste our time here.
Let's finish them quickly and move to the Hideout!
But first, let's defeat Swimmon first!

I think so, Wizardmon.
But we should not let our guards down yet.
More of Swimmon are swarming to this place.
We should make a way through and get out of here.

Oops. I guess it's not the right time to think of such thing.

Gatomon, we may have missed something.
These guys are guards. Which means, some of them may have the key to Hideout.
Complete:
Leave the hypnosis to me. I'll take care of hypnotizing Swimmon.
Myotismon is a very cunning creature, so the front gate may have more locks.
We may happen to find more keys.
Expert:
That is absolutely right.
I almost missed that part.
By the way, Wizardmon, which of them may have the key?

Now, I'll try the hypnosis agasint Swimmon.

Hey, Swimmon… listen and answer to me carefully.
First question, who has the key to Myotismon's Hideout?
Second question, what else is needed to open the Hideout's locked door?
Finally, where is Myotismon right now?
Complete:
Gatomon, I've discovered everything we need.
Apartment key can be found from Swimmon(Guard), and there are 3 keys in total.
Expert:
The key… is held by one of the Swimmon guards…
And to enter… Hideout… requires… total three… three keys…
Myotismon… has left… to have… a proper meal…

Body:
Well done, Wizardmon!
Let's find Swimon(Guard) and claim the Hideout's Key!
Simple: Defeat Swimmon(Guard) and collect First Hideout's Key
Complete: Gatomon!! I've found the Hideout's key!!

Very good!! Wizardmon, I think we're done here, so let's keep moving!
Keep your eyes open to see if there are any more guards while we're on the way, so we can find the second key fast!
Complete:
Gatomon…!
Someone seems to be in front of here!
Expert:
I got it, Gatomon.
I'll take a good look for it.

I was expecting you.
But you're later than I thought.
Complete:
That's right…

Hey, Tylomon. How did you know we'll be here now?

So there are more guards and they are sharks?
They look tougher than Swimmon I guess.

That's because I can smell your scent.
And I know that you've been fighting against our army.
I can sence that too.
Complete:
Myotismon may be aware of us too…
That we've turned back on him.
Expert:
Is that so?
That also means…

Body:
Well, do you think Myotismon is aware of your betrayal, or not?
In fact, that isn't really the point.
Because your miserable journey is going to end here, soon.
Just give up your hopes and don't try to resist!
Complete:
It doesn't sound like a lie, Gatomon.
I've managed to deal with the ones who approached.
But it looks like we're going to spend more time here.

Don't give up, Wizardmon!
We need to hurry! This time, Myotismon is not in his Hideout and it is our chance!!
We should take these sharks out and head to the Hideout!
Let's finish it quickly and move on!
Complete: I think we're almost done dealing with them. Shall we get out of this place, Gatomon?

You arrogant traitors!
We've not finished our business yet, so where are you trying to go now?
What you saw from us is not the real us!
Let me show you what real terror is!!

Tylomon(Megalodon) Emerges When You Defeat 25 Tylomon(Captain)
Defeat Tylomon(Megalodon)
Complete:
What in the world!?
What made the sharks so big?

Yes, I'm fine and not hurt anywhere.
But I couldn't find the second key to Hideout.
There's a chance that the key can be in one of Tylomon's body, so I'll continue the search.

Since there are more Tylomon that we didn't encounter yet, I think it's best to find the rest of information from them.

I'm sure some of remaining Tylomon have information about the third key.

Tylomon has confessed of where the third key is!
It's held by one of Bakemon.
So now we just have to look for Bakemon.

Gatomon seems to be worried about Hikari.

But you won't have to worry very much.
I've checked for any sign of aggressive Digimon moving towards Hikari's house yet.

At this moment, we have to make haste on reaching Myotismon's Hideout.
Our objective is to get the real Crest of Light.
When it's done, Gatomon doesn't have to worry about Hikari anymore.

Hikari will be just fine. Her brother is with her too.
But actually, I do worry about her.
I'm not even sure if Tai is trustworthy.
Wizardmon, let's hurry finding Bakemon.
I can never be relieved about Hikari.

Wait!! Something flashed from a distance!!
There must be a fight going on that location.
I don't think the two of them can stand the fight.
We should go and help them!

Let's speed up Agumon!
I hope we're not late.

Hikari, you should stay home.

Uh…well, all right Taichi.
Then please take care of yourself~! Agumon too~!
I hope Gatomon is safe.

What are you chattering about??
Are you secretly talking of conspiracy in front of us who serve lord Myotismon?
How arrogant!
Complete:
Taichi, they were bad guys after all.
I've once thought they were someone's pets, but if they're related with Myotismon, they must be evil inside.
Taichi, help me to evolve~!

They're much tougher than they look.
Who would imaging bird's bill can be such a deadly weapon.

Really? It's quite annoying…

What made you come back to my Hideout?

Your excuses are useless as we'll figure that out eventually…

Go to Taichi's Apartment

Take them down and save the people in this area!

Take all the humans here.

We'll take them as captives.
This is a direct order of lord Myotismon!

You little arrogant kids again!

Let's retreat for now.

This place is too dangerous to stay, we must get out…

Ever since the fog appeared in this city, all communications, transportations have been cut.

After that, monsters that I've never seen before in my life have invaded the streets all of a sudden and began kidnapping all the civilians of Odaiba.

Follow me. I'll guide you to a place where you and your friends can hide.

Unfortunately, I can't stay.
I must go to the Fuji TV station to contact others and alert them about this place.
The place is invaded by the monsters, but I know a secret passage inside the building.
Gabumon, is that right?
Please keep Matt safe!

You have my word, son.
Don't you worry about me and stay put in this place!
Once the people find out about the conditions of this city, they'll send reinforcements.

If we had Taichi together, we could try…

Taichi?
How did you come here?

Prepare for your evolution, Agumon!

I smell an existence of valuable prey from somewhere…
Scent of a human… along with 8th Chosen Child's Digivice.

Darn! The Duplicated Crest of Light they have must be reacting to Hikari's Digivice!
I guess we have no other choice than to eliminate them!

Human child… such a shame that your wishes won't come true.

You should have not underestimated us, boys.
And I'll return your words back to you.
Give up the Digivice and run away as fast as you can if you value your lives!
The place you occupied doesn't belong to you.

What kind of nonsence is that? Do you really think I'd give up this thing so easily?
MetalGreymon, show them no mercy!

Wait! It's true that we've misjudged you!
Please let us stay! I know you aren't a mean type of human.
Understand that we don't want to do this either.
We are actually mere victims of Myotismon.
We are just following him to live because we have been threatened.
We also prefer peace, just like you guys do!

Is that so? I can understand that…
You guys are poor beings… is probably what you want to hear from me. Isn't it?
But I don't really trust strangers.

I know, I know! I was an attacker just a moment ago, so you won't probably trust me.
Even I would do the same if I were you.
But just try me for once! Give me a chance to gain your trust!
I can prove you that I'm not loyal to Myotismon!
We can help each other!

Do you mean it? Like I said, I don't trust strangers, I don't really trust you.
But I'll give you time to finish your words.
So you were talking to prove what?

Thanks! You're kind and clever as I first thought!
I could tell the difference from you and other humans!

First, let me guide you. You follow me and I'll show you.

Talk to Taichi

Digimon who has the appearance of ragged teddy bear like you saw, but an ultimate form of Digimon.

Just do as what I say, and you'll find out that you can trust on us too.

You were right. They're very strong as you said.
Will this be enough?

That's it? More simple that I first expected.
I can see that they're belonging to Myotismon.
Then let's play along, shall we, MetalGreymon?

Open your eyes wide, my friend!
The guys you took out were just part of them.
They weren't the strongest among the group and that won't affect Myotismon at all.

Those ones are the strong ones among them.
When you take them out, it will definitely work on distracting Myotismon!

What are you hesitating for?
You're not giving up after coming all this way until now, aren't you? Take their Army Captains out and return to me!

(Gasp) Oh, wow… they really are stronger than the others.

So… WereGarurumon(Black)!! Is it done now?

Oh?? What? You've done with something?

Have you swiped out all Army Captains?
Are you serious about that?

What? Are you trying to play a joke on us?
It isn't funny at all!

Go easy kid. Hold your temper.
I had no doubts on you. I was just sounding you out.
I can see that WaruMonzaemon did reduce in numbers.
Good job, good job.

You're finally on the last stage of mission now.
Be proud of yourself.
The only remaining targets are WaruMonzaemon(Captain)! They are the actual leaders of them.

(More gasps) Ah… damn it…

Hey, WereGarurumon(Black)!!

I've done as your adivce and the army of WaruMonzaemon are basically all eliminated!

Ooohh. Outstanding! You really did eliminate most of them. I'm truly impressed.
You've done a good job.

So you guys must be exhausted by now, aren't you?
Why don't you take some rest now? In eternal peace…

Clearly, as you've heard. R.I.P!
It stands for Rest In Peace!
I know you are strong enough to fight WaruMonzaemon.
That's why I requested you to eliminate them.

However, you must have drained your energy on WaruMonzaemon army and now you've become nearly just an empty shell.

You get my point?
It's piece of cake for me and my friends to bury empty shells into ground. So long, human child and his foolish partner!

Cowardly bastards!

Defeat Knightmon
Defeat Knightmon(Army Captain)
Defeat Knightmon(Captain)

Now we just have one target left!

We're humiliated by losing our helms and armors!
I'll not forgive those human children that insulted us!

Knightmon(Cavalry Lord) Emerges When You Defeat Knight(Captain)
Defeat Knightmon(Cavalry Lord)

Wow, that was really a tough call…

Taichi… It's still too early to be at ease.
I can sence countless eyes staring at us from beyond the fog.
Maybe I could be wrong, but there are strong monsters in this area for sure.
Shall we explore a bit more, or find Gatomon and save Gatomon first?
What do you say, Taichi?

Taichi! It's them!
Watch yourself!

I feel like I want to go rescue Gatomon and Mimi.

If it follows us to Big Sight, it'll be nothing but a trouble.
MetalGreymon! Let's go find them!

These creatures must be…?
Cerberumon, the hell hound from the stories?
Complete:
Hahaha. That's pretty much nothing.
I haven't realized that from a book.
I've heard from other people's conversations.
If there are hell hounds in this place, does that mean it's hell here?
Expert:
Oh… do you know about us?
I guess you read books often, don't you?

Body:
But well! They may look very dangerous, but basically are just pet dog of Myotismon I guess!
MetalGreymon, don't be afraid of them!
Let's just finish them off like we did so far!
Complete:
We've managed to get through them, but MetalGreymon is wounded.
These guys are quite tough enemies.
What shall we do now?

MetalGreymon's hard hands have been scratched.
It's probably caused by the claws of Cerberumon.
Because the claws look very sharp and hard.

If you do that, we can get rid of them more easily!

Body:
Without the sharp claws, they're not something we need to be afraid of!
Let's finish them off quickly!
Complete: Well, this is odd… When they've been disarmed, it must be easier to take them down, but why is the battle being slowed down?

Hmm… I find their sight suspicious.
As they have many eyes together, may take advantage for them in battle by reading our moves and avoiding from getting damaged.
If so, let's use baits! I'll throw bone sticks in front of them to distract them.
After that, we'll take them out quickly!

Complete: Mmm… Is this effective? Maybe not?

Treating us like dogs that humans have enslaved?
It's very unpleasant.
My comrades… Let's show the tingling taste to the human child and partner who disrespects us!

Great! You did well! MetalGreymon!
See what I told you? I told you we'd win the battle! Hahaha!!!
Expert:
Oh… I guess we just taunted them.
But fine! They should have lost their consciousness and won't perform their full ability!
MetalGreymon, let's be calm and fight against them! I'm sure we can win!

Agumon! What do you think of my plan?
'Taunt the enemies and cloud their judgement to blur their visions!'
Doesn't it make sence? Haha
Complete:
Of course~ Agumon!
I'd knew that these monsters will feel humiliated when they are treated as pet dogs.
Agumon, you have a lot more to learn about me!
Expert:
Is that true, Taichi?
Did you know that Cerberumon will get mad when you throw them the bone sticks?

Anyway, I think we've managed to eliminate all of Myotismon's army in this area!

Talk to Agumon
Go to Big Sight

Body:
Good to see you, human child and partner. The time of Winter is near us.
You should remember that last time Zhuqiaomon spread energy of Summer and did not retrieve them.
Unfortunately, Baihumon is doing the same thing. He's the youngest among us, so maybe he need to learn more.
Can you help to retrieve the energy?
"Purified Essence of Fall" that possess Baihumon's energy are permeated into his minion Meteormon, so you'll be able to find it from them.
Simple: Defeat <Baihumon's Minion> Meteormon and collect 50 Purified Essence of Fall
Process: Meteormon can be a trouble, but you should be able to handle them.
Complete: Good job. Now, here's your reward.

Body: New Digimon has joined Digital World. How about a duel against this new member?
Process: Have you made up your mind?
Complete: Good luck then.
Expert: Have you made up your mind?

Welcome, Culu! DigiXros evolution is an unique type of evolution, so it requires a special evolution chip, Culu.
So I'll give you DigiXros Evolution Chip each day for you, Culu.
Attach this on your Digivice and try the DigiXros evolution, Culu!
Process: Here, take this Evolution Chip, Culu!
Complete: Here it is, Culu! Experience the new power, Culu!

Body:
Hello, buddy!
Are you enjoying the 8th Anniversary festival?

I'm Candlemon and I'm in charge of setting up the fireworks.
However, I'm stuck right now, because the prepared fireworks are kind of unique.
They require some kind of unique amber, and it can be found from the Digital World only.
From what I know, they drop from DemiMeramon.

Can you do me a big favor, collecting those embers from <Kindling> DemiMeramon? I'll promise good reward if you do that for me, buddy!
Complete:
Thank you so much!! Now I can have my job done!
I'll give you some of the fireworks!
You'll see that they are very high-quality!

Body:
Greetings, human child and partner. Can we have a short conversation now?
I have a request for you.
The Royal Knights are getting stronger and stronger day by day influenced by X-Antibody, but I'm not fully confident with it.
Because the great power can bring great conflicts as a side effect, and I'm worried about that.

My request is that, if can you test the power to see if it can be used for right purposes and avoid unnecessary conflicts.
Will you accept my request?
Complete:
Thank you. When you're ready, take this with you to D-Terminal Summon Square.
You'll be able to summon UlforceVeedramon X!

Body:
Halloween has returned, and we've done our best to decorate this place but most important stuff is missing.
The letters for HALLOWEEN. They didn't just disappear, so they must be stolen. You don't have to look very far. You'll probably find them from monsters in the Digital World.

Please find the letter boxes and bring me WE.
Process: We don't have much time…
Complete:
Thank you Tamer!
You've just made a contribution to Halloween festival!

Body:
The letters missing are not just WE.
Other letters were also stolen by those clumsy monsters.

Can you find some more letters and bring them to me?

Now the letters I need are NOW.
Process: I wish we had more time…
Complete:
Thank you!
Now we're one step closer to Halloween!

Body:
Thanks to your help, the situation is better now.
However, we're still missing many letters.

If you can find and bring some more of them, it would be grateful!

Please find WHEE from the boxes and bring them to me.
Process: The time is ticking. I'm getting nervous.
Complete:
Whee! Thanks Tamer!
With your assist, Halloween is getting in shape!

Body:
This is absurd!
I didn't realize until now of how many letters have been stolen.
This is crazy!

Can you help me find the rest of these letters?
This time, please bring me ALOHAOE.
Process: Time is running out!
Complete:
Outstanding performance!
We're almost ready for perfection!

Body:
I thought we were done with find the missing letters, but there is a problem.
We need more letters for decorating the trick or treat boxes to distribute to the children.

I heard that there are still many monsters who are carrying the box with letters. Please do me a favor. Bring me HALLOWEEN this time.
Process: We can't ruin an event that takes place just once a year!
Complete:
Excellent!!
You're good to join the Halloween festival!

Body:
It may be quite depressing, but the letters are constantly being stolen whenever we're not aware. I don't know how they've done it.

Sorry for keep asking for help, but if you help me again for the last time, I'll reward you with something really worthy.
Please bring me 5 of HALLOWEEN.
Process: Together, we can complete Halloween!
Complete:
Perfect!!
Perhaps now you can go for trick or treating!

Have you heard about the story of DigiDestined in the past?
Those children had fought against the big threat against Real World.

If you make up your mind and follow their footsteps, I'll make it worthy for you.

Those children are true heroes.
And so are you.

Do you happen to remember the story of Chosen Children that I told you from File Island area? The story of encountering MonoChromon in File Island Waterfront.

I'll tell you the rest of the story of Chosen Children.

The Chosen Children crossed the sea from File Island to Server Continent and fought against the evil Digimon.

The vestige of this history is still remaining.

Go to Server Continent Desert and deal with Neptunemon, FanBeemon and Greymon.
Process: You'd better watch yourself when you get there.
Complete: You've done well.

The Chosen Children went to Canyon after battle in the desert.

Body:
Hello there. As you know, it is time for my season to take over.
But for some reason, Zhuqiaomon had spread energy of Summer more than enough, causing difficulty on retrieving them.
I'm trying to purify the energy, so can you help?

"Zhuqiaomon's Heat" is permeated to local creatures, so you'll be able to get it when you defeat the monsters.
Process: The Summer is gone, and Fall will take over.
Complete: Now, take a look. Combine the stuff I gave you and Zhuqiaomon's Heat together and the Summer heat will return to Zhuqiaomon. I'll do the crafting. When you're done, I'll reward you.
Expert: 주작몬의 열기들을 충분히 모았나?

Body:
Hi, you must have heard the story.
Some of my fellows have escaped Verdandi Terminal with the unstable X-Antibody.
If they're unstopped, the X-Antibody will spread in Digital World and influence all creatures to become violent.
Can you find them and re-claim them before it is too late?
The ones that have the X-Antibody are hidden somewhere in Digital World, between the group of Candlemon.
Simple: Find the Boss among <Revolt> Candlemon and Collect X-Antibody
Process: Do you think I have that power inside me too?
Complete: Thank you! With your help, I sence the unstable X-Antibody power has been neutralized!
Expert: You're back?

Body:
X-Antibody. Honestly, I'm curious about that power.
I wonder how we will change when we possess the power.
To this question, White-bearded Guru has made cards that show us the aspects of when our Digicore and X-Antibody are fused.

Also of what kind of power we can get.

This is the card I was talking about. Will you take a look on it?
Simple: Defeat Dynasmon X summoned from the Dynasmon X Summon Card
Process: Here's the card.
Complete: Great! I'll give you the reward.

Body: You must have heard of it. It's another aspect of Omegamon Zwart. If you can find it yourself, I'll give you a suiting name.
Simple: Talk to Omegamon with Omegamon Zwart D as your partner
Process: It's nothing compulsory. Do as you wish.
Complete: That's it. Take this title with you.
Expert: So this is a dark reflection of myself? Interesting...

Body:
Do you want to experience the dark side of me, Omegamon Zwart D?
If you wish to see it, just let me know.
Simple: Talk to Omegamon in DATS Center
Process: Hmm…
Complete: Test your own strength.
Expert: Good. Then…

Body:
Culu~! Welcome back!
I was looking for you, Culu!
I hear the voice of someone who's looking for you from the East of Western Area, Culu~!
I advise you to go there at once, Culu!
Oh, you don't need to worry~! It's a voice from good-hearted being, Culu!
Simple: Talk to somebody in Western Village : East
Helper: %qs1Talk to somebody in Western Village : East%qe  %cc1/%mc1
Process: I hope nothing bad happens… Culu…
Complete: You've really came here.

Body:
The dark reflection of myself will bring destruction to the Digital World…
I, Omegamon will stop it for good!
Simple:
Summon Omegamon from Western Area : East
Defeat Omegamon
Process: Don't even think of resistance!
Complete:
Ha… You're quite tough.
Now I can see why Yggdrasil had concerned.

Body:
I've watched it very well. The collision between two Omegamon.
Same but different, the light and darkness, good and evil, positive and negative energy.
It was pretty amazing by the way~ hahahahaha!
Process:
Hey, what's the matter with you?
You look like it's the end of world tomorrow.
Complete:
Oh, your friend Omegamon Zwart…
Seems to be badly injured. Not so strange that the opponent was Omegamon.
It'd be more strange to be clean after fighting an opponent of same rank.

Body:
Well, I understand that why you don't trust me.
I can read from your expressions that you're thinking 'What the hell is this guy planning to do?'.
But you better trust me for once at least…
Because I know how to treat the wounds of your friend leaving not a single scratch behind.
Process: Just trust me for once and I'll have your friend perfectly healed as you wish.
Complete:
Very well, my friend.
You've made a wise decision…
I hope you keep in mind that the wound of your friend can only be restored by someone like me.

Body:
Good. I guess I've explained enough already, so shall I talk about the requirements?
I know that your friend is in injured state, but for healing the wounds cleanly, you need more effort. You should know it's necessary?
What required now is the materials for making the cure.
The first required material is Eye of Argomon(Mega) which is formed by Tree attribute and best on curing the cut wounds!
When you bring it to me, I'll tell you the rest!
Simple: Defeat Argomon(Mega) and obtain Eye of Argomon
Process: Argomon(Mega) can be found from Lost Historic.
Complete:
Oh, you really did get it. Very good!
But there are 2 more things required.
Your friend seems to be getting worse by the meantime.

Body:
The next thing we need is Pukumon's Helmet!
Pukumon's Helmet is formed by Water attribute and it is very effective on neutralizing poison!
The complete cure includes poisonous material, so that is why Pukumon's Helmet is needed.
Bring it to me and I'll tell you what's next!
Simple: Defeat Pukumon and obtain Pukumon's Helmet
Process: Pukumon can be found from File Island Waterfront!
Complete:
Good job. You've got the material correctly!
Omegamon Zwart, you're doing great so far.
But you should continue until it's completely done.

Body:
Now we're on the final step! Keep it up~!
The final required material is Megidramon's Flame!
Megidramon's Flame is formed by Fire attrtibute and it's highly effective on restoring the damage influenced by frostbite!
When the cure is treated, it will be able to restore the wound made by Garuru Cannon.
Bring it to me and I'll complete the cure.
Simple: Defeat Megidramon and obtain Megidramon's Flame
Process: Megidramon can be found from Silent Forest!
Complete:
It must have been tough deal, but seems like you went through it.
However, there is one bad news.
If you promise not to hit me, I can tell you.
So, what do you say?

Body:
The real final requirements are the Heart and Ivory of SkullMammothmon!
These things are separate, but can be obtained from one SkullMammothmon, so we can still say they're final!
The Heart and Ivory of SkullMammothmon will help the other materials to combine and become a complete cure.
With these materials, I can finish the cure to heal your friend!
What's hanging your back? Go and get them while I'll prepare to make the cure!
Simple:
Defeat SkullMammothmon and obtain Heart of SkullMammothmon
Defeat SkullMammothmon and obtain Ivory of SkullMammothmon
Process: SkullMammothmon is known to be at Verdandi Terminal.
Complete:
Oh, that's great~!
Things are going as planned!

Body:
Good~ Now I've finished making the cure to heal your friend's wounds!
Here, take it. It's in a form of injection.
It doesn't matter where you inject it. I'm just letting you heal your friend yourself.
Simple: Use the Cure in Kurata's Hideout
Process: The Party Time is about to begin soon… hehe.
Complete:
Have you injected the cure properly?
If so, you'll see how it works soon.

Body:
Hmmm… Omegamon Zwart….You have a long life…
Poor guy….. It will be much easier if you just give up on it…
You are still holding your life....

Okay… then I’ll help you to release that life…
My MugenDramons will attack Omegamon Zwart to accelerate its berserker…

MugenDramons!! Attack Omegamon Zwart~!
Process: Rampaging holy knight? It's really attracting.
Complete:
Oh~ how amazing!
He's holding up even after defeating MugenDramon…
So he is Omegamon after all… what a surprise.

But the rampage from inside cannot be stopped.
In the end, it will devour the soul.
No hard feelings, but I'd say it's a proper maneuver for disturbing my plan of Armagemon!!

Enjoy watching how Omegamon Zwart's soul being swallowen by madness and suffer until the very end.
I'm done here now. Maybe I'll come back with a more pleasant surprise next time. Hahaha...

Body:
Beep! It’s me! I found that a huge Digimon appeared on Western Area: East!
Is it related to you?

I see... If it’s not a big deal, come back to headquarter and report the situation!
Over!
Process: Please report the state!
Complete:
I see… It's Akihiro Kurata again after all…

By the way, I see that Omegamon Zwart is in a critical stage.
That's terrible…

Body:
Well, I understand that why you don't trust me.
I can read from your expressions that you're thinking 'What the hell is this guy planning to do?'.
But you better trust me for once at least…
Because I know how to treat the wounds of your friend leaving not
Complete:
Welcome again, Culu~!
I've been expecting you at this time, Culu~!
Expert:
Oh… that's what happened…
Unfortunately, neither I can help…
I have some clues theoretically, but I don't have enough time for conclusions now.

How about asking for help to Calumon?
Calumon may be able to give you a solution.

Body:
You've injected Akihiro Kurata's cure on Omegamon Zwart, Culu?
Oh, why in the Earth have you done that, Culu?
If Virus data gets into Vaccine attribute Digimon, it's only going to make bad results! Culu!
Did you really not notice it, Culu?
Silly! That was very poor decision, Culu!

But what happened is what happened.
If you just leave Omegamon Zwart like this, it will eventually lead him to die, Culu!
Process: I've found the only thing that can be done, Culu!
Complete:
Omegamon Zwart will face death if we don't do anything… Culu.

To save him from death, we need something that resists against Virus attribute, Culu!
This stuff I have are devided to 2 parts and only effective when the 2 parts are together, but unfortunately I only have 1 part now, so it won't show it's full effect.

But if you can find the other part, your partner Omegamon Zwart can gain power to resist against Virus and can evolve into another form at the same time, Culu!

Anyway, even if it ends successfully, the evolution will lead to incomplete status.
So I hope this accident never happens again, Culu!

Body:
Well…
I know this may sound awkward at first, but I hope you not to get me wrong.

I just asked you if you're willing to use this Digivice, but it's not possible at this moment.
Ah! Like I said, don't misunderstand me.
I really want to let you use my new invention too.
However, those weird looking group of Kokuwamon stole all the batteries that goes into the Digivice!

I'm sorry to ask you for a favor, but there's no other choice for me other than to ask for retrieving the batteries. If you do that, the new Digivice will be yours without additional cost!!

So what do you think? Isn't it fair enough?
If you agree with me, please find and bring me those batteries!
Process:
New Digivice is for sale!
Oh, is that you? My bad! Of course I have my word on you. Don't worry about the promise!
Complete:
Thank you~ sincerely!
You've done a great favor for me!
I'll give you the new Digivice as I've promised.
Experience the innovation as you use it!
Oh, by the way, it's packed in a box.
I hope you don't mind about that.

Body: If you want to succeed the title of Ceresmon, go and collect Grain of Myth from the monsters all over the world.
Simple: Collect 200 Grains of Myth from monsters all over the areas.
Process: You can gain the power of woods when you succeed the title of Ceresmon.
Complete: Impressive!

Body:
Glad to see you. A tough looking Tamer and partner Digimon.
Agumon family members have grouped uop together as we assemble once in a year when Moon rises in the sky of Autumn.
However, we're having a dispute of proving who's the best of all of us.
Uh… even though I think I'm the best.

So you've been helping others alot so far?
Will you become a judge and make a fair rule?
If you agree to do so, please do me a favor.
I'll tell you the opponents you can fight, so you can prove yourself to become our judge.
Process: I obviously think the new generation of Agumon is the mightiest of all. Don't you agree?
Complete: Wow! You've defeated them so fast!

Body:
Good then, one of us will become your duel opponent.
While you face one of us, you'll see who's the strongest among us.
After you choose one, I'll give you a gift.
When you're ready, please let me know.
Process: I'll be waiting for you.
Complete:
Here you are. This is the card that you can summon one of us.
If you defeat Agumon who has been summoned from the Summon Square, I'll give you the gift.
Expert: So are you prepared?

Body:
You must be the new student that just came!

Can I ask you a favor? I'm sorry to ask for help to a new student, but I have no other choice now.
We've lost contact with the substitute teacher field trip group that went to the File Island Waterfront.

Can you get there and check what's going on?
Process: If it's him, I have no worries.
Complete: Oh! You must be the new one?

Body:
The substitute teacher field trip groups are not just one.

There's another group that went to Server Continent Desert.
We've lost contact with them also.

Can you check that area too?
Process: What could be happening…
Complete: Thanks! Now I can make the juice to wake Marcus!

Body:
New semester is pretty close now, but Marcus seems to forgot about it and keeps idling in the beaches.
Even when our Digimon friends are helping us.

I think it's time for me to give him my specially made juice to wake him up.
But for that, I need the ingredients first. Will you be kind enough to help me with this?

The ingredients must be available from the monsters around this area.
Simple: Collect Special Recipe Juice's Ingredient from monsters in File Island Waterfront
Process: I have 2 people waiting…
Complete: Thank you very much!! We'll return as soon as we complete!

Body:
You should be sent by Vice Principle Yushima?
The research for class is almost done, but we have a problem.
Mimi has been exhausted and passed out.
I don't know if we can return before the next semester.

While we continue the research, can you get some water to Mimi?
The water here is very difficult to find, so you should find from the monsters in this area.

I know it's harsh task, but you're the only one I can ask for help now.
Process: This place is too hot and dry.
Complete: You've done a great job!

Body:
To find the study materials and data for teaching the students in school, the Chosen Children and DATS agents are doing the activities in Digital World.
The school has given them special position called substitute teacher, with the certificates that are given when they help other children.

When you happen to get the certificates, bring them to me and I'll compensate you.
Process: Ah, you have them there!
Complete: Good. Please stay as a faithful student!

Body:
Welcome to the unique Digimon school.
As a congratulations present for you, I'll give you this school uniform.
Even though the data of this uniform is unstabilized and can last for only a day, I'll give you rechargeable energy everyday, so don't worry.
Process: Now, let's see what we have here.
Complete: Good luck for today too!
Expert: So are you prepared?
