4. Right-click on your Jumping Digimon DigiEgg to instantly hatch it. And then, name your Digimon by your favor.
5. Switch your partner Digimon to Jumping Digimon that you just hatched!
6. Right-click on Moon Stone of Fortune to instantly level up your Jumping Digimon! Also use EXP Ruby for your Tamer to instantly level up just like your Jumping Digimon.

You're now standing on Valley of Light. What do you think?

It was destroyed many times in the past, but had been rebuilt like now, so you can stand on it right here.
Complete:
Oh, one more thing! I forgot to tell you!
There is something you should be aware of from now on!

Body:
Valley of Light has been occupied by the crowds of Myotismon's Army who's trying to invade the Real World. They're Myotismon's minions, so they're very strong, but you don't need to worry! There's still a safe route to look around this place.
1. Press 'I' to open your bag.
2. You'll find item called 'Mode Selector'. Right-click on it, or press 'X' to open Digimon window.
3. Look for the Digimon icon that has '+' mark on top-right corner.
4. After the Riding Mode slot is opened, you can use ride on your Digimon by pressing 'R' key.

During the riding mode, you can travel safely around this area.
Shall we continue the tour in Valley of Light then?

Oh, and there is one thing I'd like you to be aware of!
In the Valley of Light, White-bearded Guru is standing there to send you back to D-Terminal.
If you go back to D-Terminal in the middle of tour, it can become such a pain to return here, so please don't make a mistake!
Simple: Go to Valley of Light Station

Hello there!
You look like a student to me.
How're you doing in your school?
Anyway, I have a situation here. My class students are not showing up in class even after new semester has begun.
Can you find and make them come back to class?
Process: I hope my students can learn from you!
Complete:
Thank you, buddy!
As a moral of their laziness, I'll double their homeworks today!
Hahaha… just kidding!
I don't want my students to refuse coming to class again.

Body: The Dark Masters are more persistent than I've thought! They returned, in such a bad time. I've heard that they are lurking somewhere among the File Island Areas and Server Continent Areas. Can you drive them out of Digital World for the peace? If you do, it would be a great favor in restoring the damaged Digital World.
Simple:
Defeat MetalSeadramon
Defeat Puppetmon
Defeat MachineDramon
Defeat Piedmon
Process: When will Digital World become peaceful again?
Complete: Thank you! I can't imagine what the world would be like without a friend like you. I guess we're maintaining peace with your support!

Body: The humans act like they're not bothered by the Digital World's damage and seem to not care about it. But it's wrong, and humans definitely have responsibility for Digital World being ruined. I hope you're different from them. If you cooperate on the reconstruction, I'll make you get paid for it, so don't take this as an unfair request. We need energy sources to repair the damages. Find them and bring them to me.
Simple:
Collect Scar Essence
Collect Uprising Flame Piece
Collect Energy of Steel
Collect Energy of Thunder God

Process: Digital World is ruined a lot, but when humans like you can help, there is still hope.
Complete: Good job so far. Here is the compensation.

TitleText: [Daily] Training with the Humans Begins Now!
Body: Yes, I admit that we have lost the fight against you. The fight was fair and square and you beat us with your pure skills and strength. We have no excuses. However, we are Four Holy Beasts, the guardians of this world. Please fight us again like you did before. This can be a great opportunity for us to train!
Simple:
Defeat Xuanwumon
Defeat Zhuqiaomon
Defeat Baihumon
Defeat Qinglongmon
Process: Training isn't only for the weak! It has no exceptions!
Complete: Impressive! We've failed to redeem our honor, but it was a good discipline. We may have chance to win in the future, so don't be lazy in your training!

Body: I wonder if you've heard, but recently Fanglongmon seems to be awakening. Unfortunately, we're not strong enough to stop it. Fanglongmon was once the leader of us, also an emperor who once ruled the world. Fanglongmon was defeated and sealed up by an angel Digimon a long time ago. However, nothing could stop Fanglongmon from regaining his power, and it started to break the seal. And when he's finally free from the seal, boundless power will be released instantly, influencing Digital World, and even the Real World too. We need your help on this.
Complete: I appreciate that. With your help, we can work things out.

Body: There's one important thing you must do in prior. Lucemon has emerged in the Real World. You should take care of Lucemon first. Lucemon's presence in the Real World may stimulate Fanglongmon's fury and our mission to stop Fanglongmon can fail before we can even start it. Lucemon was last found from Yokohama East Village. Please deal with Lucemon and make him weaker, so Fanglongmon does not become aware of him.
Process: Lucemon may be planning something wicked. Don't fall into his trap!
Complete: Oh, you've already dealed with Lucemon? That was pretty fast. No wonder you could beat us.

TitleText: Treatment for the Four Holy Beasts
Body: Now we won't have to worry about Lucemon for a while. However, Qinglongmon, Zhuqiaomon, and Baihumon they all seem to be exhausted from the reconstruction of Digital World. If you can help, can you find and bring something for a good health care? I heard that Digimons these days carry Tonic for taking care of their conditions.
Process: I wonder how this drink effect on our bodies. Aren't you?
Complete: So this is the Tonic people were talking about.

TitleText: Digimon Who Failed Becoming a Holy Beast
Body: The Tonic that you brought us was very helpful indeed. I greatly appreciate it. Oh, and if you don't mind, can you deliver this to Megadramon? I'll explain later.
Process: I hope he likes my present.
Complete: A long time ago, in the past, we have had human partners with us and were defending the Digital World. 5 Humans and their partners, us. We pretty managed well to secure the world in peace. But once we had a fierce battle against the enemies so called Dark Masters. We were defeated by them and facing crisis to be eliminated. But at that time, there was a friend who threw himself into battle to save us. That is, MegaDramon, who you've delivered the Digicore. I wanted to repay him.
Expert: What is this? Oh… I'm feeling much stronger. Is this the power of Xuanwumon?

TitleText: A Battle to Save the World
Body: I feel much better as we could repay Megadramon for his debt. Without any burden in my mind, I think I'm ready to return to the plan. Now, let's go to stop Fanglongmon, for the world's peace!
Process: Are you prepared for the battle? Let me know when you're ready.
Complete: Amazing! We could truly stop Fanglongmon by ourselves.

TitleText: Final Battle, for Saving the World Again
Body: The last battle was not enough to stop Fanglongmon for good, so we should try again to for a perfect conclusion. We've already faced Fanglongmon before, so I don't worry too much this time. Let's go again to save the world.
Process: Are you prepared for the battle? Let me know when you're ready.
Complete: As we thought, you've done it again. I guess we won't have to worry about the peace of Digital World and Real World in this century!!

Body: Hi there. Are you willing to be kind enough to help your neighborhood? Then I can give you the opportunity.
Complete: Yes? I appreciate that. I was studying about the survival and resistance against X-Program and by some kind of coincidence, I've discovered a new way of evolution. However, I felt that the power I gained is too strong for myself to take control. So I want a match to test controlling my new powers. Take this with you on the way to D-Terminal Summon Square and use it there. Duel with me there in the evoluted form.

Body: I finally found out how to evolute in Digital World. I can give you advice how to evolve your friend to Gallantmon X! If you succeed on it, I'll give you a nice present!
Process: Did you find the way to evolve your friend?
Complete: So you've figured the way out to evolve your partner to Gallantmon X? You can become the real champion from now!

Body:
Continued from the incident that happened last year, let me explain about the entire affairs.
There's a place that looks exactly like Village of the beginning, but actually somewhere of different time and space. Apocalymon was preparing to attack our world from that place.
Luckily, I managed to stop its plan by installing firewalls.
Then I went there for investigation, but could not proceed because of Apocalymon's evil spirits.
Process:
I haven't seen Apocalymon itself, but the evil spirits of Apocalymon are already tough enemies to deal with.
I've made a report of the situation to DATS Center already, and the firewall will keep off Apocalymon from invasion.
It's certain that this world may get into big trouble when Apocalymon really invades.
Complete:
I don't think it's a good idea to go there.
You shouldn't risk your life after you just saved me.
And there are still many investigations to be done.
Expert:
I haven't seen Apocalymon itself, but the evil spirits of Apocalymon are already tough enemies to deal with.
I've made a report of the situation to DATS Center already, and the firewall will keep off Apocalymon from invasion.
It's certain that this world

Body:
My colleague fell into a trap during the investigation!
Who'd have imagined such trap to be set in this place.
It's the Giromons who set this up!
Can you find the key from them to set this friend free?
Process: My friend's not going to be trapped there forever, isn't he?
Complete:
Oh my! You've really found the key!
Finally, I can save my colleague.
Take this as a reward!

Body:
With luck, I could receive your help and get free, but it's still not good that there are disrupters on the investigation.
To continue on, they must be eliminated.
Can you help the investigation by eliminating the disrupters?
The leader of those bastards are known to be HiAndromon.
He's quite a tough enemy, and emerges from somewhere among the Western areas.
I promise to reward you sufficiently.
Process: HiAndromon is tough enemy. When you face him, don't lose your concentration.
Complete:
Wow, you've really defeated HiAndromon!
Even though they seem to emerge from time to time… your achievement will be great help for the investigation.
Oh, and don't forget to claim your reward.

Body:
The Warp Fragments are not perfectly stabilized, but that's still fine with me.
Bring them to me and I'll exchange them to Detective's Badge.
You may already know, but these badges are pretty valuable.
Collect as many Warp Fragments as you can and bring them to me.
Process: Warp Fragments are required to build the Teleporters. Yet, the chance to succeed is not so high. But you can just focus on collecting them for now.
Complete:
Ugghh… it really is very very difficult to succeed on combining these fragments… they just got ruined.
Anyway, I appreciate your effort.
Take the reward.

Body:
I don't know if you've heard of this already, but there are secret diagrams found from the wild Digimons recently.
If you're interested in unlocking the secret boxes, can you find the diagrams for me?
Process: Haha… there seem to be so many of them. It's a tough deal, I know. But keep up the good work, you'll be rewarded fairly.
Complete: That's so many diagrams in a short period. You're very diligent! I guess you deserve a nice reward.

Body: I've recently lost most of the new year's fortune cards. They've been stolen somehow, but they're very important to me. Can you help me find those cards? I'll definitely reward you for the favor.
Process: The cards are not just ordinary cards. They're made specially for fortune telling during the New Year season. I really need them.
Complete: That's it! Thank you! Let me tell your fortune as a returning of favor.

Body:
Hi, friends! Will you play along with us? It's a simple Tag game. We brothers will be running around the places in Digital World. The tag won't attack you first, so you find the tag and challenge the Tag. Easy, isn't it?
If you beat us in the game, I'll give you an item that you can make in to something special as a reward.
Process: You'd better keep your eyes wide open!
Complete: Finished already? I thought we just began!

Body:
Hi, buddy! If you don't mind, can you help us? We are 3 Agumon(Black) brothers! Recently our youngest brother seems to be depressed and is not talking with us.
Can you ask him, or find out what's make him so depressed?
Process: I wonder what makes him so silent.
Complete: Yes, there is something that bothers me.
Expert: Who are you by the way? Me? Looking depressed?

Body:
My elder brothers are able to evolve into stronger forms! But the only problem is with me. I'm not old and experienced enough for the evolution.
I've heard about a dragon-type Digimon's appearance recently, so I want to find out about its evolution, but I'm not strong enough. Can you find out the true aspects of Digimon from the rumors?
Process: The rumors say that the newly found Digimon looks awesome!
Complete: Is it BlitzGreymon?

Body: BlitzGreymon is a very fascinating Digimon indeed! However, there are not many people who knows well about it… Will you be able to track down the rumors? If you find a clue, I'll give you something good in return!!
Process: What would I look like when I turn into BlitzGreymon?
Complete: Haha! Now I'm one step closer to evolve into BlitzGreymon myself!

Body:
Now I decided my path, so the only question left is, how to become strong enough for the evolution!!
Can you bring Agumon(Black) friend so we can find the way to evolution fast? I'll get my brothers for some help. Let's do this! This chances don't come to us everyday!
Process: Let me know when you're ready!
Complete: Great! We're all prepared now!

Body:
My elder brothers agreed to help us training. My brothers can evolve into Millenniumon and Omegamon Zwart!
So don't let your guard down, and try best on the duels! I was told that they'll be moving around the areas every 1 hour, so let's go around the areas really quickly!
Process: My brothers will be waiting for us from somewhere.
Complete: Hew! That was a pretty a tough duel!

Body: The training must be continued. We should be able to beat my brothers in duel more perfectly. I can sence that you and I have grown much stronger than before, but still not perfect yet. I know you should feel the same about it.
Process: When you find my brothers, don't hesistate!
Complete: Very nice! The training should be helpful indeed!

Body: Ok, we've been through the hard trials so far. Evolution should be not a difficult task to us anymore. I've sucessfully evolved myself into BlitzGreymon. Can you show me your result now?
Process: You don't need to be shy. You should be proud of this evolution!
Complete: Now, you turned into BlitzGreymon too! Congratulations!! This evolution is a live evidence that shows our efforts of overcoming the trials!

Do you know that there are unique DigiEggs in the File Island Waterfront?
DigiEgg of Shoreline's Breeze.

Can you get it for me? I'd greatly appreciate it if you do.
Process: The DigiEgg can be found from the local monsters there. File Island Waterfront.
Complete:
This DigiEgg is amazing. So beautiful!

Thank you for finding the egg for me!

I'm Digital World's greatest son of Greymon family, Agumon X!
There are too many dragons that brag themselves to be the strongest dragon type Digimon!
I want to prove them that they're wrong!
Please defeat them and make the shameful.
And if you can bring some of their precious stuffs, it would be nice!

Defeat DexDoruGreymon
Defeat MegaDramon
Collect DexDoruGreymon's Horn
Collect MegaDramon's Machine Arm

Body:
I thought plants should be quiet, but some of them are not!
They are being too noisy in Verdandi Terminal.

Mushroomon acts like they're the strongest and Lilymon seems to think they're guardians of justice.
Please defeat them so they can change their minds.
And if you can bring some of their precious stuffs, it would be nice!
Simple:
Defeat Lilymon
Defeat Mushroomon
Collect Lilimon's Wings
Collect Mushroomon's Mushroom

Process: Mushrooms and wings would make this plan perfect!
Complete:
I really hate these plants!
But these loots look nice though. Thank you!

Body:
Verdandi Terminal is full of freaks!
Leomons are insane, they are aggressive to anyone near them, and Kunemons are making annoying noises everytime when someone trespasses.
Please defeat them and bring peace to the area.
And if you can bring some of their precious stuffs, it would be nice!
Simple:
Defeat Leomon
Defeat Kunemon
Collect Leomon's Blade
Collect Kunemon's Antenna

Complete:
Hew~ I feel much relieved now~
Thanks!

Body:
On the way back to Thomas, can you deliver this to him?
It's a present that I've prepared.
Because I'd like to repay for the favor.
Thank you~!
Process: Marcus??
Complete:
A returning present from Kristy?
She must have been happy with the present then.
Thank you for the support.

Body:
We defeated Apocalymon long time ago, but it resurrected somehow and becoming threat to us again!
I'll guide you to the place where it is found.
Please defeat Apocalymon and stop the potential disaster!
Complete: It's not alone this time. Watch out for its minions!

Simple: Set up the 7th Anniversary Cake Candle

Body:
Another guest?
Glad to see you!
I wonder if this isn't rude to ask, but I was looking for someone who can help. You see, my friend Agumon is pretty hungry now since he hasn't eat for a while.
I can't leave here now because I need to prepare for the 7th Anniversary party. Please help me if you don't mind!
Process: Agumon eats a lot, so I guess 10 Chickens will be enough!
Complete:
Wow~ Did you bring me those Chickens?
For me? Thanks very much~~~!

Body:
Uh oh~ mate~
I'm really glad you gave me chickens and they were very tasty… but I ate too fast and now I'm thirsty~
Can you bring me something to drink? Something popping like Soda would be nice~
Process: Ask Marcus bro, he may know where to get it~!
Complete: Really? Agumon must have eaten too fast so he needs water…

Body:
So, Agumon asked you for something to drink?
Then, I guess I'll give you some of the beverages.
It's a Pop Soda prepared for the 7th Anniversary Party, but I'm giving it for Agumon. Please don't tell the others.
Simple: Passing the Pop Soda to Agumon
Complete: Wow~!! Is this really Soda? You have my love~!

Body:
Hello there, I'm Gaomon.
My Master seems to be worried about something, not like he used to be. If it's ok for you, can you ask him what is troubling him?
Complete: Oh? Hi. How did you come here?

Body:
You came as Gaomon asked you?
That's quite understandable. I should have spoke with him earlier. It's nothing so serious. I was just thinking of Marcus' mother and sister as they could not join the 7th Anniversary Party. If you came to help me, can you deliver a letter and a present for them? Thanks in advance...

Process: She should be at her house by now.
Complete: Thomas has sent you?

Body:
That is really Thomas. He's very sencitive.
Kristy? She's at School now~
You'll be able to see her there now.

So what could Thomas have written for me?

%qs2Deliver Present to Kristy Damon%qe  %cc2/%mc2

A present??
It's from Thomas?
He's so kind! Please tell him thanks.
And thank you too!

Body:
Hi there. I introduced myself before. I'm Yoshino.
What? You are here to help me because I don't look like I'm in a good mood?
Process: I guess I can't deny that.
Complete:
Hmm… that's probably because…
I was remembering of someone.

Body:
I once had a friend, who fell into a bad path for a moment… his name is G. Neon…
I'm quite curious of how he's doing now.

Can you deliver this to G. Neon?
Process: G. Neon should be somewhere in the village.
Complete:
Yoshino told you to deliver this?
Thanks, but please tell her I can't accept that request.
She's probably just worried about my future, which is unnecessary for herself.

Body:
That is how G. Neon responded?
Not very surprising, but still a pity…
By the way, I guess I can't leave our captain lonely?
Please deliver this present to captain Sampson. Thank you!

Thank you, and please tell her my thanks.

Body:
Unfortunately, we have a situation.
I don't like to give you a task during a celebration, but first thing's first. There's a report that there are Digimons realized in Yokohama Village, unleashed.
Please take care of them and return.
Process: If you deal with this task, I'll invite you to this party, guranteed.
Complete: Good job! You can enjoy the party now!

Body:
Huh? What are you talking about?
I look like I don't belong to the party?
What's your problem?

No? You're just worried about me?
That's a little awkward. Ok, I'll tell you why then.
It's simple. My father could not attend the party even when he deserves to. If you're here to help, can you see how he's doing outside? Thanks!
Complete:
Did you say Keenan?
My son?

Body:
Can you tell him, my son that I'm doing just fine?
Oh, and if you can help, please take care of the rampageous Digimons in the D-Terminal.

I know you can handle it easily!
Simple:
Talk to Keenan Krier
Defeat Drimogemon
Process: Those monsters are loitering around in D-Terminal Dungeon B1!
Complete:
My father said that he's fine?
Hmm… I thought he may have been disappointed.
It's good to hear that he's not unhappy.
Thanks for helping!

Please deliver this present to my father.

You came to help? That's very kind of you.
Do you see PawnChessmon B who's next to me?
She's pretty quiet but very deligent, and I want to thank her with a little present.
Can you ask her what she wants as a present?
Oh, please don't tell that I told you to do so.

She's remaining silent?
Ugghh… that's not as what I was expecting.

I guess we should ask Mary for help this time!
Can you ask Mary what PawnChessmon W and PawnChessmon B prefers?

Thank you~
Complete: Oh, well…

So that is Miki's question?
But I had the same question myself.

How about you go and ask PawnChessmon W as if you're curious about it?

When you get the answer from him, please tell me too. Thanks!
Process: Did I sound like our captain?

Well… not that I expected them to talk… but…

There's a friend who used to be quiet, not beside me now, but someone I could always rely on.

I appreciate your cooperation!
Process: You should be able to find Kudamon from Western Village.

A present from Richard Sampson?
That's something unexpected.

Body:
Thanks. And please tell Richard thanks for the present.
Oh… and please also pass him the information of Western Village that I collected.

I have to remain here for a while.
Complete: It's good that Kudamon seems to like the present.

By the way, by analyzing the information sent from Kudamon, there are some symptoms of potential disaster going on.
Can you handle it now?
I'm sure it's an easy task for you.
Complete: Good job! As I expected!

There's someone I would like to give thanks to.
If you don't mind, please deliver my thanks for him too.
Process:
Who is he?
You should know him very well.
He's chief Yushima.
Complete:
Haha… a present from Sampson?
That's something I don't see everyday.

Body:
The present from Sampson reminds me of Kamemon.
Actually, Kamemon needs this present more than me.
But Kamemon seems to be outside now.
Can you deliver this to Kamemon for me?
Thank you.
Process: Kamemon is known to be somewhere in the Snowstorm Village.
Complete:
...
!!!
(He seems to be anxious)

Kamemon received the present silently?
I see…

Body:
So Kamemmon seem to be anxious of something?
Then there must be something going on.
I'm sorry to ask again, but can you go and ask Kamemon what his trouble is?

…
There are bad guys nearby.
Please help me to chase them out.
Complete: You have my thanks…

Body:
We're in a middle of celebration, but there's a man we should keep an eye on.
He is Akihiro Kurata!

Please check what Kurata is upto, and tell me.
Process: That man can be planning something stupid to do.
Complete:
Hashima told you that?
How arrogant…

Body:
Hey, I desire to live in peace now.
There is a Gizumon that I used to research, but now its unleashed and causing some trouble.

I'd like to handle it myself if I can, but I have nothing left on me. So if you're here to help, why don't you deal with it?
Process:
Gizumon must be somewhere around the factory.
It was programmed to create a disorder in the city a long time ago.
Complete: Impressive. You've done well~

Body: Anyway, I'm living quietly and peacefully now, so you can tell Hashima to mind his own business!
Complete:
That's what the man said? Akihiro Kurata?
Unbelievable… but that doesn't mean I don't believe what you've just said. Good job by the way.

Process: Those ingredients can be obtained from Xuanwumon, Zhuqiaomon, and Baihumon!
Complete:
Really? Qinglongmon has prepared the Turkey Cuisine for me?
I didn't know he really meant it. Wonderful!
And thank you for delivering the delious roasted turkey~!

Body:
It's Spring now, but the flowers are not blooming.
Yukidarumon must be the cause of this cold.
Young Palmons are not strong enough to fight the cold.
For the Spring to come to us normally, we need to do something.
Yukidarumon(Frost) has stolen seeds that we should retrieve.
The stolen seeds possess enough energy, so if we get them back, we'll be able to revive Spring.
Process: Please bring the seeds to us. The longlasting cold is becoming painful.
Complete:
That's it. These seeds are the seeds I talked about!
Thank you!
I'll give you this flower in return.

Body:
It should be Spring by now, but isn't it too cold?
It's March already, third month of the year. Unbelieveable!
The way I heard from people, a group of Yukidarumons have invaded Real World and making a disorder.
Can you chase them away so the temperature becomes normal again?
Process: I'm sure that the cause of this abnormal coldness is because of them.
Complete:
Believe or not, the temperature become warmer!
Thanks to you that now we can finally greet our Spring with happiness!

TitleText: Items Lost by Betting with ToyAgumon…
Body:
I've lost my items on bet with ToyAgumon…
I know it's my fault, but I realized that the bet was unfair.
Please help me get my stuffs back!
Complete: Use this block to bet ToyAgumon and you'll be able to play the card game with him.

Body:
I need some help.
Recently, DemiMeramon has increased in numbers drastically and it's causing Whamon's water pouch to dry-up.
He can't stay here longer without any water.
Since I became desperate, I came here and found you.
Can you drive some of DemiMeramon from here for me?
Process: Whamon can regain water in his pouch when the number of DemiMeramons decrease.
Complete: Good Job!! Now please take out the water drops from this water pouch and hand them to Whamon! Thank you!

Body:
We're in a difficult situation.
Meramon is spreading heat all over the world to take his revenge.
Please collect Meramon's Heat to prevent any possible disaster.
Process: Let's cool off the heat!
Complete: Thanks!! I've prepared a nice gift for you!

TitleText: Rehearsal before facing the True Qinglongmon

Simple:
Defeat Xuanwumon from Scar of Water Crystal
Defeat Zhuqiaomon from Uprising Flame
Defeat Baihumon from Trace of Black Steel
Process: Have you completed the rehearsal yet?
Complete:
Looks like you've done the rehearsal already.. Here, take this reward with you, as it's the only reward I can give you.
Please help us maintain the peace of Digital World and Real World.

Body:
Culu? Are you sure you're going straight to Qinglongmon in this condition?
Qinglongmon is the strongest among all the Four Holy Beasts, culu!
Trust me that you won't have a chance if you go now!
Process: Could you feel the mighty force of Qinglongmon, Culu?
Complete:
For the Digital World! Culu!
This is the only thing I can help you now, Culu!
